querySql:
-- task_id: 104663
-- hiveDb: pdata_news_n
-- source: LOCAL_CODE
-- sqlStatus: AVAILABLE
-- scriptPath: BigData-pdata_news_n/news_dm02/pdata_news_n.tyzx_exch_quot_h_fk
-- observed_at: 2026-09-05T01:06:44.430Z

-- createSql
-- DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tyzx_exch_quot_h_fk;  20230822 应柜台交易市场要求,改为全量表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tyzx_exch_quot_h_fk (
    busi_date         STRING COMMENT '数据日期',
    secu_id           STRING COMMENT '统一证券编号',
    src_sys_prdno     STRING COMMENT '源系统产品编号',
    trd_dt            STRING COMMENT '交易日期',     
    crrc_cd           STRING COMMENT '货币代码',     
    pric_pre_clos     STRING COMMENT '昨收盘价(元)',             
    pric_open         STRING COMMENT '开盘价(元)',         
    pric_high         STRING COMMENT '最高价(元)',         
    pric_low          STRING COMMENT '最低价(元)',         
    pric_clos         STRING COMMENT '收盘价(元)',         
    pric_chg          STRING COMMENT '涨跌（当类型为场内期权和港股期货时，记录的是涨跌的价格变化-元，其他类型记录的为涨跌幅-百分比）',         
    deal_vol          STRING COMMENT '成交量（港股股票(股)、港股期货(张)、黄金现货(千克)，其它默认为手）',         
    deal_amt          STRING COMMENT '成交金额(元)',         
    pric_adjpreclose  STRING COMMENT '复权昨收盘价(元)',                 
    pric_adjopen      STRING COMMENT '复权开盘价(元)',             
    pric_adjhigh      STRING COMMENT '复权最高价(元)',             
    pric_adjlow       STRING COMMENT '复权最低价(元)',         
    pric_adjclose     STRING COMMENT '复权收盘价(元)',             
    pric_adjfactor    STRING COMMENT '复权因子',             
    trd_stat          STRING COMMENT '交易状态',         
    buying_pric       STRING COMMENT '买入价（元）',         
    selling_pric      STRING COMMENT '卖出价（元）',             
    sett_pric         STRING COMMENT '结算价（元）',         
    open_intr         STRING COMMENT '持仓量(港股期货:张,其它默认为手）',         
    open_intr_mval    STRING COMMENT '持仓市值（元）',             
    fnd_unit_nav      STRING COMMENT '基金单位净值',             
    nav               STRING COMMENT '资产净值', 
    cir_mval          STRING COMMENT '流通市值（元）',                
    undrl_wind_cd     STRING COMMENT '标的WIND代码',             
    data_src          STRING COMMENT '数据来源',         
    remark            STRING COMMENT '备注',
    pric_avg          STRING COMMENT '均价(VWAP)',     --20241014 新增字段 by wxliupengfei
    accum_unit_nav    STRING COMMENT '累计单位净值',   --20241014 新增字段 by wxliupengfei
    eda_unit_nav      STRING COMMENT '复权单位净值',   --20241014 新增字段 by wxliupengfei

    rec_upd_time      STRING COMMENT '记录更新时间',
    rec_down_time     STRING COMMENT '记录创建时间'
)
COMMENT '证券-每日行情信息'
PARTITIONED BY (
    src_id string comment '来源标识', 
    grp_id string comment '并行标识')
stored as orc;

-- querySql
set hive.merge.mapfiles = true ;
set hive.merge.mapredfiles = true;
set hive.merge.size.per.task=1073741824;
set hive.merge.smallfiles.avgsize=1073741824;
set hive.merge.orcfile.stripe.level=false;
set hive.exec.dynamic.partition=true;
set hive.exec.dynamic.partition.mode=nonstrict;
set hive.exec.max.created.files=10000;
set hive.exec.max.dynamic.partitions.pernode=10000;
set hive.exec.max.dynamic.partitions=10000;
set hive.auto.convert.join=false;

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE tyzx_exch_quot_h_fk partition (src_id = 'TIT', grp_id = '01')
select
     '${data_day_str}'             as busi_date           -- 数据日期
    ,coalesce(b.secu_id, c.secu_id)     as secu_id             -- 统一证券编号            
    ,concat('TIT-', key_instrument_id)  as src_sys_prdno       -- 源系统产品编号                 
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(quote_date), 'yyyyMMdd') as trd_dt -- 交易日期
    ,b.crrc_cd                          as crrc_cd             -- 货币代码
    ,a.preclose_quote                   as pric_pre_clos       -- 昨收盘价(元)
    ,a.open_quote                       as pric_open           -- 开盘价(元)
    ,a.high_quote                       as pric_high           -- 最高价(元)
    ,a.low_quote                        as pric_low            -- 最低价(元)
    ,a.close_quote                      as pric_clos           -- 收盘价(元)
    ,a.pctchange                        as pric_chg            -- 涨跌（当类型为场内期权和港股期货时，记录的是涨跌的价格变化-元，其他类型记录的为涨跌幅-百分比）
    ,a.volume                           as deal_vol            -- 成交量（港股股票(股)、港股期货(张)、黄金现货(千克)，其它默认为手）
    ,a.amount                           as deal_amt            -- 成交金额(元)
    ,a.adjpreclose_quote                as pric_adjpreclose    -- 复权昨收盘价(元)
    ,a.adjopen_quote                                 as pric_adjopen        -- 复权开盘价(元) --20241014补充写入 by wxliupengfei
    ,a.adjhigh_quote                                 as pric_adjhigh        -- 复权最高价(元) --20241014补充写入 by wxliupengfei
    ,a.adjlow_quote                                  as pric_adjlow         -- 复权最低价(元) --20241014补充写入 by wxliupengfei
    ,a.ADJCLOSE_QUOTE                   as pric_adjclose       -- 复权收盘价(元)
    ,a.ADJ_FACTOR                       as pric_adjfactor      -- 复权因子
    ,a.TRADE_STATUS                     as trd_stat            -- 交易状态
    ,a.BID                              as buying_pric         -- 买入价（元）
    ,a.ASK                              as selling_pric        -- 卖出价（元）
    ,a.SETTLE_QUOTE                     as sett_pric           -- 结算价（元）
    ,a.OPEN_INTEREST                    as open_intr           -- 持仓量(港股期货:张,其它默认为手）
    ,a.MARKET_VALUE                     as open_intr_mval      -- 持仓市值（元）
    ,a.UNIT_NAV                         as fnd_unit_nav        -- 基金单位净值
    ,a.NAV                              as nav                 -- 资产净值
    ,a.CIRCULATION_MARKET_VALUE         as cir_mval            -- 流通市值（元）
    ,a.WIND_CODE                        as undrl_wind_cd       -- 标的WIND代码
    ,a.SOURCE_NAME                      as data_src            -- 数据来源
    ,''                                 as remark                 -- 备注
    ,a.avg_price                        as pric_avg            --均价(VWAP)     --20241014 新增字段 by wxliupengfei
    ,a.accum_shr_nav                    as accum_unit_nav      --累计单位净值   --20241014 新增字段 by wxliupengfei
    ,a.adj_shr_nav                      as eda_unit_nav        --复权单位净值   --20241014 新增字段 by wxliupengfei

    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(updated_datetime), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as rec_upd_time  -- 记录修改时间
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                 as rec_down_time -- 记录创建时间
from 
(
    select * from
    odata_n_tit.d_mkt_ins_daily_info 
) a
left join 
(
    select secu_id, in_code, crrc_cd
    from t02_scr_base_info 
    where src_id = 'TIT'
) b 
on a.key_instrument_id = b.in_code
left join 
(
    select secu_id, in_code
    from t02_scr_base_info 
    where src_id = 'WD'
) c 
on a.WIND_CODE = c.in_code
;
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: dm_rsk_n.futr_mkt_quot
querySql:
SELECT secu_id,
	in_code,
	futr_cd,
	trd_dt,
	crrc_code,
	pric_open,
	pric_high,
	pric_low,
	pric_clos,
	sett_pric,
	deal_vol,
	deal_amt,
	data_src_cd,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    a.secu_id,                  --统一证券编码
    a.in_code,                  --源内部编码
    b.futr_cd,                  --期货代码
    a.trd_dt,                   --交易日期
    d.src_const_cd crrc_code,   --货币代码
    a.pric_open,                --开盘价
    a.pric_high,                --最高价
    a.pric_low,                 --最低价
    a.pric_clos,                --收盘价
    a.sett_pric,                --结算价
    a.deal_vol,                 --成交量
    a.deal_amt,                 --成交金额
    'TITANS' as data_src_cd,    --数据来源系统
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${YYYY-MM-DD}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        secu_id,
        substr(src_sys_prdno,5) as in_code,
        default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt,
        pric_open,
        pric_high,
        pric_low,
        pric_clos,
        sett_pric,
        deal_vol,
        deal_amt
    from
        pdata_news_n.tyzx_exch_quot_h_fk
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) a 
join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        date_src,
        src_cd as futr_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '02'
    ) b 
on
    a.in_code = b.in_code
left join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        scr_type_src,
        crrc_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) c 
on
    b.in_code = c.in_code
    and b.date_src = 'WIND'
left join
    (
    select
        const_cd,
        src_const_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const
    where
        src_id = 'TIT' 
        and const_type_cd = 'fin00001'
    ) d 
on
    c.crrc_cd = d.const_cd
where
    c.scr_type_src = 'FUTURE' 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: dm_rsk_n.fnd_mkt_quot_day
querySql:

name: 价格类因子行情表_新增15点30分跑批
querySql:
SELECT fctr_id,
	trd_dt,
	pric_chg,
	pric_clos,
	pric_adjclose,
	pric_adjfactor,
	fnd_unit_nav,
	accum_unit_nav,
	eda_unit_nav,
	src_id,
	src_tbl,
	ori_upd_time,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    fctr_id,                                                            --因子ID
    default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt,                             --交易日期
    cast(chg as double) as pric_chg,                                    --涨跌幅
    '' as pric_clos,                                                    --收盘价
    '' as pric_adjclose,                                                --复权收盘价
    '' as pric_adjfactor,                                               --复权因子
    '' as fnd_unit_nav,                                                 --基金单位净值
    '' as accum_unit_nav,                                               --累计单位净值
    '' as eda_unit_nav,                                                 --复权单位净值
    src_id,                                                             --来源标识
    src_tbl,                                                            --来源表
    rec_upd_time as ori_upd_time,                                       --源头更新时间
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    pdata_news_n.t02_fin_mkt_quot_fctr_rslt
where
    src_id = 'LBR' 
    and grp_id = '01'
union all
select

querySql:

    b.src_const_cd as CURVE_CURRENCY , --收益率币种
    rc.curv_acs_type as CURVE_INTERPOLATOR, --插值方法：LINEAR、LOG_LINEAR、SPLINE、STEP_UP

    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        fctr_cd,
        fctr_curv_ch_name
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_def
    where
        src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and fctr_engine_hand_method in ('VOL_CMF_EWMA_HIS_CALC','VOL_FX_EWMA_HIS_CALC','VOL_IR_CF_HIS_CALC')
    ) a 
join
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        vola_curv_id
    from

    where
        busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and vola_srfc_type = 'TERM'
    ) b 
on
    a.fctr_id = b.fctr_id
join
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        default.datekey2date(trd_date) val_dt,
        term_stru,
        fctr_val,
        maty_date,
        rec_upd_time
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_data
    where
        src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '02'
    ) c 
on
    a.fctr_id = c.fctr_id

select
    a.fctr_id,              --因子ID
    b.vola_curv_id,         --波动率曲线ID
    d.val_dt,               --曲面日期
    a.fctr_cd,              --因子代码
    a.fctr_curv_ch_name,    --因子曲线中文名称
    d.term as dim1,         --维度1取值
    '' as dim2,             --维度2取值
    '' as dim3,             --维度3取值
    cast(d.intrpn/100 as decimal(18,6)) as vola,   --波动率
    d.maty_date,            --到期日
    d.src_id,               --来源标识
    d.rec_upd_time,         --记录更新时间
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        fctr_cd,
        fctr_curv_ch_name
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_def
    where
        src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and fctr_engine_hand_method in ('VOL_GENERIC_ATM_CALC', 'VOL_FUTURE_ATM_CALC', 'VOL_MANUAL_INPUT_CALC','VOL_IMPLIED_BENCHMARK_CALC')

    from

    where
        busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and vola_srfc_type = 'TERM'
        and coalesce(trim(vola_curv_id),'') <> ''
    ) b 
on
    a.fctr_id = b.fctr_id
join
    (
    select
        src_sys_prdno

        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_undrl_data_lbr

        busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'

on
    b.src_sys_prdno = c.src_sys_prdno
join
    (
    select
        curv_surf_id,
        substr(curv_surf_date,1,10) val_dt,
        term,
        intrpn,
        substr(maty_date,1,10) maty_date,
        src_id,
        rec_upd_time
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_vola_instc
    where
        src_id='TIT' 
        and grp_id='01'

on

name: dm_fin_n.v_fin_trs_plreport
querySql:
WITH DT AS (
    select trd_date as busi_date
    from pdata_n.T99_TRD_CAL_REF
    where trd_date between '2023-01-01' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_RCC.U_EXCHANGEDATE'
    and exch_type_cd = '1' and fin_type_cd in ('1','')
    ),
LEG_VALUATION AS (
    select
        Src_Prd_Id,
        busi_date,
        Book_Agt_Id,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FIXED_LEG_TYPE' then Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FLOAT_LEG_TYPE' then Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as STRUC_ACC_R_PNL,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FIXED_LEG_TYPE' then Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as FIXED_ACC_R_PNL,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FLOAT_LEG_TYPE' then Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then Ocrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FIXED_LEG_TYPE' then Ocrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FLOAT_LEG_TYPE' then Ocrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then Ocrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_ORG,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FIXED_LEG_TYPE' then Ocrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_ORG,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FLOAT_LEG_TYPE' then Ocrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_ORG,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then Lcrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FIXED_LEG_TYPE' then Lcrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FLOAT_LEG_TYPE' then Lcrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield else 0 end) as FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then Lcrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_BASE,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FIXED_LEG_TYPE' then Lcrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_BASE,
        sum(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FLOAT_LEG_TYPE' then Lcrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield else 0 end) as FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_BASE
    from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_VALU_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_VALUATION'
    group by Src_Prd_Id, busi_date, Book_Agt_Id
    )

SELECT  CAST( BusiDate AS String ) BusiDate ,
	 CAST( contractCode AS String ) contractCode ,
	 CAST( status AS String ) status ,
	 CAST( bookName AS String ) bookName ,
	 CAST( ctptyShortName AS String ) ctptyShortName ,
	 CAST( windCode AS String ) windCode ,
	 CAST( underlyingName AS String ) underlyingName ,
	 CAST( underlyingType AS String ) underlyingType ,
	 CAST( notionalOrg AS String ) notionalOrg ,
	 CAST( notional AS String ) notional ,
	 CAST( notionalBase AS String ) notionalBase ,
	 CAST( valueOrg AS String ) valueOrg ,
	 CAST( value AS String ) value ,
	 CAST( valueBase AS String ) valueBase ,
	 CAST( dynamicNotionalOrg AS String ) dynamicNotionalOrg ,
	 CAST( dynamicNotional AS String ) dynamicNotional ,
	 CAST( dynamicNotionalBase AS String ) dynamicNotionalBase ,
	 CAST( accuUnrealizedPnl AS String ) accuUnrealizedPnl ,
	 CAST( accuUnrealizedPnlOrg AS String ) accuUnrealizedPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( accuUnrealizedPnlBase AS String ) accuUnrealizedPnlBase ,
	 CAST( accuRealizedPnl AS String ) accuRealizedPnl ,
	 CAST( accuRealizedPnlOrg AS String ) accuRealizedPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( accuRealizedPnlBase AS String ) accuRealizedPnlBase ,
	 CAST( accuTotalPnl AS String ) accuTotalPnl ,
	 CAST( accuTotalPnlOrg AS String ) accuTotalPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( accuTotalPnlBase AS String ) accuTotalPnlBase ,
	 CAST( structureUnPnl AS String ) structureUnPnl ,
	 CAST( fixedUnPnl AS String ) fixedUnPnl ,
	 CAST( floatUnPnl AS String ) floatUnPnl ,
	 CAST( structurePnl AS String ) structurePnl ,
	 CAST( fixedPnl AS String ) fixedPnl ,
	 CAST( floatPnl AS String ) floatPnl ,
	 CAST( structureUnPnlOrg AS String ) structureUnPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( fixedUnPnlOrg AS String ) fixedUnPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( floatUnPnlOrg AS String ) floatUnPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( structurePnlOrg AS String ) structurePnlOrg ,
	 CAST( fixedPnlOrg AS String ) fixedPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( floatPnlOrg AS String ) floatPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( structureUnPnlBase AS String ) structureUnPnlBase ,
	 CAST( fixedUnPnlBase AS String ) fixedUnPnlBase ,
	 CAST( floatUnPnlBase AS String ) floatUnPnlBase ,
	 CAST( structurePnlBase AS String ) structurePnlBase ,
	 CAST( fixedPnlBase AS String ) fixedPnlBase ,
	 CAST( floatPnlBase AS String ) floatPnlBase ,
	 CAST( expensesPnl AS String ) expensesPnl ,
	 CAST( expensesPnlOrg AS String ) expensesPnlOrg ,
	 CAST( expensesPnlBase AS String ) expensesPnlBase ,
	 CAST( settlementCurrency AS String ) settlementCurrency ,
	 CAST( exchangeRateCny AS String ) exchangeRateCny ,
	 CAST( trsType AS String ) trsType ,
	 CAST( accuYtdPnlBase AS String ) accuYtdPnlBase ,
	 CAST( accuYtdPnl AS String ) accuYtdPnl ,
	 CAST( party AS String ) party ,
	 CAST( structureLegDirection AS String ) structureLegDirection ,
	 CAST( fixedLegDirection AS String ) fixedLegDirection ,
	 CAST( floatLegDirection AS String ) floatLegDirection ,
	 CAST( BOOK_DEPARTMENT AS String ) BOOK_DEPARTMENT ,
	grp_id,
	 CAST( busi_date AS String ) busi_date  FROM (
	 
SELECT  --常规存续
    ppd.Busi_Date AS BusiDate,
    trs.Inr_Comp_No AS contractCode,
    '存续' AS status,
    book.Book_Full_Name AS bookName,
    trs.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name AS ctptyShortName,
    CASE WHEN TLEG.Src_Prd_Id like '% %' THEN '多标的' ELSE riu.wind_cd_src END AS windCode,
    CASE WHEN TLEG.Src_Prd_Id like '% %' THEN '多标的' ELSE riu.ch_abbr END AS underlyingName,
    CASE WHEN TLEG.Src_Prd_Id like '% %' THEN '多标的' ELSE riu.scr_type_src END AS underlyingType,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Nom_Prin AS notionalOrg,
    ppd.Nom_Prin AS notional,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Nom_Prin AS notionalBase,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Mval AS valueOrg,
    ppd.Mval AS value,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Mval AS valueBase,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Dyna_Nom_Prin AS dynamicNotionalOrg,
    ppd.Dyna_Nom_Prin AS dynamicNotional,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Dyna_Nom_Prin AS dynamicNotionalBase,
    ppd.Accum_Unrlz_Yield AS accuUnrealizedPnl,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield AS accuUnrealizedPnlOrg,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield AS accuUnrealizedPnlBase,
    ppd.Accum_Rlz_Yield AS accuRealizedPnl,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield AS accuRealizedPnlOrg,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield AS accuRealizedPnlBase,
    ppd.Accum_Yield_Tot AS accuTotalPnl,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot AS accuTotalPnlOrg,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot AS accuTotalPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL, 0 ) AS structureUnPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL, 0 ) AS fixedUnPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL, 0 ) AS floatUnPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS structurePnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS fixedPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS floatPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS structureUnPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS fixedUnPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS floatUnPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS structurePnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS fixedPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS floatPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS structureUnPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS fixedUnPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS floatUnPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS structurePnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS fixedPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS floatPnlBase,
    nvl( ppd.Accum_Rlz_Yield, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS expensesPnl,
    nvl( ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS expensesPnlOrg,
    nvl( ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS expensesPnlBase,
    trs.Sett_Crrc_Cd AS settlementCurrency,
    CASE WHEN EX_RATE.Src_Crrc_Cd <> 'CNY' THEN EX_RATE.Mid_Price ELSE 1 END AS exchangeRateCny,
    trs.Swap_Type_Cd AS trsType,
    ROUND(nvl(ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot, 0) - NVL(py.Lcrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot, 0), 2) AS accuYtdPnlBase,
    ROUND(nvl(ppd.Accum_Yield_Tot, 0) - NVL(py.Accum_Yield_Tot, 0), 2) AS accuYtdPnl,
    trs.Our_Id_Type_Cd AS party,
    H.STRUCTURE_LEG_DIRECTION AS structureLegDirection,
    H.FIXED_LEG_DIRECTION AS fixedLegDirection,
    H.FLOAT_LEG_DIRECTION AS floatLegDirection,
    book.Bel_Dept AS BOOK_DEPARTMENT,
    '01' as grp_id,
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY' and Src_Scr_Type_Cd = 'TRS'
    ) ppd
join DT
on ppd.busi_date = dt.busi_date
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_BOOK_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) book
ON ppd.Book_Agt_Id = book.Book_Agt_Id
JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Comp_Stat_Cd not in ('218','230','255','253','254')
        and Swap_Type_Cd NOT IN ('AB_LONG_SWAP', 'AB_SHORT_SWAP')
    ) trs
ON ppd.Src_Prd_Id = trs.Comp_Src_Prd_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_COMP_RGST_SAC_EVT
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_CONTR_REPORT'
    ) trscr
ON trs.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = trscr.Otc_Comp_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY'
    ) py
ON py.Book_Agt_Id = ppd.Book_Agt_Id AND NVL(py.Ivst_Type_Cd, 0) = NVL(ppd.Ivst_Type_Cd, 0) 
    AND py.Long_Shor_Clas = ppd.Long_Shor_Clas AND py.Src_Prd_Id = ppd.Src_Prd_Id
    AND PY.busi_date = concat(year(ppd.busi_date)-1,'-12-31')
LEFT JOIN LEG_VALUATION PTLV
ON ptlv.Src_Prd_Id = ppd.Src_Prd_Id AND ptlv.busi_date = ppd.busi_date AND ptlv.Book_Agt_Id = ppd.Book_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select *
    from pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) EX_RATE
ON trs.Sett_Crrc_Cd = EX_RATE.src_crrc_cd AND default.datekey2date(EX_RATE.trd_dt) = ppd.busi_date
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        Swap_Comp_Agt_Id,
        max(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then coalesce(Leg_Glbl_Seq_No,'') else '' end) as Leg_Glbl_Seq_No,
        max(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE' then coalesce(Paid_Dir_Cd,'') else '' end) as STRUCTURE_LEG_DIRECTION,
        max(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FIXED_LEG_TYPE' then coalesce(Paid_Dir_Cd,'') else '' end) as FIXED_LEG_DIRECTION,
        max(case when Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd = 'FLOAT_LEG_TYPE' then coalesce(Paid_Dir_Cd,'') else '' end) as FLOAT_LEG_DIRECTION 
    FROM PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' and busi_Date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    group by Swap_Comp_Agt_Id
    ) H
ON H.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = trs.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select
        KEY_LEG_ID,
        concat_ws(' ',collect_set(UNDERLYING_INS_ID)) as Src_Prd_Id
    from PDATA_NDS.POS_TRS_LEG_CURRENT_POS
    where busi_Date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    group by KEY_LEG_ID
    ) TLEG
ON h.Leg_Glbl_Seq_No = TLEG.KEY_LEG_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) riu
ON TLEG.Src_Prd_Id = riu.in_code
WHERE ppd.busi_date >= trs.Strt_Pric_Date and ppd.busi_date < nvl(trscr.Actl_Sett_Date,trs.End_Pric_Date)

UNION ALL  --常规到期
SELECT
    DT.BUSI_DATE AS BusiDate,
    trs.Inr_Comp_No AS contractCode,
    '到期' AS status,
    book.Book_Full_Name AS bookName,
    trs.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name AS ctptyShortName,
    CASE WHEN TLEG.Src_Prd_Id like '% %' THEN '多标的' ELSE riu.wind_cd_src END AS windCode,
    CASE WHEN TLEG.Src_Prd_Id like '% %' THEN '多标的' ELSE riu.ch_abbr END AS underlyingName,
    CASE WHEN TLEG.Src_Prd_Id like '% %' THEN '多标的' ELSE riu.scr_type_src END AS underlyingType,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Nom_Prin AS notionalOrg,
    ppd.Nom_Prin AS notional,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Nom_Prin AS notionalBase,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Mval AS valueOrg,
    ppd.Mval AS value,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Mval AS valueBase,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Dyna_Nom_Prin AS dynamicNotionalOrg,
    ppd.Dyna_Nom_Prin AS dynamicNotional,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Dyna_Nom_Prin AS dynamicNotionalBase,
    ppd.Accum_Unrlz_Yield AS accuUnrealizedPnl,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield AS accuUnrealizedPnlOrg,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Unrlz_Yield AS accuUnrealizedPnlBase,
    ppd.Accum_Rlz_Yield AS accuRealizedPnl,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield AS accuRealizedPnlOrg,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield AS accuRealizedPnlBase,
    ppd.Accum_Yield_Tot AS accuTotalPnl,
    ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot AS accuTotalPnlOrg,
    ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot AS accuTotalPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL, 0 ) AS structureUnPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL, 0 ) AS fixedUnPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL, 0 ) AS floatUnPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS structurePnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS fixedPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS floatPnl,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS structureUnPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS fixedUnPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS floatUnPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS structurePnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS fixedPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS floatPnlOrg,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS structureUnPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS fixedUnPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_UR_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS floatUnPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS structurePnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS fixedPnlBase,
    nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS floatPnlBase,
    nvl( ppd.Accum_Rlz_Yield, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL, 0 ) AS expensesPnl,
    nvl( ppd.Ocrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_ORG, 0 ) AS expensesPnlOrg,
    nvl( ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Rlz_Yield, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.STRUC_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FIXED_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) - nvl( ptlv.FLOATS_ACC_R_PNL_BASE, 0 ) AS expensesPnlBase,
    trs.Sett_Crrc_Cd AS settlementCurrency,
    CASE WHEN EX_RATE.Src_Crrc_Cd <> 'CNY' THEN EX_RATE.Mid_Price ELSE 1 END AS exchangeRateCny,
    trs.Swap_Type_Cd AS trsType,
    CASE WHEN substr(DT.BUSI_DATE,1,4) > substr(nvl(trscr.Actl_Sett_Date, trs.End_Pric_Date),1,4) THEN 0
         ELSE ROUND( nvl( ppd.Lcrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot, 0 ) - NVL( py.Lcrrc_Accum_Yield_Tot, 0 ), 2 ) 
         END AS accuYtdPnlBase,
    CASE WHEN substr(DT.BUSI_DATE,1,4) > substr(nvl(trscr.Actl_Sett_Date, trs.End_Pric_Date),1,4) THEN 0
         ELSE ROUND( nvl( ppd.Accum_Yield_Tot, 0 ) - NVL( py.Accum_Yield_Tot, 0 ), 2 ) 
         END AS accuYtdPnl,
    trs.Our_Id_Type_Cd AS party,
    H.STRUCTURE_LEG_DIRECTION AS structureLegDirection,
    H.FIXED_LEG_DIRECTION AS fixedLegDirection,
    H.FLOAT_LEG_DIRECTION AS floatLegDirection,
    book.Bel_Dept AS BOOK_DEPARTMENT,
    '01' as grp_id,
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY' and Src_Scr_Type_Cd = 'TRS'
    ) ppd
join DT on 1=1
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_BOOK_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) book
ON ppd.Book_Agt_Id = book.Book_Agt_Id
JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Comp_Stat_Cd not in ('218','230','255','253','254')
        and Swap_Type_Cd NOT IN ('AB_LONG_SWAP', 'AB_SHORT_SWAP')
    ) trs
ON ppd.Src_Prd_Id = trs.Comp_Src_Prd_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_COMP_RGST_SAC_EVT
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_CONTR_REPORT'
    ) trscr
ON trs.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = trscr.Otc_Comp_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_BOOK_HOLD_SUM
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_POSITION_DAILY'
    ) py
ON py.Book_Agt_Id = ppd.Book_Agt_Id AND NVL(py.Ivst_Type_Cd, 0) = NVL(ppd.Ivst_Type_Cd, 0) 
    AND py.Long_Shor_Clas = ppd.Long_Shor_Clas AND py.Src_Prd_Id = ppd.Src_Prd_Id
    AND PY.busi_date = concat(year(ppd.busi_date)-1,'-12-31')
LEFT JOIN LEG_VALUATION PTLV
ON ptlv.Src_Prd_Id = ppd.Src_Prd_Id AND ptlv.busi_date = ppd.busi_date AND ptlv.Book_Agt_Id = ppd.Book_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select *
    from pdata_news_n.t02_fxr_cfets_quot
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) EX_RATE
ON trs.Sett_Crrc_Cd = EX_RATE.src_crrc_cd AND default.datekey2date(EX_RATE.trd_dt) = nvl(trscr.Actl_Sett_Date, trs.End_Pric_Date)
LEFT JOIN (

    riu.ch_abbr AS underlyingName,
    riu.scr_type_src AS underlyingType,
    ep.NOTIONAL AS notionalOrg,
    ep.NOTIONAL AS notional,
    ep.NOTIONAL AS notionalBase,
    ep.VAULE AS valueOrg,
    ep.VAULE AS value,
    ep.VAULE AS valueBase,
    ep.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL AS dynamicNotionalOrg,
    ep.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL AS dynamicNotional,
    ep.DYNAMIC_NOTIONAL AS dynamicNotionalBase,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) AS accuUnrealizedPnl,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) AS accuUnrealizedPnlOrg,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) AS accuUnrealizedPnlBase,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCU_OTHER_FEE, 0 ) AS accuRealizedPnl,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCU_OTHER_FEE, 0 ) AS accuRealizedPnlOrg,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCU_OTHER_FEE, 0 ) AS accuRealizedPnlBase,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCU_OTHER_FEE, 0 ) AS accuTotalPnl,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCU_OTHER_FEE, 0 ) AS accuTotalPnlOrg,
    nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT, 0 ) + nvl( ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST, 0 ) + nvl( ACCU_OTHER_FEE, 0 ) AS accuTotalPnlBase,
    ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT AS structureUnPnl,
    ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST AS fixedUnPnl,
    0 AS floatUnPnl,
    ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT AS structurePnl,
    ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST AS fixedPnl,
    0 AS floatPnl,
    ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT AS structureUnPnlOrg,
    ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST AS fixedUnPnlOrg,
    0 AS floatUnPnlOrg,
    ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT AS structurePnlOrg,
    ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST AS fixedPnlOrg,
    0 AS floatPnlOrg,
    ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_PROFIT AS structureUnPnlBase,
    ACCUMULATE_UNREALIZED_INTEREST AS fixedUnPnlBase,
    0 AS floatUnPnlBase,
    ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_PROFIT AS structurePnlBase,
    ACCUMULATE_REALIZED_INTEREST AS fixedPnlBase,
    0 AS floatPnlBase,
    ACCU_OTHER_FEE AS expensesPnlOrg,
    ACCU_OTHER_FEE AS expensesPnl,
    ACCU_OTHER_FEE AS expensesPnlBase,
    SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY AS settlementCurrency,
    1 AS exchangeRateCny,
    CASE WHEN TRS_TYPE = 'CALL_SWAP' THEN '多头互换-金仕达' 
         WHEN TRS_TYPE = 'PUT_SWAP' THEN '空头互换-金仕达' 
         WHEN TRS_TYPE = 'B_LONG_SHORT_SWAP' THEN '多空互换-金仕达'
         ELSE TRS_TYPE END AS trsType,
    ANNUAL AS accuYtdPnlBase,
    ANNUAL AS accuYtdPnl,
    PARTY AS party,
    FIXED_LEG_DIRECTION AS fixedLegDirection,
    FLOAT_LEG_DIRECTION AS floatLegDirection,
    STRUCTURE_LEG_DIRECTION AS structureLegDirection,
    'OTC' AS BOOK_DEPARTMENT,
    '04' as grp_id,
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_NDS.KS_TRADE_COMFIRM_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and substr(business_date,1,10) = substr(nvl(ACTUAL_TERMINATION_DATE, END_DATE),1,10)
        and CONTR_STATUS = 'TERMINATED'
    ) ep
left join (
    select Pty_Id, Shor_Name_Ch
    from PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME
    where src_tbl in ('ODATA_N_OIS.O_OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY') and busi_Date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) rcp
on rcp.Pty_Id = ep.COUNTERPARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    select *        
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) riu
ON ep.UNDERLYING_WIND_CODE = riu.wind_cd_src
JOIN DT ON 1 = 1
WHERE DT.BUSI_DATE >= substr(ep.business_date,1,10) 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: dm_rsk_n.crrc_mkt_intrt
querySql:
SELECT secu_id,
	in_code,
	mkt_data_cd,
	trd_dt,
	bid_pric,
	ask_pric,
	min_pric,
	data_src_cd,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    a.secu_id,                  --统一证券编码
    a.in_code,                  --源内部编码
    b.mkt_data_cd,              --市场数据代码
    a.trd_dt,                   --交易日期

    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${YYYY-MM-DD}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        secu_id,
        substr(src_sys_prdno,5) as in_code,
        default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt,
        cast(intrt/100 as decimal(18,8)) as min_pric
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_ira_indx_info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) a 
join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        date_src,
        src_cd as mkt_data_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '02'
    ) b 
on
    a.in_code = b.in_code
    and b.date_src = 'WIND' 
	) castTable

name: dm_fin_n.fin_gf_fi_quot_stock
querySql:
SELECT fin_inst_code,
	fin_inst_name,
	ast_type,
	mkt_type,
	stk_inr_code,
	strt_date,
	end_date,
	open_pric,
	high_pric,
	low_pric,
	clos_pric,
	clos_pric_frnt_eda,
	clos_pric_pst_eda,
	chg,
	turn,
	tr,
	pe,
	pb,
	pcf,
	pts,
	tot_equi,
	tot_mval,
	cir_equi,
	cir_mval,
	rise_fall,
	tramt,
	stat,
	data_src,
	rec_upd_time,
	modif_prsn,
	rec_down_time,
	creator,
	busi_date,
	data_remark,
	modif_date,
	modif_remark FROM (
	 select 
         base.scr_cd                                                as fin_inst_code	-- 金融工具编码
        ,base.ch_abbr                                               as fin_inst_name	-- 金融工具名称
        ,concat(coalesce(base.remark,'NONE'),'-',coalesce(stk_base.list_brd_name,'NONE'))   as ast_type	        -- 资产类型
        ,base.mkt_cd                                                as mkt_type	        -- 市场类型
        ,quot.stk_inr_code                                          as stk_inr_code	    -- 指数内部编码
        ,quot.trd_dt                                                as strt_date        -- 开始日期
        ,quot.trd_dt                                                as end_date         -- 结束日期
        ,quot.open_pric                                             as open_pric           -- 开盘价
        ,quot.high_pric                                             as high_pric           -- 最高价
        ,quot.low_pric                                              as low_pric            -- 最低价
        ,quot.clos_pric                                             as clos_pric           -- 收盘价
        ,quot_bef.clos_pric_frnt_eda                                as clos_pric_frnt_eda  -- 收盘价(前复权)
        ,quot.clos_pric_pst_eda                                     as clos_pric_pst_eda   -- 收盘价(后复权)
        ,quot.chg                                                   as chg                 -- 涨跌幅(%)
        ,quot.turn                                                  as turn                -- 成交量(股)
        ,valu_idx.tr                                                as tr                  -- 换手率
        ,valu_idx.pe                                                as pe                  -- PE市盈率
        ,valu_idx.pb                                                as pb                  -- PB市净率
        ,valu_idx.pcf                                               as pcf                 -- PCF市现率
        ,valu_idx.pts                                               as pts                 -- PS市销率
        ,valu_idx.tot_equi                                          as tot_equi            -- 总股本(股)
        ,valu_idx.tot_mval                                          as tot_mval            -- 总市值
        ,valu_idx.cir_equi                                          as cir_equi            -- 流通股本(股)
        ,valu_idx.cir_mval                                          as cir_mval            -- 流通市值
        ,quot.rise_fall                                             as rise_fall           -- 涨跌
        ,quot.tramt                                                 as tramt               -- 成交额
        ,quot.stat                                                  as stat                -- 状态	 
        ,''                                                         as data_src	           -- 数据来源
        ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')     as rec_upd_time	       -- 修改时间
        ,''                                                         as modif_prsn	       -- 修改人
        ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')     as rec_down_time	   -- 创建时间
        ,''                                                         as creator	           -- 创建人
        ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                            as busi_date	       -- 数据日期
        ,case when base.mkt_cd='BSE' then  '' else trd_way.tran_method  end          as data_remark	       -- 数据备注
        ,''                                                         as modif_date	       -- 变更日期
        ,''                                                         as modif_remark	       -- 变更标记
    from (
        select 
            secu_id         as stk_inr_code	-- 股票内部编码
            ,trd_dt         
            ,pric_open      as open_pric            -- 开盘价   
            ,pric_high      as high_pric            -- 最高价   
            ,pric_low       as low_pric             -- 最低价   
            ,pric_clos      as clos_pric            -- 收盘价   
            ,pric_adjclose  as clos_pric_pst_eda    -- 收盘价(后复权)        
            ,pct_chg        as chg                  -- 涨跌幅(%)
            ,cast(deal_vol as decimal(20, 4)) * 100   as turn  -- 成交量(股)    
            ,pric_chg       as rise_fall            -- 涨跌
            ,tnv_val_aft    as tramt                -- 成交额
            ,trd_stat       as stat                 -- 状态
       from pdata_news_n.t02_exch_quot_s
       where src_id = 'WD' and grp_id in ('01', '02', '03', '04','07')
    ) quot
    left join (
         select 
           secu_id
          ,scr_cd
          ,mkt_cd
          ,in_code
          ,ch_abbr
          ,scr_type
          ,remark
        from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'WD' 
        and MKT_CD IN ('STAS','BSE')
    ) base
    on quot.stk_inr_code = base.secu_id
    left join (
        select 
           secu_id 
          ,trd_dt
          ,pric_close_eda_bef as clos_pric_frnt_eda -- 收盘价(前复权)
        from pdata_news_n.t02_exch_quot_bef_s
        where src_id = 'WD' and grp_id = '01'
    ) quot_bef
    on quot.stk_inr_code = quot_bef.secu_id and quot.trd_dt = quot_bef.trd_dt
    left join (
        select 
            secu_id
           ,trd_dt
           ,covt_rati                   as tr          -- 换手率
           ,mval_prft_rati              as pe          -- PE市盈率
           ,mval_ast_rati               as pb          -- PB市净率
           ,mval_pcf_ocf                as pcf         -- PCF市现率
           ,mval_ps                     as pts         -- PS市销率
           ,cast(tot_equi as decimal(24, 8)) * 10000    as tot_equi    -- 总股本(股)
           ,tot_mval                    as tot_mval    -- 总市值
           ,cast(cir_equi as decimal(24, 8)) * 10000    as cir_equi    -- 流通股本(股)
           ,cir_mval                    as cir_mval    -- 流通市值
        from pdata_news_n.t02_stk_valu_idx
        where src_id  = 'WD' and grp_id in ('01','02','03','04')
    ) valu_idx
    on quot.stk_inr_code = valu_idx.secu_id and quot.trd_dt = valu_idx.trd_dt

    left join 
    
    ( select 
             
             aa.secu_id
            ,aa.scr_cd
            ,aa.abbr_name
            ,aa.scr_type
            ,aa.mkt_cd
            ,aa.crrc_cd
            ,aa.list_date
            ,aa.delist_date
            ,aa.list_brd_cd
            ,CASE WHEN aa.list_brd_name = '' THEN NULL else aa.list_brd_name END AS list_brd_name
            ,aa.shsc_flag               ----目前只有A股接入了判断是否沪深股通的字段，港股有该字段但没接入，后期记得修改
      from 
            (
             select 
             secu_id
            ,scr_cd
            ,abbr_name
            ,scr_type
            ,mkt_cd
            ,crrc_cd
            ,list_date
            ,delist_date
            ,list_brd_cd
            ,list_brd_name
            ,shsc_flag
            ,row_number()over(partition by secu_id order by grp_id) as rn 
            from pdata_news_n.t02_stk_base_info 
            where src_id = 'WD'
            ) aa where aa.rn = 1
    ) stk_base
    on base.secu_id = stk_base.secu_id

    left join 
    (
        select 
               secu_id
              ,src_sys_prdno
              ,tran_method
              ,strt_dt
              ,end_dt
        from 
        pdata_news_n.t02_stk_tran_method 
        where src_id = 'WD' and grp_id = '01'
    ) trd_way
    on quot.stk_inr_code = trd_way.secu_id
    where quot.trd_dt >= trd_way.strt_dt and quot.trd_dt < coalesce(trd_way.end_dt,'2999-12-31')
    and base.secu_id is not null AND trd_way.secu_id IS NOT NULL    ---取trd_way表可以全部关联上的股转市场、北交所的证券
UNION ALL

select 
         base.scr_cd                                                as fin_inst_code	-- 金融工具编码
        ,base.ch_abbr                                               as fin_inst_name	-- 金融工具名称
        ,concat(coalesce(base.remark,'NONE'),'-',coalesce(stk_base.list_brd_name,'NONE'))   as ast_type	        -- 资产类型
        ,base.mkt_cd                                                as mkt_type	        -- 市场类型
        ,quot.stk_inr_code                                          as stk_inr_code	    -- 指数内部编码
        ,quot.trd_dt                                                as strt_date        -- 开始日期
        ,quot.trd_dt                                                as end_date         -- 结束日期
        ,quot.open_pric                                             as open_pric           -- 开盘价
        ,quot.high_pric                                             as high_pric           -- 最高价
        ,quot.low_pric                                              as low_pric            -- 最低价
        ,quot.clos_pric                                             as clos_pric           -- 收盘价
        ,quot_bef.clos_pric_frnt_eda                                as clos_pric_frnt_eda  -- 收盘价(前复权)
        ,quot.clos_pric_pst_eda                                     as clos_pric_pst_eda   -- 收盘价(后复权)
        ,quot.chg                                                   as chg                 -- 涨跌幅(%)
        ,quot.turn                                                  as turn                -- 成交量(股)
        ,valu_idx.tr                                                as tr                  -- 换手率
        ,valu_idx.pe                                                as pe                  -- PE市盈率
        ,valu_idx.pb                                                as pb                  -- PB市净率
        ,valu_idx.pcf                                               as pcf                 -- PCF市现率
        ,valu_idx.pts                                               as pts                 -- PS市销率
        ,valu_idx.tot_equi                                          as tot_equi            -- 总股本(股)
        ,valu_idx.tot_mval                                          as tot_mval            -- 总市值
        ,valu_idx.cir_equi                                          as cir_equi            -- 流通股本(股)
        ,valu_idx.cir_mval                                          as cir_mval            -- 流通市值
        ,quot.rise_fall                                             as rise_fall           -- 涨跌
        ,quot.tramt                                                 as tramt               -- 成交额
        ,quot.stat                                                  as stat                -- 状态	 
        ,''                                                         as data_src	           -- 数据来源
        ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')     as rec_upd_time	       -- 修改时间
        ,''                                                         as modif_prsn	       -- 修改人
        ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')     as rec_down_time	   -- 创建时间
        ,''                                                         as creator	           -- 创建人
        ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                            as busi_date	       -- 数据日期
        ,case when base.mkt_cd='BSE' then  '' else trd_way.tran_method   end   as data_remark	       -- 数据备注
        ,''                                                         as modif_date	       -- 变更日期
        ,''                                                         as modif_remark	       -- 变更标记
    from (
        select 
            secu_id         as stk_inr_code	-- 股票内部编码
            ,trd_dt         
            ,pric_open      as open_pric            -- 开盘价   
            ,pric_high      as high_pric            -- 最高价   
            ,pric_low       as low_pric             -- 最低价   
            ,pric_clos      as clos_pric            -- 收盘价   
            ,pric_adjclose  as clos_pric_pst_eda    -- 收盘价(后复权)        
            ,pct_chg        as chg                  -- 涨跌幅(%)
            ,cast(deal_vol as decimal(20, 4)) * 100   as turn  -- 成交量(股)    
            ,pric_chg       as rise_fall            -- 涨跌
            ,tnv_val_aft    as tramt                -- 成交额
            ,trd_stat       as stat                 -- 状态
       from pdata_news_n.t02_exch_quot_s
       where src_id = 'WD' and grp_id in ('01', '02', '03', '04','07')
    ) quot
    left join (
         select 
           secu_id
          ,scr_cd
          ,mkt_cd
          ,in_code
          ,ch_abbr
          ,scr_type
          ,remark
        from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'WD' 
        and MKT_CD IN ('STAS','BSE')
    ) base
    on quot.stk_inr_code = base.secu_id
    left join (
        select 
           secu_id 
          ,trd_dt
          ,pric_close_eda_bef as clos_pric_frnt_eda -- 收盘价(前复权)
        from pdata_news_n.t02_exch_quot_bef_s
        where src_id = 'WD' and grp_id = '01'
    ) quot_bef
    on quot.stk_inr_code = quot_bef.secu_id and quot.trd_dt = quot_bef.trd_dt
    left join (
        select 
            secu_id
           ,trd_dt
           ,covt_rati                   as tr          -- 换手率
           ,mval_prft_rati              as pe          -- PE市盈率
           ,mval_ast_rati               as pb          -- PB市净率
           ,mval_pcf_ocf                as pcf         -- PCF市现率
           ,mval_ps                     as pts         -- PS市销率
           ,cast(tot_equi as decimal(24, 8)) * 10000    as tot_equi    -- 总股本(股)
           ,tot_mval                    as tot_mval    -- 总市值
           ,cast(cir_equi as decimal(24, 8)) * 10000    as cir_equi    -- 流通股本(股)
           ,cir_mval                    as cir_mval    -- 流通市值

      and grp_id = '06'
  ) a

    select

    from

      src_id = 'TIT'
      and grp_id = '01'
      --and trd_dt = '20260408'
  ) b on a.fi_code_u = split(b.secu_id, '\\.') [2]
  and a.r_end_date = b.lift_day
left join (
     select default.date2datekey(trd_date) as trd_date, default.date2datekey(last_trd_date) as last_trd_date,
     case when trd_flag='0' then default.date2datekey(last_trd_date) else default.date2datekey(trd_date) end as trd_date1
        from pdata_n.T99_TRD_CAL_REF where Src_Tbl='ODATA_N_RCC.U_EXCHANGEDATE' and Exch_Type_Cd='0'
)cal 
on b.trd_dt=cal.trd_date1
where  b.ref_undrl_cd   is   not   null 
	) castTable

querySql:
with bene_owner_hold_prop as( -- 1.证件号空值处理，转空字符串 -- 2.剔除空比例 -- 3.剔除空交易对手 -- 4.去重 select distinct s0.Pty_Id -- 交易对手 ,s0.Bene_Name -- 受益人/持有人 ,s0.Cert_No ,s0.Hold_Prop from( -- 受益人持股比例 select Pty_Id -- 交易对手 ,Bene_Owner_Name as Bene_Name -- 受益人 ,coalesce(Cert_No, '') as Cert_No ,Hold_Prop from pdata_n.T01_BENE_OWNER_DD_INFO where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_OIS.G_AML_BENEFICIARY' and Hold_Prop <> '' and Pty_Id <> '' and Bene_Owner_Style_Cd = '1' -- 受益所有人信息 union all -- 持有人持股比例 -- 无空比例项 select Pty_Id -- 交易对手 ,Bene_Name -- 持有人 ,coalesce(Cert_No, '') as Cert_No ,Hold_Prop from pdata_n.T01_PTY_OWSR_OVER_PROP_BENE_INFO where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_OIS.G_COUNTERPARTY_BENEFIT_OVER_LIST' and Pty_Id <> '' ) s0 ) SELECT undrl_cd, undrl_name, bene_owner_name, bene_owner_cert_no, ost_hold_prop, cutp_shor_name_hold_prop, sum_hold_prop, trd_date, busi_date FROM ( -- titans监控标的场内前十大股东持股比例+场外衍生品持有标的份额比例>0.03 select t1.upper_src_cd as undrl_cd -- 标的代码 ,t1.ch_abbr as undrl_name -- 标的名称 ,t1.Bene_Name as bene_owner_name -- 受益/持有人姓名 ,t1.Cert_No as bene_owner_cert_no -- 受益/持有人证件号 ,t3.Occp_Tot_Equi_Rati as ost_hold_prop -- 股东标的持股比例（%） -- 格式为：交易对手A(比例);
交易对手B(比例) -- 用于前端换行展示 ,concat_ws(';
', collect_list(concat(t1.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name, '(', t1.Hold_Prop, ')'))) as cutp_shor_name_hold_prop -- 交易对手简称（受益/持有人最大持有比例） ,sum(t1.otc_mval) / t2.tot_mval *100 + t3.Occp_Tot_Equi_Rati as sum_hold_prop -- 穿透汇总持有比例（%） ,default.date2datekey(default.pretradedate('${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}', 1)) as trd_date -- 交易日 ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date -- 业务日期 from( -- 场外持股市值 select undrl.upper_src_cd ,undrl.ch_abbr ,prop.Bene_Name ,prop.Cert_No ,sum(prop.Hold_Prop * mval.Dyna_Nom_Prin) as otc_mval -- 收益/持有人场外持股规模 ,prop.Hold_Prop -- 收益/持有人交易对手持有比例 ,comp.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name from( -- 监控标的清单 select ch_abbr,upper_src_cd from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_stk_bene_owsr_prop where src_id='TIT' and grp_id='01' ) undrl -- 挂钩标的存续的气囊X+收益互换合约 join( select * from pdata_n.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO where Busi_Date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Grp_Id in('01','02','03') and coalesce(Early_Term_Date, End_Pric_Date) > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and( Src_Contr_Type = 'AIRBAGX' -- 安全气囊X or Busi_Type = 'TRS' -- 收益互换 ) ) comp on undrl.upper_src_cd = comp.undrl_wd_cd join( -- 1.同名不同ID -- 空ID情况，默认取非空ID及最大持股比例，结果只返回一条 select h1.Pty_Id -- 交易对手 ,h1.Bene_Name -- 持有人 ,max(h1.Cert_No) as Cert_No ,max(h1.Hold_Prop) as Hold_Prop from bene_owner_hold_prop h1 join(select Bene_Name from bene_owner_hold_prop group by Bene_Name having count(distinct Cert_No) >= 2) h2 on h1.Bene_Name = h2.Bene_Name group by h1.Pty_Id,h1.Bene_Name union all -- 2.名-ID一对一，含空ID项 select h1.Pty_Id -- 交易对手 ,h1.Bene_Name -- 持有人 ,h1.Cert_No ,max(h1.Hold_Prop) as Hold_Prop from bene_owner_hold_prop h1 left join(select Bene_Name from bene_owner_hold_prop group by Bene_Name having count(distinct Cert_No) >= 2) h2 on h1.Bene_Name = h2.Bene_Name where h2.Bene_Name is null group by h1.Pty_Id,h1.Bene_Name,h1.Cert_No ) prop on prop.Pty_Id = comp.Cutp_Pty_Id -- 取持股规模 join( select * from pdata_n.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_ADTNL_DET where Busi_Date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and End_Pric_Date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' ) mval on comp.agt_id = mval.agt_id and comp.undrl_wd_cd = mval.undrl_wd_cd group by undrl.upper_src_cd ,undrl.ch_abbr ,prop.Bene_Name ,prop.Cert_No ,prop.Hold_Prop ,comp.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name ) t1 left join( -- 最新交易日标的市值 select src_sys_prdno ,split(src_sys_prdno, '-')[1] as S_INFO_WINDCODE ,tot_mval ,trd_dt from pdata_news_n.t02_stk_valu_idx where src_id='WD' and grp_id='01' and trd_dt = default.date2datekey(default.pretradedate('${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}', 1)) ) t2 on t1.upper_src_cd = t2.S_INFO_WINDCODE join( -- 前十大股东场内持股比例 select src_sys_prdno ,split(src_sys_prdno, '-')[1] as S_INFO_WINDCODE ,Stkhold_Name ,Occp_Tot_Equi_Rati ,end_Date from pdata_news_n.t02_co_stkhold where src_id='WD' and grp_id='01' and end_Date = default.date2datekey(date_sub(trunc(to_date('${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'), 'quarter'), 1)) -- 上季度末 ) t3 on t1.upper_src_cd = t3.S_INFO_WINDCODE and t1.Bene_Name = t3.Stkhold_Name group by t1.upper_src_cd ,t1.ch_abbr ,t1.Bene_Name ,t1.Cert_No ,t3.Occp_Tot_Equi_Rati ,t2.tot_mval having sum(t1.otc_mval) / t2.tot_mval *100 + t3.Occp_Tot_Equi_Rati > 3 ) castTable

name:
广发香港票据明细，TITANS数据源
2025.1.7:取消有效合约限制，取全量数据
2026.4.23 过滤已作废的合约 canceled
querySql:
SELECT  CAST( Holding_ID AS String ) Holding_ID ,
	 CAST( Buy_Sell AS String ) Buy_Sell ,
	 CAST( Issuer AS String ) Issuer ,
	 CAST( Guarantor AS String ) Guarantor ,
	 CAST( Notes_Type AS String ) Notes_Type ,
	 CAST( Security_Type AS String ) Security_Type ,
	 CAST( Series_Number AS String ) Series_Number ,
	 CAST( ISIN AS String ) ISIN ,
	 CAST( Issue_Party AS String ) Issue_Party ,
	 CAST( Trade_Date AS String ) Trade_Date ,
	 CAST( Settlement_Date AS String ) Settlement_Date ,
	 CAST( Maturity_Date AS String ) Maturity_Date ,
	 CAST( Duration AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Duration ,
	 CAST( Actual_Rate AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Actual_Rate ,
	 CAST( Currency AS String ) Currency ,
	 CAST( Notional_Amt AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Notional_Amt ,
	 CAST( Notional_Amt_HKD AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Notional_Amt_HKD ,
	 CAST( Day_Count_Fraction AS String ) Day_Count_Fraction ,
	 CAST( Coupon_Frequency AS String ) Coupon_Frequency ,
	 CAST( Reoffer_Rate AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Reoffer_Rate ,
	 CAST( Reoffer_Amt AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Reoffer_Amt ,
	 CAST( DVP_FOP AS String ) DVP_FOP ,
	 CAST( Inventory_Amt AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Inventory_Amt ,
	 CAST( Inventory_Amt_HKD AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Inventory_Amt_HKD ,
	 CAST( Settlement_Amt AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Settlement_Amt ,
	 CAST( Settlement_Amt_HKD AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Settlement_Amt_HKD ,
	 CAST( Client_Account_Number AS String ) Client_Account_Number ,
	 CAST( Counterparty_Name AS String ) Counterparty_Name ,
	 CAST( Rate_Type AS String ) Rate_Type ,
	 CAST( Reference_Rate AS String ) Reference_Rate ,
	 CAST( Relevant_Margin AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Relevant_Margin ,
	 CAST( Leveraged AS String ) Leveraged ,
	 CAST( Guaranteed AS String ) Guaranteed ,
	 CAST( GF_Funding_Currency AS String ) GF_Funding_Currency ,
	 CAST( GF_Funding AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) GF_Funding ,
	 CAST( Put_Call_Option AS String ) Put_Call_Option ,
	 CAST( Put_Call_Date AS String ) Put_Call_Date ,
	 CAST( Notes_Name AS String ) Notes_Name ,
	 CAST( USD_CCY AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) USD_CCY ,
	 CAST( HKD_CCY AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) HKD_CCY ,
	 CAST( Data_Time AS String ) Data_Time ,
	 CAST( Data_Src_Sys AS String ) Data_Src_Sys ,
	 CAST( GRP_ID AS String ) GRP_ID ,
	 CAST( BUSI_DATE AS String ) BUSI_DATE  FROM (
	 select 
	prd.prd_id as Holding_ID	--持仓编号
	,'Sell' as Buy_Sell	--买卖方向
	,'GF_Global_Capital' as Issuer	--发行人
	,'GF_Holdings' as Guarantor	--担保人
	,if(prd.prd_type='FundingNote',prd.prd_type,'StructureNote') as Notes_Type	--票据类型
	,prd.prd_type as Security_Type	--证券类型
	,prd.prd_inr_cd as Series_Number	--产品编号
	,prd.prd_ext_cd as ISIN	--证券编号
	,if(prd.iss_dept = 'HK_FICC','FICC',prd.iss_dept) as Issue_Party	--发行部门
	,prd.Trade_Date	--交易日
	,prd.start_date as Settlement_Date	--起息日
	,prd.end_date as Maturity_Date	--到期日
	,datediff(prd.end_date,prd.start_date) as Duration	--原始期限
	,if(RTL.Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd ='FIXED_LEG_TYPE', cast(RTL.Fix_Ratio as decimal(18,6))*100, null) as Actual_Rate --实际利率
	,prd.sett_crrc as Currency	--币种
	,prd.total_notional as Notional_Amt	--初始名义金额
	,cast(prd.total_notional*r.HKD_CCY as decimal(18,2)) as Notional_Amt_HKD	--初始名义金额折港币
	,rtl.inta_bm_cd as Day_Count_Fraction		--计息方式
	,rtl.ratio_pd as Coupon_Frequency		--付息频率
	,prd.Reoffer_Rate	--折价率
	,cast(prd.total_notional*prd.reoffer_rate/100 as decimal(18,2)) as Reoffer_Amt	--折价金额
	,'DVP' as DVP_FOP	--交割方式
	,prd.Inventory_Amt	--库存金额
	,cast(prd.inventory_amt*r.HKD_CCY as decimal(18,2)) as Inventory_Amt_HKD	--库存金额折港币
	,case when prd.prd_type='FundingNote' then prd.total_notional- prd.inventory_amt else cast(cast(prd_par_val as double)*cast(scrp_qty as double) as decimal(18,2)) end as Settlement_Amt	--发行金额
	,cast((case when prd.prd_type='FundingNote' then prd.total_notional- prd.inventory_amt else cast(prd_par_val as double)*cast(scrp_qty as double) end)*r.HKD_CCY as decimal(18,2)) as Settlement_Amt_HKD	--发行金额折港币
	,replace(trd.Cutp_Pty_Id,'TIT060-','')  as Client_Account_Number	--客户号
	,RCP.Shor_Name_Ch as Counterparty_Name	--对手名称
	,note.intr_bsc as Rate_Type	--利率类型
	,case when prd.prd_type='BOND' then '' else rtl.Undrl_Cd end as Reference_Rate	--利率基准
	,case when prd.prd_type='BOND' then '' else if(RTL.Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd ='FLOAT_LEG_TYPE', cast(RTL.Intr_Marg as decimal(18,6))*100, null) end as Relevant_Margin	--利差
	,'N' as Leveraged	--是否配资
	,'N' as Guaranteed	--是否担保
	,'' as GF_Funding_Currency	--配资币种
	,'' as GF_Funding	--配资金额
	,'' as Put_Call_Option	--期权类型
	,'' as Put_Call_Date	--期权日期
	,prd.prd_inr_cd as Notes_Name	--票据名称
	,r.USD_CCY   --折美元汇率	
	,r.HKD_CCY	--折港币汇率
	,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as Data_Time	--数据时间
	,'TITANS' as Data_Src_Sys	--数据来源系统
	,'03' as GRP_ID --业务编号
	,'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as BUSI_DATE	--业务日期
from (--产品信息主表
    select 
		prd_id
		,prd_type 
		,prd_inr_cd 
		,prd_ext_cd 
		,replace(iss_dept,'_','') as iss_dept
		,default.datekey2date(sale_date) as trade_date
		,default.datekey2date(val_date) as start_date
		,default.datekey2date(maty_date) as end_date
		,sett_crrc
		,cast(prd_tot_nom_prin as decimal(20,2)) as total_notional --产品总名义金额
		,100 as reoffer_rate
		,0 as inventory_amt
		,prd_par_val    --产品面值
		,scrp_qty       --已认购数量
     from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_info	--160750
    where src_id = 'TIT'
      and grp_id = '01'
      and prd_stat	!= 'CANCELED' --20260423：过滤已作废的合约
      --and prd_stat	 = 'EFFECTIVE' --有效合约
      and (prd_type = 'FundingNote'  --融资型条件
           or (prd_type != 'FundingNote' 
           --and book_name='OTCHK-互换-票据'  --结构型条件,20260331取消账簿名称限制。产品类型共3种，除fundingnote以外的都是structure
          ))
      and prd_inr_cd not like '%TEST%' and prd_id not in ('10009','10010','10040') --删除测试数据
) prd
left join (--产品交易流水表
    select
    	distinct Prd_Id,
    	isin,
    	src_scr_inr_cd,
    	Cutp_Pty_Id	--交易对手当事人编号
     from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_DERI_BOOK_MTCH_EVT	--160714
    where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.P_PRD_NOTES_TRADE_RECORD'
      and BUSI_DATE <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) trd on prd.Prd_Id=trd.Prd_Id and  prd.prd_inr_cd=trd.src_scr_inr_cd
left join (--note信息表，取利率类型
    select 
    	isin,
    	seq_num,
    	prd_id,
    	intr_bsc  
     from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_note_info	--160751
    where src_id = 'TIT'
      and grp_id = '01'
) note on prd.prd_inr_cd =note.seq_num and prd.prd_id=note.prd_id
left join ( --取交易对手简称
    select * 
    from PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME	--104299
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' 
    and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) RCP on trd.Cutp_Pty_Id = RCP.Pty_Id
left join ( --取内部交易流水号
            select 
                prd_id,
                inr_trd_jour_no
            from (
                   select 
                       *,row_number()over(partition by prd_id order by undrl_scr_cd desc) rnk
                    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_asset_info	--160753
                   where src_id = 'TIT'
                     and grp_id = '01'
            ) p where p.rnk = 1
) ass on prd.prd_id=ass.prd_id
left join (
    select 
    	stati_cont_desc,
    	agt_id
    from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_STATI_INFO_H	--105387
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' 
      and Agt_Stati_Info_Type_Cd = '09'
      and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
      and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) t on ass.inr_trd_jour_no=t.stati_cont_desc
LEFT JOIN (
    select 
    	swap_comp_agt_id,
    	Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd,
    	inta_bm_cd,	--计息基准代码
    	fix_ratio,	--固定利率
    	ratio_pd,	--利率周期
    	intr_marg,	--利差
    	Undrl_Cd	--标的代码
     from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO	--103942
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' 
      and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
      and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd != 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
) rtl on t.agt_id=rtl.swap_comp_agt_id
left join (--取汇率
    select n.*
    from
    (
        select 
        	Crrc_Cd,
        	cast(USD_CCY as decimal(18,4)) as USD_CCY,
        	cast(HKD_CCY as decimal(18,4)) as HKD_CCY,
        	row_number() over(partition by Crrc_Cd order by trd_date desc) rnk 
        from dm_index_n.gfhk_currency_hkd_usd_rate  --171396
        where busi_date='${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
         and trd_date <='${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) n where rnk=1
) r on prd.sett_crrc=r.Crrc_Cd 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name:
风控-香港负债数据：融资型票据
--2024.12.11 GF1融资票据新表替换
--2026.4.23 过滤已作废的合约 canceled
querySql:
SELECT Busi_Type,
	Busi_Type_Cd,
	Sys_Ord_Id,
	Inr_Ord_Id,
	Fir_Sett_Date,
	Due_Sett_Date,
	Maty_Pay_Date,
	Fin_Term,
	Remn_Term,
	 CAST( Remn_Prin AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Remn_Prin ,
	 CAST( Init_Fin_Prin AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Init_Fin_Prin ,
	Accum_Inta_Base,
	 CAST( Rate AS DECIMAL(20,6) ) Rate ,
	Rate_Type,
	Inta_Bm_Cd,
	Inta_Freq,
	Intr_Payb,
	Itpy_Method,
	Next_Intr_Paid_Date,
	Next_Intr_Paid_Intr,
	Iss_Method,
	Dept,
	Deal_No,
	Self_Trdr_Name,
	Cutp_Id,
	Cupt_Full_Name,
	Cupt_Shor_Name,
	Cupt_Bel_Org_Id,
	Cupt_Bel_Org_Full_Name,
	Cupt_Bel_Org_Shor_Name,
	Cupt_Clas,
	Cutp_Oact_Bnk_Name,
	Scr_Cd,
	Scr_Shor_Name,
	Exch_Type_Cd,
	Exch_Name,
	Adv_Trmt_Flag,
	Bren_Flag,
	Fix_Prft_Flag,
	Frgn_Flag,
	Crrc_Cd,
	Inr_Scr_Acct_Id,
	Inr_Scr_Acct_Name,
	Promis_Loan_Flag,
	Data_Time,
	Grp_Id,
	BUSI_DATE FROM (
	 select   
	Notes_Type as Busi_Type  --业务品种
    ,'' as Busi_Type_Cd   --业务品种编码
    ,Holding_ID as Sys_Ord_Id	--源系统交易编号
    ,'' as Inr_Ord_Id      --内部交易号
    ,Settlement_Date as Fir_Sett_Date 	--起息日
    ,Maturity_Date as Due_Sett_Date	--到期日
    ,Maturity_Date as Maty_Pay_Date	--到期兑付日
    ,datediff(Maturity_Date,Settlement_Date) as Fin_Term	--融资期限
    ,GREATEST(datediff(Maturity_Date,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'),0) as Remn_Term   --剩余期限
    ,Notional_Amt as Remn_Prin	    --本金金额
    ,Notional_Amt as Init_Fin_Prin     --初始融资本金
    ,'' as  Accum_Inta_Base    --累计日计息基数
    ,Actual_Rate as Rate   --年利率
    ,'' as Rate_Type  --利率类型
    ,day_count_fraction as Inta_Bm_Cd     --计息基准代码
    ,coupon_frequency as Inta_Freq   --付息频率
    ,'' as Intr_Payb    --应付利息
    ,case when coupon_frequency is not null then '分期付息' else null end as Itpy_Method  --付息方式
    ,Maturity_Date as Next_Intr_Paid_Date   --下一利息支付日
    ,'' as Next_Intr_Paid_Intr  --下一利息支付日利息
    ,Data_Src_Sys as Iss_Method   --发行方式
    ,Issue_Party as Dept    --部门
    ,Holding_ID as Deal_No  --交易编号
    ,'' as Self_Trdr_Name   --本方交易员
    ,client_account_number as Cutp_Id    --交易对手编号
    ,Counterparty_Full_Name as Cupt_Full_Name     --交易对手全称
    ,Counterparty_Name as Cupt_Shor_Name     --交易对手简称
    ,'' as Cupt_Bel_Org_Id      --交易对手所属机构编号
    ,'' as Cupt_Bel_Org_Full_Name   --交易对手所属机构全称
    ,'' as Cupt_Bel_Org_Shor_Name   --交易对手所属机构简称
    ,'' as Cupt_Clas    --交易对手分类
    ,'' as Cutp_Oact_Bnk_Name   --对手开户行
    ,ISIN as Scr_Cd   --证券代码
    ,Series_Number as Scr_Shor_Name  --证券简称
    ,'' as Exch_Type_Cd     --市场代码
    ,'' as Exch_Name    --交易所名称
    ,'' as Adv_Trmt_Flag    --提前终止标志
    ,'' as Bren_Flag    --保本标志
    ,'' as Fix_Prft_Flag    --固定收益标志
    ,'' as Frgn_Flag      --境外标志
    ,Currency as Crrc_Cd    --币种
    ,'' as Inr_Scr_Acct_Id  --内部证券账户编码
    ,'' as Inr_Scr_Acct_Name    --内部证券账户名称
    ,'' as Promis_Loan_Flag   --是否承诺性贷款
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as Data_Time	--数据时间
    ,'02' as Grp_Id     --业务编号
    ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as BUSI_DATE	--业务日期
from
(-----GF1融资型票据-------
    select   
    	trd.Holding_ID	--持仓编号
        ,trd.security_id as Series_Number	--产品编号
    	,trd.security_isin_id as ISIN	--证券编号
        ,'FundingNote' as Notes_Type	--票据类型
    	--,case when trd.legal_entity_name='GFGC_FICC' then 'FICC' else 'GM' end as Issue_Party	--发行部门
    	,case when trd.legal_entity_name = 'GFGC_FICC' then 'FICC' 
	        when  trd.legal_entity_name = 'HK_TREASURY' then 'Treasury'
	        else 'GM' 
	        end as Issue_Party	--发行部门
    	,trd.Settlement_Date 	--起息日  --case when buy_sell='Buy' then execution_settlement_date else issue_date end
    	,trd.Maturity_Date	--到期日
    	,case when type='BND' then cast(trd.coupon as decimal(18,6))  
	          when type ='FRN' then spread+ir end as Actual_Rate	--实际利率
    	,trd.security_currency as Currency	--币种
    	,cast(trd.order_notional as decimal(18,2)) as Notional_Amt	--初始名义金额
    	,replace(trd.day_count,'ACT','ACTUAL') as Day_Count_Fraction 	--计息方式	
    	,case when trd.Coupon_Frequency='Annually' then 'Annual'
	          when trd.Coupon_Frequency='Bimonthly' then 'Bi-monthly'
	          when trd.Coupon_Frequency='Semi-annual' then 'Semi-Ann'
	          when trd.Coupon_Frequency='Biennially' then 'Biennial'
	      else trd.Coupon_Frequency	end as Coupon_Frequency	--付息频率    --新表的值映射为旧表的值
    	,trd.customer as Client_Account_Number 	--客户号
    	,trd.customer as Counterparty_Name  	--对手简称
        ,trd.customer as Counterparty_Full_Name  --对手全称
        ,'GF1' as Data_Src_Sys	--数据来源系统	
    from (
        select 
            isin as security_isin_id
            ,Hld_Id as holding_id
            ,Scr_Cd as security_id
            ,case when Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd='2' then 'Sell' when Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd ='1' then 'Buy' else Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd end as buy_sell   --模型转码需转回来
            ,Note_Type_Cd as type
            ,Sub_Corp as legal_entity_name
            ,default.datekey2date(Sett_Date) as Settlement_Date
            ,default.datekey2date(Maty_Date) as Maturity_Date
            --,default.datekey2date(execution_settlement_date) as execution_settlement_date --成交结算日
            --,default.datekey2date(issue_date) as issue_date --发行日
            ,Fix_Note_Intr as coupon
            ,Scr_Crrc_Cd as security_currency
            ,case when Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd ='1' then Nom_Amt*-1  else Nom_Amt end as order_notional    --case when order_type='Buy' then notional_security_ccy*-1  else notional_security_ccy end
            ,Inta_Ba_Cd as day_count
            ,Itpy_Freq_Cd as Coupon_Frequency  
            ,Cust_Abbr as customer
            --,order_counterpart
            ,Flot_Note_Intr as usym 
            ,cast(Diff /100 as decimal(20,6)) as spread
    	from PDATA_HK.T05_HK_GM_SB_FIN_NOTE_TRD_EVT   --184197   --pdata_nds.o_img_v_trade_fn 
        where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_HCR.O_IMG_V_TRADE_FN'
        --and busi_date='${yyyy-MM-dd}'
          and Sett_Date < Maty_Date
       -- and legal_entity_name in ('GFGC','GFGC_FICC') 
       -- and acct in ('GFGC-SCN','GFGC_FICC_NOTE') 
       -- and type in ('BND','FRN') 
    ) trd 
    left join (--取标的利率
    	select
             case when scr_abbr = 'SOFRON' then 'USD.SOFR.1D'
                  when scr_abbr = 'CNH_HIBOR_3M' then 'HKD.HIBOR.3M'
                  end as scr_abbr   --与 o_img_v_trade_fn.usym 保持一致
    		 ,cast(ir as decimal(18,6)) as ir
    	from (
    		select    
    			*
    			,row_number()over(partition by scr_abbr order by trd_dt desc) rnk
    		from pdata_news_n.t02_ira_ibor 	--72351
    		where src_id = 'TL'
    		and grp_id = '01'
    		and scr_abbr in ('SOFRON','CNH_HIBOR_3M')
    		and trd_dt <=replace ('${yyyy-MM-dd}','-','')
    		) t 
    		where t.rnk=1
    ) SR on trd.usym = sr.scr_abbr

    union all

    ----TITAN融资型票据----
    select 
    	prd.prd_id as Holding_ID	--持仓编号
        ,prd.prd_inr_cd as Series_Number	--产品编号
    	,prd.prd_ext_cd as ISIN	--证券编号
        ,if(prd.prd_type='FundingNote',prd.prd_type,'StructureNote') as Notes_Type	--票据类型
    	,if(prd.iss_dept = 'HK_FICC','FICC',prd.iss_dept) as Issue_Party	--发行部门
    	,prd.start_date as Settlement_Date	--起息日
    	,prd.end_date as Maturity_Date	--到期日
    	,if(RTL.Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd ='FIXED_LEG_TYPE', cast(RTL.Fix_Ratio as decimal(18,6))*100, null) as Actual_Rate --实际利率
    	,prd.sett_crrc as Currency	--币种
    	,prd.total_notional as Notional_Amt	--名义金额
    	,upper(rtl.inta_bm_cd) as Day_Count_Fraction		--计息方式
    	,rtl.ratio_pd as Coupon_Frequency		--付息频率
    	,replace(trd.Cutp_Pty_Id,'TIT060-','')  as Client_Account_Number	--客户号
    	,RCP.Shor_Name_Ch as Counterparty_Name	--对手简称
        ,RCP.Full_Name_Ch as Counterparty_Full_Name  --对手全称
        ,'TITANS' as Data_Src_Sys	--数据来源系统
    from (--产品信息主表
        select 
    		prd_id
    		,prd_type 
    		,prd_inr_cd 
    		,prd_ext_cd 
    		,replace(iss_dept,'_','') as iss_dept
    		,default.datekey2date(val_date) as start_date
    		,default.datekey2date(maty_date) as end_date
    		,sett_crrc
    		,cast(prd_tot_nom_prin as decimal(20,2)) as total_notional --产品总名义金额
         from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_info	--160750
        where src_id = 'TIT'
          and grp_id = '01' 
          and prd_stat	!= 'CANCELED' --20260423：过滤已作废的合约
          --and prd_stat = 'EFFECTIVE' --有效合约   --2025-01-08取消限制
          and prd_type = 'FundingNote'  --融资型条件 
          and prd_inr_cd not like '%TEST%' and prd_id not in ('10009','10010','10040') --删除测试数据 20260224补充
    ) prd
    left join (--产品交易流水表
        select
        	distinct Prd_Id,
        	isin,
        	src_scr_inr_cd,
        	Cutp_Pty_Id	--交易对手当事人编号
         from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_DERI_BOOK_MTCH_EVT	--160714
        where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.P_PRD_NOTES_TRADE_RECORD'
          and BUSI_DATE <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) trd on prd.Prd_Id=trd.Prd_Id and  prd.prd_inr_cd=trd.src_scr_inr_cd
    left join ( --取交易对手简称
        select * 
        from PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME	--104299
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' 
        and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) rcp on trd.cutp_pty_id = rcp.pty_id
    left join ( --取内部交易流水号
        select 
        	prd_id,
        	inr_trd_jour_no
         from (
                   select 
                       *,row_number()over(partition by prd_id order by undrl_scr_cd desc) rnk
                    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_asset_info	--160753
                   where src_id = 'TIT'
                     and grp_id = '01'
            ) p where p.rnk = 1
    ) ass on prd.prd_id=ass.prd_id
    left join (
        select 
        	stati_cont_desc,
        	agt_id
        from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_STATI_INFO_H	--105387
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' 
          and Agt_Stati_Info_Type_Cd = '09'
          and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
          and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) t on ass.inr_trd_jour_no=t.stati_cont_desc
    LEFT JOIN (
        select 
        	swap_comp_agt_id,
        	Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd,
        	inta_bm_cd,	--计息基准代码
        	fix_ratio,	--固定利率
        	ratio_pd,	--利率周期
        	intr_marg,	--利差
        	Undrl_Cd	--标的代码
         from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_LEG_INFO	--103942
        where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS_LEG' 
          and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
          and Swap_Comp_Leg_Type_Cd != 'STRUCTURE_LEG_TYPE'
    ) rtl on t.agt_id=rtl.swap_comp_agt_id
) t 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: dm_hk_n.ref_future_properties
querySql:
SELECT key_instrument_id,
	ename,
	name,
	code,
	sccode_with_suffix,
	sccode,
	exchmarket,
	listdate,
	delistdate,
	dlmonth,
	ltdldate,
	cctype,
	contract_multiplier,
	created_datetime,
	updated_datetime,
	data_source,
	underlying_ins_id,
	type,
	price_limit,
	future_type,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 SELECT 
b.in_code    as   key_instrument_id, -- 证券内码-期货代码
get_json_object(remark,'$.STD_CONTR_ENAME')   as   ename, -- 证券英文简称
std_contr_name   as   name, -- 证券中文简称
get_json_object(remark,'$.TRD_CD')   as   code, -- 交易代码
std_contr_cd   as   sccode_with_suffix, -- 标准合约代码(带后缀）
split(std_contr_cd,'[.]')[0]   as   sccode, -- 标准合约代码
exch_abbr   as   exchmarket, -- 交易所 字典项=EXCHANGE
contr_list_date   as   listdate, -- 上市日期
last_trd_date   as   delistdate, -- 最后交易日期
get_json_object(remark,'$.DELI_MTH')   as   dlmonth, -- 交割月份
deli_date_intro   as   ltdldate, -- 最后交割日
get_json_object(remark,'$.CCTYPE')   as   cctype, -- 连续合约类型
contr_mulplr   as   contract_multiplier, -- 合约乘数
get_json_object(remark,'$.SRC_CREATE_TIME')   as   created_datetime, -- 创建时间
rec_upd_time   as   updated_datetime, -- 更新时间
get_json_object(remark,'$.SRC_DATA_SOURCE')   as   data_source, -- DATA_SOURCE
undrl_scr_cd   as   underlying_ins_id, -- 期货标的编码
get_json_object(remark,'$.TYPE')   as   type, -- 合约类型
max_pric_vola_intro   as   price_limit, -- 涨跌幅
c.src_const_cd   as   future_type, -- 期货类型
from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')   as   data_time, -- 数据时间
'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as   busi_date  -- 业务日期
FROM (
select *
from pdata_news_n.t02_fut_base_info  where 
src_id='TIT'  and  grp_id = '01'
and src_tbl = 'odata_n_tit.d_ref_future_properties') A 
left JOIN 
(select 
in_code,secu_id,src_sys_prdno 
from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'TIT') B 
ON A.secu_id = B.secu_id AND A.src_sys_prdno = B.src_sys_prdno  
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT const_cd,src_const_cd FROM pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const where const_type_cd = 'var00001' and src_id = 'TIT' ) c 
ON a.futr_type_cd  = c.const_cd 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: dm_rsk_n.futr_base_info
querySql:
SELECT secu_id,
	in_code,
	src_cd,
	ch_abbr,
	scr_en_abbr,
	std_contr_cd,
	contr_type,
	cont_contr_type,
	src_mkt_cd,
	contr_list_date,
	last_trd_date,
	deli_mth,
	deli_date,
	data_src_cd,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    a.secu_id,                  --统一证券编码
    a.in_code,                  --源内部编码
    c.src_cd,                   --来源编码
    b.ch_abbr,                  --证券简称
    a.scr_en_abbr,              --证券英文简称
    a.std_contr_cd,             --标准合约代码
    a.contr_type,               --合约类型
    a.cont_contr_type,          --连续合约类型
    b.src_mkt_cd,               --源交易市场代码
    a.contr_list_date,          --合约上市日期
    a.last_trd_date,            --最后交易日期
    a.deli_mth,                 --交割月份
    a.deli_date,                --交割日期
    'TITANS' as data_src_cd,    --数据来源系统
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${YYYY-MM-DD}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        secu_id,
        substr(src_sys_prdno,5) as in_code,
        get_json_object(remark,'$.STD_CONTR_ENAME') as scr_en_abbr,
        std_contr_cd,
        get_json_object(remark,'$.TYPE') as contr_type,
        get_json_object(remark,'$.CCTYPE') as cont_contr_type,
        default.datekey2date(contr_list_date) as contr_list_date,
        default.datekey2date(last_trd_date) as last_trd_date,
        get_json_object(remark,'$.DELI_MTH') as deli_mth,
        default.datekey2date(deli_date_intro) as deli_date
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fut_base_info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) a 
left join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        ch_abbr,
        src_mkt_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) b 
on
    a.in_code = b.in_code
left join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        src_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '02'
        and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) c
on
    b.in_code = c.in_code 
	) castTable
