name: dm_rsk_n.trd_opt_base_info_day
querySql:
SELECT secu_id,
	in_code,
	mkt_data_cd,
	ch_abbr,
	exer_way,
	sett_type,
	comp_type,
	maty_date,
	strt_trd_date,
	crrc_code,
	exer_pric,
	comp_unit,
	undrl_cd,
	undrl_name,
	data_src_cd,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    a.secu_id,                                                          --统一证券编号
    a.in_code,                                                          --源内部编码
    b.mkt_data_cd,                                                      --市场数据代码
    c.ch_abbr,                                                          --证券简称
    a.exer_way,                                                         --行权方式
    'Cash' as sett_type,                                                --结算类型
    a.comp_type,                                                        --合约类型
    a.maty_date,                                                        --到期日
    a.strt_trd_date,                                                    --开始交易日
    d.src_const_cd as crrc_code,                                        --货币代码
    a.exer_pric,                                                        --行权价格
    a.comp_unit,                                                        --合约单位
    e.src_cd as undrl_cd,                                               --标的资产代码
    f.ch_abbr as undrl_name,                                            --标的资产名称
    'TITANS' as data_src_cd,                                            --数据来源系统
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${YYYY-MM-DD}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        secu_id,
        src_sys_prdno,
        scr_in_code in_code,
        undrl_scr_in_code,
        exer_way,
        comp_type,
        substr(maty_date,1,10) maty_date,
        default.datekey2date(strt_trd_date) strt_trd_date,
        exer_pric,
        comp_unit
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_opt_base_info_tit
    where
        src_id='TIT'
        and grp_id='01'
    ) a
join
    (
    select
        src_sys_prdno,
        src_cd as mkt_data_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '02'
        and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) b 
on
    a.src_sys_prdno = b.src_sys_prdno
join
    (
    select
        src_sys_prdno,
        ch_abbr,
        crrc_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) c 
on
    b.src_sys_prdno = c.src_sys_prdno
left join
    (
    select
        const_cd,
        src_const_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const
    where
        src_id = 'TIT' 
        and const_type_cd = 'fin00001'
    ) d 
on
    c.crrc_cd = d.const_cd
left join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        src_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '02'
        and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) e 
on
    a.undrl_scr_in_code = e.in_code
left join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        ch_abbr
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) f 
on
    a.undrl_scr_in_code = f.in_code 
	) castTable

name: dm_rsk_n.crrc_mkt_intrt_base_info
querySql:
SELECT secu_id,
	in_code,
	mkt_data_cd,
	undrl_name,
	undrl_cd,
	crrc_code,
	term,
	maty_date,
	compd_intr_regu,
	compd_intr_freq,
	day_convn,
	sett_day_convn,
	work_day_adj_convn,
	month_end_regu,
	cal,
	data_src_cd,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    a.secu_id,                                                          --统一证券编码
    a.in_code,                                                          --源内部编码
    b.mkt_data_cd,                                                      --市场数据代码
    coalesce(c.undrl_name,a.ch_abbr) as undrl_name,                     --标的名称
    c.undrl_cd,                                                         --标的代码
    coalesce(c.crrc_name,d.src_const_cd) as crrc_code,                  --货币代码
    c.term,                                                             --期限
    c.maty_date,                                                        --到期日
    c.compd_intr_regu,                                                  --复利规则
    c.compd_intr_freq,                                                  --复利频率
    c.day_convn,                                                        --日算惯例
    c.sett_day_convn,                                                   --结算日惯例
    c.work_day_adj_convn,                                               --工作日调整惯例
    c.month_end_regu,                                                   --月末规则
    c.cal,                                                              --日历
    'TITANS' as data_src_cd,                                            --数据来源系统
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${YYYY-MM-DD}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        secu_id,
        in_code,
        scr_type_src,
        ch_abbr,
        crrc_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and scr_type_src = 'RATE_INDEX'
    ) a 
left join
    (
    select
        in_code,
        src_cd as mkt_data_cd
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_Info
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '02'
        and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) b 
on
    a.in_code = b.in_code
left join
    (
    select
        secu_id,
        undrl_name,
        undrl_cd,
        crrc_name,
        term,
        maty_date,
        compd_intr_regu,
        compd_intr_freq,
        day_convn,
        sett_day_convn,
        work_day_adj_convn,
        month_end_regu,
        cal
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_tit_ira_crrc_attr
    where
        src_id = 'TIT'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) c 
on
    a.secu_id = c.secu_id
left join
    (
    select 
        src_const_cd,
        const_cd
    from 
        pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const 
    where 
        src_id = 'TIT' 
        and const_type_cd = 'fin00001'
    ) d 
on
    a.crrc_cd = d.const_cd 
	) castTable

name: dm_otc_n.option_subject_view
querySql:
SELECT KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID,
	SECU_CODE,
	SECU_NAME,
	INS_LNG_DESC,
	Interotc_Underlying_Type,
	INTEROTC_UNDERLYING_CATEGORY,
	TRADING_PLACE,
	REPORT_TO,
	SECU_TYPE FROM (
	 SELECT
    T.in_code as KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID,  --标的ID
    T.wind_cd_src as SECU_CODE,  --标的代码
    T.ch_abbr as SECU_NAME,  --标的简称
    T.ch_name as INS_LNG_DESC,  --标的全称
    T2.undrl_type as Interotc_Underlying_Type,  --报价系统标的类型
    T2.undrl_minor_cate as INTEROTC_UNDERLYING_CATEGORY,  --报价系统标的小类
    T2.undrl_deal_site as TRADING_PLACE,  --报价系统标的交易场所
    case T2.rgst_site when 'TO_SSE' then '1'
                      when 'TO_SZSE' then '2'
                      when 'TO_SSE_SZSE' then '3'
                      when 'NO_REPORT' then '0'
                      else t2.rgst_site end as REPORT_TO,  --报备场所
    case c.src_const_cd when 'EQUITY' then '个股'
                        when 'FUND' then '基金'
                        when 'INDEX' then '指数'
                        when 'BULK_COMMODITY' then '大宗商品'
                        when 'PRECIOUS_METALS' then '贵金属'
                        when 'OTHER' then '其他(包括境外)'
                        else c.src_const_cd end AS SECU_TYPE  --OTC标的类型
FROM (
    select *
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) T
JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_undrl_attr
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01' and undrl_pool_code = '10000'
    ) T2
ON T.src_sys_prdno = T2.src_sys_prdno
left join (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const
    where src_id = 'TIT' and const_type_cd = 'var00575'
    ) c 
on t2.otc_undrl_type = c.const_cd 
	) castTable

name: dm_otc_n.otc_undrl_def
querySql:
SELECT  CAST( underlying_ins_id AS String ) underlying_ins_id ,
	 CAST( underlying_code AS String ) underlying_code ,
	 CAST( underlying_sht_desc AS String ) underlying_sht_desc ,
	 CAST( underlying_long_desc AS String ) underlying_long_desc ,
	 CAST( ins_family AS String ) ins_family ,
	 CAST( currency AS String ) currency ,
	 CAST( exchange_market AS String ) exchange_market ,
	 CAST( is_ssc AS String ) is_ssc ,
	 CAST( is_szsc AS String ) is_szsc ,
	 CAST( created_datetime AS String ) created_datetime ,
	per_unit FROM (
	 select 
    ri.in_code as underlying_ins_id,
    ric.src_cd as underlying_code,
    ri.ch_abbr as underlying_sht_desc,
    ri.ch_name as underlying_long_desc,
    ri.scr_type_src as ins_family,
    case when ri.crrc_cd = '156' then 'CNY'
         when ri.crrc_cd = '840' then 'USD'
         when ri.crrc_cd = '344' then 'HKD'
         when ri.crrc_cd = '978' then 'EUR'
         when ri.crrc_cd = '392' then 'JPY'
         else ri.crrc_cd end as currency,
    ri.src_mkt_cd as exchange_market,
    case rit.shhk_sc_flag when '0' then 'N'
                          when '1' then 'Y' end as is_ssc,
    case rit.szhk_sc_flag when '0' then 'N'
                          when '1' then 'Y' end as is_szsc,
    if(ri.create_time_src is not null, concat(ri.create_time_src,'.0'), null) as created_datetime,
    t.per_unit
from (
    select in_code,ch_abbr,ch_name,scr_type_src,crrc_cd,src_mkt_cd,create_time_src
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) ri
left join (
    select * from pdata_nds.ref_instrument where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) t
on t.key_instrument_id = ri.in_code
left join (
    select src_cd,in_code
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) ric
on ri.in_code = ric.in_code
left join (
    select rec_id,shhk_sc_flag,szhk_sc_flag from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_lbl
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) rit
on ri.in_code = rit.rec_id
where ri.scr_type_src in ('EQUITY', 'FUND', 'INDEX','FUTURE') and ric.src_cd is not null 
	) castTable

querySql:
SELECT ID,
	INNERCODE,
	MARKET,
	ISYMBOL,
	FUTURESINFO1,
	FUTURESINFO2,
	FUTURESINFO3,
	FUTURESINFO4,
	FUTURESINFO5,
	FUTURESINFO6,
	FUTURESINFO7,
	FUTURESINFO8,
	FUTURESINFO9,
	FUTURESINFO10,
	FUTURESINFO11,
	FUTURESINFO12,
	FUTURESINFO13,
	FUTURESINFO14,
	MEMO,
	ENTRYDATE,
	ENTRYTIME,
	FUTURESINFO15,
	CURRENCY,
	FUTURESINFO16,
	FUTURESINFO17,
	FUTURESINFO18,
	FUTURESINFO19,
	FUTURESINFO20,
	FUTURESINFO21,
	FUTURESINFO22,
	FUTURESINFO23,
	FUTURESINFO24,
	D_UPDATETIME FROM (
	 SELECT 
    a.src_rec_id ID,                      -- 流水号
    a.rec_id INNERCODE,               -- 内部编码
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.remark, '"src_mkt_cd":"([^"]*)"', 1) MARKET,                -- 市场代码
    std_contr_cd ISYMBOL,                 -- 交易代码
    std_contr_name FUTURESINFO1,            -- 交易品种
    trd_unit FUTURESINFO2,            -- 交易单位
    offr_unit FUTURESINFO3,            -- 报价单位
    sml_chg_pric FUTURESINFO4,            -- 最小变动价位
    pric_lmt_range FUTURESINFO5,            -- 涨跌停板幅度
    contr_mth_intro FUTURESINFO6,            -- 合约交割月份
    deal_time_intro FUTURESINFO7,            -- 交易时间
    last_trd_time_intro FUTURESINFO8,            -- 最后交易日
    deli_date_intro FUTURESINFO9,            -- 最后交割日
    contr_mulplr FUTURESINFO10,           -- 交割等级
    deli_site_intro FUTURESINFO11,           -- 交割地点
    low_trd_marg FUTURESINFO12,           -- 最低交易保证金
    contr_list_date FUTURESINFO13,           -- 交易手续费
    CASE 
	  WHEN deli_method_intro = '实物交割' THEN '1'
	  WHEN deli_method_intro = '现金交割' THEN '2'
	  WHEN deli_method_intro = '由卖方缴付合约指定的美元金额，而买方则缴付以最后结算价计算的人民币金额' THEN '3'
	  WHEN deli_method_intro = '实物交割——交割标的是交易所认可的交易凭证（ACE，Accumulated Certificate of Exchange），不是10盎司的实物金条。交收E-micro黄金期货合约时，买家收到（或卖家交付）一份CME清算所发行的ACE。一份ACE代表以COMEX黄金权证方式持有100（金衡）盎司金条10%的所有权。' THEN '4'
	END FUTURESINFO14,           -- 交割方式
    remark1 MEMO,                    -- 备注
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.remark, '"src_input_date":"([^"]*)"', 1) ENTRYDATE,               -- 录入日期
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.remark, '"src_input_time":"([^"]*)"', 1) ENTRYTIME,               -- 录入时间
    deal_unit FUTURESINFO15,           -- 对应指数代码
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.remark, '"src_crrc_cd":"([^"]*)"', 1) CURRENCY,                -- 币种
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.remark, '"src_futr_type_cd":"([^"]*)"', 1) FUTURESINFO16,           -- 期货品种类型
    deal_unit_peru FUTURESINFO17,           -- 合约单位量
    delist_date FUTURESINFO18,           -- 合约单位
    local_trd_date FUTURESINFO19,           -- 本地交易时间
    null FUTURESINFO20,           -- 品种密度
    comp_undrl FUTURESINFO21,           -- 合约标的
    src_offr_method FUTURESINFO22,           -- 报价方式
    src_tdy_sett_pric FUTURESINFO23,           -- 当日结算价
    src_deli_sett_pric FUTURESINFO24,           -- 交割结算价
    current_date D_UPDATETIME -- 更新时间
FROM (select * from pdata_news_n.t02_fut_base_info where src_id='CH' and grp_id='01') a
left join (select * from pdata_news_n.t02_fut_base_info_ext where src_id='CH' and grp_id='01') b
on a.rec_id = b.rec_id 
	) castTable

name: dm_fii_n.sum_otc_nation_debt_futr_pv_day
querySql:
SELECT Pv,
	Pv_Diff,
	intrt,
	busi_date FROM (
	 -- 现值逻辑：205800
select
    coalesce(m.pv,0) as Pv,  --PV
    coalesce(m.pv,0) - coalesce(n.pv,0) as Pv_Diff,  --PV差值
    b.intrt,  --利率(%)
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date  --业务日期
from (
    select  
        -sum(tt.amount_adjusted) as pv, --调整后应收付
        '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date
    from (
        select Agt_Id      KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,
                Rela_Agt_Id KEY_BOOK_ID
        from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' --	105388
        and Strt_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and End_Date >'${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) TOT
    join (
        SELECT trd_id as trade_id,Crrc_Cd as currency,Aft_Adj_Amt as amount_adjusted,
        Recv_pymt_Stat_Cd as  transfer_status,Clr_Date clearing_date
        FROM PDATA_N.T05_OTC_RECV_PYMT_EVT
        WHERE src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRANSFER'
        and Del_Flag = '0' and Recv_pymt_Stat_Cd = 'VERIFIED' 
        and Clr_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) tt on TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = tt.trade_id
    join (
        select
        Swap_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,
        substr(Cutp_Pty_Id,8) KEY_CTPTY_ID
        from pdata_n.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO
        where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS' and BUSI_DATE='${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) rt on TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = rt.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
    join (
            select  substr(Pty_Id,8) as Pty_Id, Shor_Name_Ch as short_name from PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME
            where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' and BUSI_DATE='${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            and Shor_Name_Ch = '广发全球资本FICC'
    ) cp on rt.KEY_CTPTY_ID = cp.Pty_Id
    ) m
full join (
    select  
        -sum(tt.amount_adjusted) as pv, --调整后应收付
        '${yyyy-MM-dd,-1d}' as busi_date
    from (
        select Agt_Id      KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,
                Rela_Agt_Id KEY_BOOK_ID
        from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H
        where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE' --	105388
        and Strt_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd,-1d}' and End_Date >'${yyyy-MM-dd,-1d}'
    ) TOT
    join (
        SELECT trd_id as trade_id,Crrc_Cd as currency,Aft_Adj_Amt as amount_adjusted,
        Recv_pymt_Stat_Cd as  transfer_status,Clr_Date clearing_date
        FROM PDATA_N.T05_OTC_RECV_PYMT_EVT
        WHERE src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRANSFER'
        and Del_Flag = '0' and Recv_pymt_Stat_Cd = 'VERIFIED' 
        and Clr_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd,-1d}'
    ) tt on TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = tt.trade_id
    join (
        select
        Swap_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,
        substr(Cutp_Pty_Id,8) KEY_CTPTY_ID
        from pdata_n.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO
        where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS' and BUSI_DATE='${yyyy-MM-dd,-1d}'
    ) rt on TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = rt.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
    join (
            select  substr(Pty_Id,8) as Pty_Id, Shor_Name_Ch as short_name from PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME
            where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' and BUSI_DATE='${yyyy-MM-dd,-1d}'
            and Shor_Name_Ch = '广发全球资本FICC'
    ) cp on rt.KEY_CTPTY_ID = cp.Pty_Id
    ) n

name: 权限核查_泰坦系统用户定价环境权限 to dm_ctms.tit_sys_user_pricing_rights_rt
querySql:
SELECT user_oaid,
	sys_user_name,
	org_name,
	role_name,
	menu_name,
	oper_rights,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
	 t.outside_id as user_oaid      --用户OA
	,coalesce(t.name, ' ') as sys_user_name  --用户名
	,t.dept_name as org_name       --部门
	,coalesce(t.role_name, ' ') as role_name      --角色名称
	,coalesce(pe.prcg_env_name,t.resource_id, ' ') as menu_name      --定价名称
	,case t.access_type when 'READWRITE' then '读写'
		when 'READONLY' then '只读'
		end as oper_rights    --访问类型
	,'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date  --业务日期
FROM(
	SELECT
		au.OUTSIDE_ID,
		au.NAME,
		ae.DEPT_NAME,
		AR.ROLE_NAME AS ROLE_NAME,
		ara.ACCESS_TYPE,
		ara.RESOURCE_ID,
		aur.KEY_ROLE_ID,
		ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY au.OUTSIDE_ID, ara.RESOURCE_ID, ara.ACCESS_TYPE, ar.ROLE_NAME ORDER BY au.OUTSIDE_ID ) AS rn
	FROM odata_n_tit.a_adm_user au  --63837
	LEFT JOIN odata_n_tit.a_adm_user_role aur  --63860
		ON aur.KEY_USER_ID = au.KEY_USER_ID
		and aur.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
	LEFT JOIN odata_n_tit.a_adm_role ar  --63612
		ON ar.KEY_ROLE_ID = aur.KEY_ROLE_ID
		and ar.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
	LEFT JOIN odata_n_tit.a_adm_role_access ara  --63613
		ON ara.KEY_ROLE_ID = aur.KEY_ROLE_ID
		and ara.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
	LEFT JOIN odata_n_tit.a_adm_employee ae  --174376
		ON ae.OAID = AU.OUTSIDE_ID
		and ae.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
	WHERE ara.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'PRICINGENV'
		AND ( ae.job_status IS NULL OR ae.job_status = 'CURRENT_POST' )
		and au.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
)t
left join pdata_news_n.t02_fin_prcg_env_curv pe  --226617
	on pe.rec_id = t.resource_id
	and pe.src_id = 'TIT' and pe.grp_id = '02'
WHERE t.rn = 1 
	) castTable

    ,'' as inta_regu           --计息规则
    ,a.ai_balance as inta       --应计利息
    ,a.ADJUST_VALUE            --利息调整
    ,'' as clr_spd             --清算速度
    ,'' as sett_date           --结算日期
    ,'' as real_sett_date      --实际结算日期
    ,'' as sett_method         --结算方式
    ,'' as scr_sett_date       --证券结算日期
    ,'' as ast_sett_date       --资金结算日期
    ,'' as sett_intr           --结算利息
    ,'' as sett_fee            --结算费用
    ,'' as clr_amt             --结算金额
    ,'' as sett_date_maty      --到期结算日期
    ,'' as sett_date_real_maty --实际到期结算日期
    ,'' as maty_sett_method    --到期结算方式
    ,'' as maty_scr_sett_date  --到期证券结算日期
    ,'' as maty_fnd_sett_date  --到期资金结算日期
    ,'' as maty_sett_intr      --到期结算利息
    ,'' as maty_sett_fee       --到期结算费用
    ,'' as maty_sett_amt       --到期结算金额
    ,'' as trd_plfm            --交易平台
    ,'' as trd_exec_mkt        --交易执行市场
    ,'' as trd_clrhs           --交易清算机构
    ,'' as trd_dealtype        --成交方式
    ,'' as trd_agt_id          --交易协议号
    ,'' as trd_trmt_date       --交易终止日期
    ,'' as exch_org            --交易机构
    ,'' as maty_deal_intrt     --到期交易利率
    ,'' as ext_busi_type       --外部业务类型
    ,'' as remark              --备注
    ,'' as acct_rcvb_payb_age  --应收应付款账龄
    ,'' as def1                --自定义项1
    ,'' as def2                --自定义项2
    ,'' as def3                --自定义项3
    ,'' as def4                --自定义项4
    ,'' as def5                --自定义项5
    ,'' as def6                --自定义项6
    ,'' as def7                --自定义项7
    ,'' as def8                --自定义项8
    ,'' as def9                --自定义项9
    ,'' as def10               --自定义项10
    ,'' as last_modif_time     --最后修改时间
    ,'' as last_modif_user     --最后修改人
    ,'' as creat_time          --创建时间
    ,'' as creat_user          --创建人   
    ,'' as data_remark  --数据备注
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as modif_date --变更日期
    ,'' as modif_flag --变更标记
    ,'TIT' as data_src --数据来源
    ,a.busi_date --数据日期
from     
(select  
  default.datekey2date(p.val_date) busi_date,--产品起息日
  concat('HK' ,e.src_scr_inr_cd) stock_code,
  '11' exchange_type,  
  if(p.prd_type='AMCNote','602600000011','602600000010') account_num,
  if(p.prd_type='AMCNote','CIV:20','CIV:PJFX') busi_type,
  p.sett_crrc crrc_code,
  0 business_price,
  e.mtch_vol business_amount,
  e.mtch_amt clear_balance,
  p.prd_tot_nom_prin business_balance,
  if(p.prd_type='AMCNote',0,p.prd_tot_nom_prin-e.mtch_amt) ADJUST_VALUE,
  p.prd_par_val PAR_VALUE,
  0 as AI_BALANCE
from (select * from  PDATA_N.T05_OTC_DERI_BOOK_MTCH_EVT
where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.P_PRD_NOTES_TRADE_RECORD')  e
inner join (select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_info
where src_id = 'TIT' 
and grp_id = '01'
and val_date between '${yyyyMMdd,-2d}' and '${yyyyMMdd}')  P
on e.src_scr_inr_cd=p.prd_inr_cd
union all
select
  t.busi_date busi_date,
  t.prd_inr_cd stock_code,
  '11' exchange_type,  
  if(t.BUSI_FLAG='CIV:FZLXJT','602600000011','602600000010') account_num,
  t.BUSI_FLAG busi_type,
  t.sett_crrc crrc_code,
  0 business_price,
  0 business_amount,
  t.LX clear_balance,
  t.LX business_balance,
  0 ADJUST_VALUE,
  0 PAR_VALUE,
  t.LX AI_BALANCE
 from (
 select 
     concat('HK',p.prd_inr_cd) prd_inr_cd,
     p.sett_crrc,
     TV.busi_date busi_date, 
      if(p.prd_type='AMCNote','CIV:FZLXJT','CIV:PJLXJT') BUSI_FLAG,
      round(abs(coalesce(last_lx,0)-lx),2) LX
   from (select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_info
     where src_id = 'TIT' 
     and grp_id = '01'
	 --and  prd_stat='EFFECTIVE'
       and prd_inr_cd<>'TESTTEST'   --and   instr(lower(prd_inr_cd),'new')=0
       and prd_type in ('AMCNote','FundingNote')
	   
     ) p 
     inner join (select distinct prd_id,inr_trd_jour_no from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_asset_info
     where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01' ) AI
     on p.prd_id=ai.prd_id 
     inner join (
     select CONTRACTCODE,
     substr(BUSIDATE,1,10) as busi_date,
     cast(coalesce(FIXEDUNPNL ,0) as double)+cast(coalesce(FLOATUNPNL ,0) as double ) as lx ,
     lag(cast(coalesce(FIXEDUNPNL ,0) as double)+cast(coalesce(FLOATUNPNL ,0) as double )) over (partition by CONTRACTCODE order by substr(BUSIDATE,1,10)) as last_lx 
     from PDATA_NDS.FIN_TRS_PLREPORT
      where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and substr(BUSIDATE,1,10) between '${yyyy-MM-dd,-3d}' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and nvl(BOOK_DEPARTMENT,'OTC') like '%_HK'  
      and BOOKNAME  in ('OTCHK-互换-票据','OTCHK-产品-票据')
      
      ) tv
     on  ai.inr_trd_jour_no=tv.CONTRACTCODE
     where default.datekey2date(p.maty_date)>tv.busi_date
     and tv.busi_date between '${yyyy-MM-dd,-2d}' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}' --刷近三天数据
     and tv.busi_date between default.datekey2date(p.sale_date) and default.datekey2date(p.maty_date)
   ) t
   where  cast(LX  as  decimal(38,4))<>0.0000
   )a
   inner join (select * from pdata_nds.y_bd_acc_fi_int where status='ENABLE' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'>=open_date and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'<cancel_date)  acc
  on acc.ACC_CODE=a.account_num 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: odata_n_tit.d_v_greeks_pricing_rm 风控视图-子交易希腊值明细数据
querySql:
SELECT rec_id,
	src_sys_prdno,
	deal_this_fn,
	sale_prsn_name,
	trdr,
	undrl_cd,
	deal_set,
	opt,
	deal_det_info,
	crrc_cd,
	deal_type,
	nom,
	deal_cutp_abbr,
	nom_prin,
	deal_stat,
	deal_remn_date,
	prd_crrc,
	deal_no,
	hld_pos_pos,
	exer_pric,
	join_code,
	cms,
	deal_sub_type,
	comp_major_minor,
	cusipcode,
	undrl_pd_pric,
	deal_pric,
	opt_encb_val,
	deal_set_id,
	deal_set_name,
	swap_contr_name,
	transcn_dir,
	deal_set_type,
	deal_cutp,
	nom_val,
	exch_no,
	deal_fee_crrc,
	undrl_exch_code,
	intr,
	pric,
	net_now_val,
	cash_delta,
	delta,
	delta_pct,
	gamma,
	gamma_pct,
	theta,
	theta_pct,
	vega,
	vega_pct,
	impl_vola,
	undrl_fwd_exec_pric,
	undrl_spot_pric,
	accr_base,
	pric_base,
	npv_base,
	cash_delta_base,
	delta_base,
	delta_pct_base,
	gamma_base,
	gamma_pct_base,
	theta_base,
	theta_pct_base,
	vega_base,
	vega_pct_base,
	impliedvolatility_base,
	undrl_fwd_price_base,
	undrl_spot_base,
	mstk_code,
	trgr_type,
	prd_ext_type,
	digit_down_rate,
	digit_up_rate,
	digit_montr_fqcy,
	prd_no,
	now_vall,
	knocked_in_flag,
	knocked_in_dt,
	correl_val,
	vola,
	cega,
	rho_r,
	rho_q,
	rho_rf,
	vega_fx,
	delta_fx,
	rho_q_base,
	cega_base,
	dept_no,
	remark,
	src_tbl,
	src_rec_id,
	rec_upd_time,
	rec_down_time,
	src_id,
	grp_id,
	busi_date FROM (
	 SELECT
     rioi.Sub_Trd_Id                                            as rec_id                           -- 记录编号
    ,concat('TIT-',nvl(rioi.Src_Prd_Cd_Shor_Name, ri.ch_abbr))  as src_sys_prdno                    -- 源系统产品编号
    ,PECM.Book_Agt_Name                                         as deal_this_fn                     -- 交易本全称
    ,''                                                         as sale_prsn_name                   -- 销售人员名称
    ,''                                                         as trdr                             -- 交易员
    ,code.src_cd                                                as undrl_cd                         -- 标的代码
    ,''                                                         as deal_set                         -- 交易集合
    ,''                                                         as opt                              -- 期权
    ,''                                                         as deal_det_info                    -- 交易明细信息
    ,'156'                                                      as crrc_cd                          -- 货币代码
    ,CASE rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd WHEN 'AUTOCALL' THEN 'ScriptableOTCProduct'
                                   WHEN 'RANGE_ACCRUAL' THEN 'ScriptableOTCProduct'
                                   ELSE 'EquityStructuredOption' END   
                                                                as deal_type                        -- 交易类型
    ,rioi.Prin                                                  as nom                              -- 名义本金(小数点保留两位)
    ,opt.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name                                     as deal_cutp_abbr                   -- 交易对手简称
    ,''                                                         as nom_prin                         -- 名义本金
    ,coalesce(d.SRC_CD_VAL,rioi.Trd_Stat_Cd)                    as deal_stat                        -- 交易状态
    ,''                                                         as deal_remn_date                   -- 交易剩余日期
    ,''                                                         as prd_crrc                         -- 产品货币
    ,rioi.Sub_Trd_Id                                            as deal_no                          -- 交易编号
    ,rioi.Qty                                                   as hld_pos_pos                      -- 持仓头寸
    ,''                                                         as exer_pric                        -- 行权价
    ,opt.Inr_Ord_Id                                             as join_code                        -- 关联编码
    ,''                                                         as cms                              -- 手续费
    ,CASE WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'VANILLA' THEN 'European' 
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'SINGLE_BARRIER' THEN 'BARRIER'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'DOUBLE_BARRIER' THEN 'BARRIER'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'DOUBLE_BARRIER_WITH_REBATE' THEN 'BARRIER'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'DIGITAL' THEN 'DIGITAL'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'DOUBLE_DIGITAL' THEN 'DIGITAL'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'RANGE_ACCRUAL' THEN 'EquityDRAPlus'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_CALL_SNOWBALLX' THEN 'Equity AutocallX'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_CALL_SNOWBALL' THEN 'EquityAutocallCoupKO'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_CALL_SNOWBALLNONCONSTANT' THEN 'EquityAutocallXNonConstant'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_CALL_PHOENIX' THEN 'EquityAutocallCoupKO'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_PUT_SNOWBALLX' THEN 'Equity AutocallX'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_PUT_SNOWBALL' THEN 'Equity AutocallX'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_PUT_SNOWBALLNONCONSTANT' THEN 'EquityAutocallXNonConstant'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_PUT_PHOENIX' THEN 'EquityAutocallCoupKO'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' AND rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL_CALL_LIZARD' THEN 'AUTOCALL_CALL_LIZARD'
          WHEN rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' THEN rioi.Opt_Comp_Sub_Trd_Type_Cd END
                                                                as deal_sub_type                    -- 交易子类
    ,''                                                         as comp_major_minor                 -- 合约大小
    ,''                                                         as cusipcode                        -- CUSIP编码
    ,null                                                       as undrl_pd_pric                    -- 标的既期价
    ,null                                                       as deal_pric                        -- 交易价格
    ,''                                                         as opt_encb_val                     -- 期权障碍值
    ,'0'                                                        as deal_set_id                      -- 交易集合id
    ,''                                                         as deal_set_name                    -- 交易集合名称
    ,''                                                         as swap_contr_name                  -- 线性互换合同名称
    ,CASE WHEN rioi.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '1' THEN 'BUY' 
          WHEN rioi.Buy_Sell_Dir_Cd = '2' THEN 'SELL' END       as transcn_dir                      -- 买卖方向
    ,''                                                         as deal_set_type                    -- 交易集合类型
    ,opt.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name                                     as deal_cutp                        -- 交易对手
    ,''                                                         as nom_val                          -- 设定价值
    ,''                                                         as exch_no                          -- 交易所编号
    ,''                                                         as deal_fee_crrc                    -- 交易费货币
    ,''                                                         as undrl_exch_code                  -- 标的交易所编码
    ,''                                                         as intr                             -- 利息
    ,null                                                       as pric                             -- 价格
    ,null                                                       as net_now_val                      -- 净现值
    ,''                                                         as cash_delta                       -- Delta现价
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
         ELSE ROUND(PEPV.DELTA / if(cast(PECM.Fxr_Rate as double) = 0,NULL,PECM.Fxr_Rate), 0)
         END as string)                                         as delta                            -- Delta=期权价格变化/标的资产价格变化
    ,PEPV.DELTA_PCT                                             as delta_pct                        -- Delta百分比
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN rioi.Trgr_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN KO_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(PEPV.GAMMA, 0)
          END as string)                                        as gamma                            -- Gamma=Delta 的变化与标的资产价格变化的比率
    ,PEPV.GAMMA_PCT                                             as gamma_pct                        -- Gamma百分比
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN rioi.Trgr_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN KO_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          ELSE PEPV.THETA END as string)                        as theta                            -- Theta=期权价格变化/到期时间变化
    ,PEPV.THETAPCT                                              as theta_pct                        -- Theta百分比
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN rioi.Trgr_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN KO_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          ELSE PEPV.VEGA END as string)                         as vega                             -- Vega=期权价格变化/波动率的变化
    ,PEPV.VEGA_PCT                                              as vega_pct                         -- Vega百分比
    ,cast(round(Mioem.Vola * 100, 5) as string)                  as impl_vola                        -- 隐含波动率
    ,''                                                         as undrl_fwd_exec_pric              -- 标的远期执行价
    ,''                                                         as undrl_spot_pric                  -- 标的即期价
    ,''                                                         as accr_base                        -- 应计基础
    ,null                                                       as pric_base                        -- 价格基准
    ,null                                                       as npv_base                         -- 净现值基准
    ,''                                                         as cash_delta_base                  -- Delta现价基准
    ,PEPV.DELTA                                                 as delta_base                       -- Delta基准
    ,null                                                       as delta_pct_base                   -- Delta百分比基准
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN rioi.Trgr_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN KO_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          ELSE ROUND(PEPV.GAMMA * PECM.Fxr_Rate, 0)
          END as string)                                        as gamma_base                       -- Gamma基准
    ,''                                                         as gamma_pct_base                   -- Gamma百分比基准
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN rioi.Trgr_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN KO_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          ELSE PEPV.THETA END * PECM.Fxr_Rate as string)        as theta_base                       -- Thela基准
    ,''                                                         as theta_pct_base                   -- Theta百分比基准
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN rioi.Trgr_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          WHEN KO_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date <= substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          ELSE PEPV.VEGA END * PECM.Fxr_Rate as string)         as vega_base                        -- Vega基准
    ,''                                                         as vega_pct_base                    -- Vega百分比基准
    ,null                                                       as impliedvolatility_base           -- 隐含基准
    ,''                                                         as undrl_fwd_price_base             -- 隐含远期价格基准
    ,''                                                         as undrl_spot_base                  -- 隐含即期基准
    ,''                                                         as mstk_code                        -- 错误编码
    ,CASE rioi.Trgr_Line_Type_Cd WHEN 'DOT' THEN 'DOT'
                                 WHEN 'DNT' THEN 'DNT'
                                 ELSE NULL END                  as trgr_type                        -- 触发类型
    ,'NONE'                                                     as prd_ext_type                     -- 产品拓展类型
    ,if(rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'DIGITAL', rioi.Down_Encb_Val, NULL)
                                                                as digit_down_rate                  -- 数字降频率
    ,if(rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'DIGITAL', rioi.Up_Encb_Val, NULL)
                                                                 as digit_up_rate                    -- 数字上升速率
    ,if(rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'DIGITAL', rioi.Obsv_Way_Cd, NULL)
                                                                 as digit_montr_fqcy                 -- 数字监控频率
    ,nvl(rioi.Src_Prd_Cd_Shor_Name, ri.ch_abbr)                 as prd_no                           -- 产品编号
    ,cast(CASE WHEN NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) = substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) THEN 0
          ELSE ROUND(PEPV.PV, 0)
          END as string)                                        as now_vall                         -- 现值
    ,case when rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' and KI_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date IS NOT NULL then '1'
          when rioi.Src_Scr_Sub_Type_Cd = 'AUTOCALL' then ''
          END                                                   as knocked_in_flag                  -- 敲入标志（0否1是）
    ,KI_BARRIER.Trgr_Line_Date                                  as knocked_in_dt                    -- 敲入日期
    ,RCI.CORRELATION_VALUE                                      as correl_val                       -- 相关性数值
    ,cast(round(Mioem.Fx_Vola * 100, 5) as string)              as vola                             -- 波动率
    ,PEPV.CEGA                                                  as cega                             -- CEGA
    ,MIOEM.Rho_R                                                as rho_r                            -- RHO_R
    ,PEPV.RHO_Q                                                 as rho_q                            -- RHO_Q
    ,PEPV.RHO_RF                                                as rho_rf                           -- RHO_RF
    ,PEPV.VEGA_FX                                               as vega_fx                          -- VEGA_FX
    ,PEPV.DELTA_FX                                              as delta_fx                         -- DELTA_FX
    ,cast(PEPV.RHO_Q * PECM.Fxr_Rate as string)                 as rho_q_base                       -- rho_q(本币)  --20231212 wxzhengziyang 新增字段
    ,cast(PEPV.CEGA * PECM.Fxr_Rate as string)                  as cega_base                        -- cega(本币)   --20231212 wxzhengziyang 新增字段
    ,opt.Book_Bel_Dept                                          as dept_no                          -- 所属部门
    ,''                                                         as remark                           -- 备注
    ,'odata_n_tit.d_v_greeks_pricing_rm'                        as src_tbl                          -- 来源表
    ,''                                                         as src_rec_id                       -- 来源记录
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as rec_upd_time                     -- 记录修改时间
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as rec_down_time                    -- 记录创建时间
    ,'TIT'                                                      as src_id                           -- 来源标识
    ,'01'                                                       as grp_id                           -- 并行标识
    ,Mioem.BUSI_DATE                                            as busi_date                        -- 数据日期
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_SUB_TRD_PRCG_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_MKT_INS_OP_EOD_METRIC'
        and busi_date between default.pretradedate(date_sub('${yyyy-MM-dd}',-1),2) and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) Mioem
JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_INS_OPTION_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and Trd_Stat_Cd NOT IN ('411', '141')
    ) rioi
ON rioi.Prd_Id = Mioem.Prd_Id
JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and Rep_Risk_Flag = '1' 
    ) opt
ON rioi.Opt_ComP_Agt_Id = opt.Opt_ComP_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        Prd_Id,
        Trgr_Line_Date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Prd_Id,
            Trgr_Line_Date,
            ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY Prd_Id ORDER BY Trgr_Line_Date) as RN
        FROM PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BARR_LINE_INFO
        WHERE src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_BARRIER_LINE' and Encb_Type_Cd IN ('UO', 'DO')
            AND Barr_Line_Type_Cd IN ('SINGLE_BARRIER', 'UP_BARRIER', 'DOWN_BARRIER', 'CALLABLE_TRIGGER')
            AND Barr_Line_Eff_Date IS NOT NULL
        ) t
    WHERE RN = 1
    ) KO_BARRIER
ON KO_BARRIER.Prd_Id = Mioem.Prd_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT Prd_Id, Trgr_Line_Date FROM PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BARR_LINE_INFO
    WHERE src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_BARRIER_LINE' and Barr_Line_Type_Cd = 'KI_BARRIER' AND Encb_Type_Cd = 'DI' AND Barr_Line_Eff_Date IS NOT NULL
    ) KI_BARRIER
ON KI_BARRIER.Prd_Id = Mioem.Prd_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_NDS.POS_EOD_POSITION_VIEW
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) PEPV
ON MIOEM.BUSI_DATE = substr(PEPV.src_busi_date,1,10) AND MIOEM.Src_Prd_Id = PEPV.KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID AND opt.Book_Agt_Id = PEPV.KEY_BOOK_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) code
on rioi.Undrl_Cd = code.src_sys_prdno
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) RINS
ON RINS.src_sys_prdno = RIOI.Undrl_Cd
left join (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const where src_id = 'TIT' and const_type_cd = 'fin00001'
    ) b
on RINS.crrc_cd = b.const_cd
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        default.datekey2date(x.trd_dt) as AS_OF,  -- 日期
        x.val as CORRELATION_VALUE,  --相关性值
        XRI.src_cd AS XCODE,  -- 标的代码
        YRI.src_cd AS YCODE  --币种代码
    FROM (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_oth_corre_fctr
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
        ) x
    JOIN (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
        ) XRI
    ON XRI.in_code = x.fctr_x
    JOIN (
        select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
        ) YRI
    ON YRI.in_code = x.fctr_y
    ) RCI
ON MIOEM.BUSI_DATE = RCI.AS_OF AND RCI.XCODE = RINS.wind_cd_src AND RCI.YCODE = concat(b.src_const_cd, 'CNY.EX')
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) ri
ON ri.src_sys_prdno = rioi.Prd_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS'
    ) PECM 
ON RIOI.Comp_Prd_Id = PECM.Prd_Id AND MIOEM.BUSI_DATE = PECM.BUSI_DATE
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
    WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_INFO'
        AND TGT_TAB_FLD = 'Trd_Stat_Cd'
        AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'REF_INS_OPTION_INFO'
        AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'TRADE_STATUS'
        AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
    ) D
ON rioi.Trd_Stat_Cd = D.DW_CD_VAL                  --TRADE_STATUS 转码
WHERE (NVL(opt.Erly_Trmt_Date,opt.End_Prcg_Date) >= Mioem.BUSI_DATE OR rioi.Maty_Date IS NULL)
    AND Mioem.Prcg_Env_Id = case opt.Book_Bel_Dept when 'OTC_HK' then '10034' when 'GFS_FICC' then '10029' else '10000' end

UNION ALL 
select
     m.Src_Prd_Id                                               as rec_id                           -- 记录编号
    ,concat('TIT-',m.Prd_Shor_Name)                             as src_sys_prdno                    -- 源系统产品编号
    ,m.Book_Agt_Name                                            as deal_this_fn                     -- 交易本全称
    ,''                                                         as sale_prsn_name                   -- 销售人员名称
    ,''                                                         as trdr                             -- 交易员
    ,m.Undrl_Cd                                                 as undrl_cd                         -- 标的代码
    ,''                                                         as deal_set                         -- 交易集合
    ,''                                                         as opt                              -- 期权
    ,m.Prd_Shor_Name                                            as deal_det_info                    -- 交易明细信息
    ,case when m.Undrl_Crrc_Cd = 'CNY' then '156' 
          ELSE m.Undrl_Crrc_Cd END                              as crrc_cd                          -- 货币代码
    ,m.Src_Prd_Cate_Cd                                          as deal_type                        -- 交易类型
    ,'0'                                                        as nom                              -- 名义本金(小数点保留两位)
    ,''                                                         as deal_cutp_abbr                   -- 交易对手简称
    ,''                                                         as nom_prin                         -- 名义本金
    ,''                                                         as deal_stat                        -- 交易状态
    ,null                                                       as deal_remn_date                   -- 交易剩余日期
    ,m.Undrl_Crrc_Cd                                            as prd_crrc                         -- 产品货币
    ,m.Src_Prd_Id                                               as deal_no                          -- 交易编号
    ,m.Vol                                                      as hld_pos_pos                      -- 持仓头寸
    ,null                                                       as exer_pric                        -- 行权价
    ,c.src_cd                                                   as join_code                        -- 关联编码
    ,null                                                       as cms                              -- 手续费
    ,null                                                       as deal_sub_type                    -- 交易子类
    ,null                                                       as comp_major_minor                 -- 合约大小
    ,null                                                       as cusipcode                        -- CUSIP编码
    ,m.Undrl_Pric                                               as undrl_pd_pric                    -- 标的既期价
    ,m.Pric                                                     as deal_pric                        -- 交易价格
    ,null                                                       as opt_encb_val                     -- 期权障碍值
    ,'0'                                                        as deal_set_id                      -- 交易集合id
    ,null                                                       as deal_set_name                    -- 交易集合名称
    ,null                                                       as swap_contr_name                  -- 线性互换合同名称
    ,case m.Long_Shor_Clas when 'LONG' then 'BUY'
                           when 'SHORT' then 'SELL' end         as transcn_dir                      -- 买卖方向
    ,null                                                       as deal_set_type                    -- 交易集合类型
    ,null                                                       as deal_cutp                        -- 交易对手
    ,null                                                       as nom_val                          -- 设定价值
    ,null                                                       as exch_no                          -- 交易所编号
    ,null                                                       as deal_fee_crrc                    -- 交易费货币
    ,null                                                       as undrl_exch_code                  -- 标的交易所编码
    ,null                                                       as intr                             -- 利息
    ,m.Pric                                                     as pric                             -- 价格
    ,m.Npv                                                      as net_now_val                      -- 净现值
    ,null                                                       as cash_delta                       -- Delta现价
    ,m.Delta                                                    as delta                            -- Delta=期权价格变化/标的资产价格变化
    ,m.Delta_Pct                                                as delta_pct                        -- Delta百分比
    ,m.Gamma                                                    as gamma                            -- Gamma=Delta 的变化与标的资产价格变化的比率
    ,null                                                       as gamma_pct                        -- Gamma百分比
    ,m.Theta                                                    as theta                            -- Theta=期权价格变化/到期时间变化
    ,null                                                       as theta_pct                        -- Theta百分比
    ,m.Vega                                                     as vega                             -- Vega=期权价格变化/波动率的变化
    ,null                                                       as vega_pct                         -- Vega百分比
    ,m.Vola                                                     as impl_vola                        -- 隐含波动率
    ,null                                                       as undrl_fwd_exec_pric              -- 标的远期执行价
    ,null                                                       as undrl_spot_pric                  -- 标的即期价
    ,null                                                       as accr_base                        -- 应计基础
    ,m.Pric                                                     as pric_base                        -- 价格基准
    ,m.Npv                                                      as npv_base                         -- 净现值基准
    ,null                                                       as cash_delta_base                  -- Delta现价基准
    ,m.Delta                                                    as delta_base                       -- Delta基准
    ,m.Delta_Pct                                                as delta_pct_base                   -- Delta百分比基准
    ,m.Gamma                                                    as gamma_base                       -- Gamma基准
    ,null                                                       as gamma_pct_base                   -- Gamma百分比基准
    ,m.Theta                                                    as theta_base                       -- Thela基准
    ,null                                                       as theta_pct_base                   -- Theta百分比基准
    ,m.Vega                                                     as vega_base                        -- Vega基准
    ,null                                                       as vega_pct_base                    -- Vega百分比基准
    ,m.Vola                                                     as impliedvolatility_base           -- 隐含基准
    ,null                                                       as undrl_fwd_price_base             -- 隐含远期价格基准
    ,null                                                       as undrl_spot_base                  -- 隐含即期基准
    ,null                                                       as mstk_code                        -- 错误编码
    ,null                                                       as trgr_type                        -- 触发类型
    ,'NONE'                                                     as prd_ext_type                     -- 产品拓展类型
    ,null                                                       as digit_down_rate                  -- 数字降频率
    ,null                                                       as digit_up_rate                    -- 数字上升速率
    ,null                                                       as digit_montr_fqcy                 -- 数字监控频率
    ,m.Prd_Shor_Name                                            as prd_no                           -- 产品编号
    ,m.PV                                                       as now_vall                         -- 现值
    ,null                                                       as knocked_in_flag                  -- 敲入标志（0否1是）
    ,null                                                       as knocked_in_dt                    -- 敲入日期
    ,null                                                       as correl_val                       -- 相关性数值
    ,null                                                       as vola                             -- 波动率
    ,m.Cega                                                     as cega                             -- CEGA
    ,null                                                       as rho_r                            -- RHO_R
    ,m.Rho_Q                                                    as rho_q                            -- RHO_Q
    ,m.Rho_Rf                                                   as rho_rf                           -- RHO_RF
    ,m.Vega_Fx                                                  as vega_fx                          -- VEGA_FX
    ,m.Delta_Fx                                                 as delta_fx                         -- DELTA_FX
    ,m.Rho_Q                                                    as rho_q_base                       -- rho_q(本币)  --20231212 wxzhengziyang 新增字段
    ,m.Cega                                                     as cega_base                        -- cega(本币)   --20231212 wxzhengziyang 新增字段
    ,RB.Bel_Dept                                                as dept_no                          -- 所属部门
    ,''                                                         as remark                           -- 备注
    ,'odata_n_tit.d_v_greeks_pricing_rm'                        as src_tbl                          -- 来源表
    ,''                                                         as src_rec_id                       -- 来源记录
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as rec_upd_time                     -- 记录修改时间
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as rec_down_time                    -- 记录创建时间
    ,'TIT'                                                      as src_id                           -- 来源标识
    ,'01'                                                       as grp_id                           -- 并行标识
    ,m.busi_date                                                as busi_date                        -- 数据日期
from (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_TIT_DAY_HOLD_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_EOD_CALC_METRICS' and Src_Prd_Cate_Cd = 'LISTEDOPTION'
        and busi_date between default.pretradedate(date_sub('${yyyy-MM-dd}',-1),2) and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) m
join (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) c
on m.Prd_id = c.src_sys_prdno
join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Rep_Risk_Flag = '1'
    ) RB 
ON M.Book_Agt_Id = RB.Book_Agt_Id 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: odata_n_tit.d_v_risk_option_cross_metric 风控视图-多标的期权日终定价cross指标表
querySql:
SELECT busi_date,
	rec_id,
	secu_id,
	src_sys_prdno,
	scr_incd,
	src_busi_date,
	wind_cd_x,
	undrl_abbr_x,
	wind_cd_y,
	undrl_abbr_y,
	undrl_bgng_pric,
	undrl_clos_pric,
	undrl_clos_pric_date,
	vola_dot,
	comp_no,
	deal_no,
	DELTA,
	VEGA,
	RHO_Q,
	UNIT_DELTA,
	UNIT_VEGA,
	GAMMA,
	UNIT_GAMMA,
	CEGA,
	CORR,
	remark,
	src_tbl,
	src_rec_id,
	rec_upd_time,
	rec_down_time,
	src_id,
	grp_id FROM (
	 SELECT
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                                as busi_date               --数据日期                                                                                       
    ,''                                                            as rec_id                  --记录编号                                                                 
    ,r.secu_id                                                     as secu_id                 --统一证券编号                                                                         
    ,PECM.Prd_Id                                                   as src_sys_prdno           --源系统产品编号                                                                                                        
    ,PECM.Src_Prd_Id                                               as scr_incd                --证券内码                                                                                    
    ,default.date2datekey(PECM.BUSI_DATE)                          as src_busi_date           --源业务日期                                                                                     
    ,code_X.src_cd                                                 as wind_cd_x               --x标的WIND代码                                                                               
    ,code_X.ch_abbr                                                as undrl_abbr_x            --x标的简称                                                                                 
    ,code_Y.src_cd                                                 as wind_cd_y               --y标的WIND代码                                                                               
    ,code_Y.ch_abbr                                                as undrl_abbr_y            --y标的简称                                                                                 
    ,''                                                            as undrl_bgng_pric         --标的期初价                                                                          
    ,''                                                            as undrl_clos_pric         --标的收市价                                                                          
    ,''                                                            as undrl_clos_pric_date    --标的收市价日期                                                                               
    ,''                                                            as vola_dot                --波动率点（定价使用）                                                                   
    ,opt.Inr_Ord_Id                                                as comp_no                 --合约编号                                                                                   
    ,PECM.Sub_Trd_Id                                               as deal_no                 --交易编号                                                                          
    ,''                                                            as DELTA                   --DELTA                                                                
    ,''                                                            as VEGA                    --VEGA                                                               
    ,''                                                            as RHO_Q                   --RHO_Q                                                                
    ,''                                                            as UNIT_DELTA              --UNIT_DELTA                                                                     
    ,''                                                            as UNIT_VEGA               --UNIT_VEGA                                                                    
    ,PECM.GAMMA                                                    as GAMMA                   --GAMMA                                                                     
    ,PECM.UNIT_GAMMA                                               as UNIT_GAMMA              --UNIT_GAMMA                                                                              
    ,PECM.CEGA                                                     as CEGA                    --CEGA                                                                   
    ,PECM.CORR                                                     as CORR                    --CORR                                                                   
    ,''                                                            as remark                  --备注                                                                 
    ,'odata_n_tit.d_v_risk_option_cross_metric'                    as src_tbl                 --来源表                                                                                                          
    ,''                                                            as src_rec_id              --来源记录                                                                     
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')         as rec_upd_time            --记录修改时间                                                                                                                          
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')         as rec_down_time           --记录创建时间
    ,'TIT'                                                         as src_id                  --数据来源
    ,'01'                                                          as grp_id                  --并行分组标识
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_SUB_TRD_PRCG_INDX
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_PRICING_EOD_CROSS_METRIC'
    ) PECM
JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_INS_OPTION_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and Trd_Stat_Cd NOT IN ( '411', '141' )
    ) rioi
ON rioi.Prd_Id = PECM.Prd_Id
JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and Rep_Risk_Flag = '1' 
    ) opt
ON PECM.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = opt.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) code_X 
ON PECM.Cros_X_Undrl_Prd_Id = code_X.src_sys_prdno
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) code_Y 
ON PECM.Cros_Y_Undrl_Prd_Id = code_Y.src_sys_prdno
LEFT JOIN (
    select src_sys_prdno,secu_id from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) R
ON PECM.Prd_Id = r.src_sys_prdno
WHERE PECM.Prcg_Env_Id = case opt.Book_Bel_Dept when 'OTC_HK' then '10034' when 'GFS_FICC' then '10029' else '10000' end 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: V_RISK_OPTION_BASKET_INFO 风控视图-期权合约多标的一篮子信息
querySql:
SELECT busi_date,
	rec_id,
	secu_id,
	src_sys_prdno,
	comp_no,
	comp_inr_no,
	comp_ins_id,
	bask_ins_id,
	bask_type_cd,
	undrl_secu_id,
	undrl_abbr,
	undrl_ins_id,
	undrl_wind_cd,
	undrl_wght,
	book_name,
	book_own_dept,
	remark,
	src_tbl,
	src_rec_id,
	rec_upd_time,
	rec_down_time,
	src_id,
	grp_id FROM (
	 SELECT
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                                           as busi_date        --数据日期                                                                                       
    ,''                                                                       as rec_id           --记录编号
    ,b.secu_id                                                                as secu_id          --统一证券编号
    ,concat('TIT-',opt.Ext_Ord_Id)                                            as src_sys_prdno    --源系统产品编号                                                                                                  
    ,opt.Ext_Ord_Id                                                           as comp_no          --合约编号                                                                               
    ,opt.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id                                                      as comp_inr_no      --合约内部编号                                                                                      
    ,opt.Src_Comp_Prd_Id                                                      as comp_ins_id      --合约INS编号                                                                                     
    ,RBC.bask_secu_incd                                                       as bask_ins_id      --篮子INS编号                                                                                   
    ,RODS.Bask_Type                                                           as bask_type_cd     --篮子类型(INDEX_BASKET-指数式-篮子,WORST_OF-最差成分-篮子,BEST_OF-最优成分-篮子,HIMALAYAS-喜马拉雅-篮子)                                                                                  
    ,RI.secu_id                                                               as undrl_secu_id    --标的统一证券编号                                                                               
    ,RI.ch_abbr                                                               as undrl_abbr       --标的简称                                                                                 
    ,RBC.bask_compnt_secu_incd                                                as undrl_ins_id     --标的INS编号                                                                                        
    ,RIC.upper_src_cd                                                         as undrl_wind_cd    --标的WIND代码                                                                                 
    ,RBC.bask_compnt_prop                                                     as undrl_wght       --标的权重                                                                           
    ,opt.Book_Name                                                            as book_name        --账簿名称                                                                             
    ,opt.Book_Bel_Dept                                                        as book_own_dept    --账簿所属部门                                                                                  
    ,''                                                                       as remark           --备注                                                                 
    ,'odata_n_tit.d_v_risk_option_basket_info'                                as src_tbl          --来源表                                                                                                         
    ,''                                                                       as src_rec_id       --来源记录                                                                     
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                    as rec_upd_time     --记录修改时间                                                                                                                          
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                    as rec_down_time    --记录创建时间    
    ,'TIT'                                                                    as src_id           --数据来源
    ,'01'                                                                     as grp_id           --并行分组标识
FROM (
    select * from PDATA_N.T98_SB_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Rep_Risk_Flag = '1'
    ) opt
JOIN (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Bask_Type IS NOT NULL
    ) rods 
ON opt.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id = RODS.Opt_Comp_Agt_Id
JOIN pdata_news_n.nds_ref_basket_constituent RBC
ON opt.Src_Undrl_Trd_Cd = RBC.bask_secu_incd
LEFT JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) RI
ON RBC.bask_compnt_secu_incd = RI.in_code

依赖：161255,105387,103943,124566,105382
querySql:
WITH CALENDAR AS (
SELECT NATURE_DATE,SSE_DATE,LAST_1_DATE,LAST_2_DATE,NEXT_1_DATE,NEXT_2_DATE,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY SSE_DATE) AS SSE_RN
FROM (
  SELECT CC.CAL_DATE AS NATURE_DATE,CC1.CAL_DATE AS SSE_DATE,CC1.LAST_1_DATE,CC1.LAST_2_DATE,CC1.NEXT_1_DATE,NEXT_2_DATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC.CAL_DATE ORDER BY CC1.CAL_DATE) RN
  FROM (
    select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID = 'TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'NATURE' 
      AND from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') between '2024-01-01' AND '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  ) CC
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CAL_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_1_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_2_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_1_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_2_DATE
    FROM (
      select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
      from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID='TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'SSE' AND TRD_FLAG = '1'
    ) cc 
  ) CC1
  ON CC.CAL_DATE <= CC1.CAL_DATE 
) cla
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY NATURE_DATE
)

SELECT agt_id,
	trd_id,
	event_id,
	comp_stat,
	comp_stat_desc,
	create_time,
	appr_end_time,
	strt_time,
	end_time,
	evt_date,
	evt_type,
	evt_stat,
	evt_stat_desc,
	bgng_prcg_date,
	proc_name,
	proc_stat,
	tran_no,
	tran_type,
	tran_stat,
	clr_date,
	adj_frnt_bgng_pric,
	adj_pst_bgng_pric,
	inpt_time,
	err_type,
	stat,
	wind_cd,
	hld_pos_qty,
	src_upt_time,
	src_busi_date,
	key_ca_id,
	ex_date,
	ca_type,
	ca_sub_type,
	bel_dept,
	data_time,
	grp_id,
	busi_date FROM (
	 

select  distinct
        md.key_otc_trade_id            as agt_id                  --协议编号 
       ,md.internal_trade_id           as trd_id                  --交易编号 
       ,''                             as event_id                --事件id
       ,''                             as comp_stat               --合约状态 
       ,''                             as comp_stat_desc          --合约状态取值描述 
       ,''                             as create_time             --创建时间 
       ,md.event_real_time             as appr_end_time           --事件审批结束时间 
       ,''                             as strt_time               --开始时间 
       ,''                             as end_time                --结束时间 
       ,''                             as evt_date                --事件日期 
       ,''                             as evt_type                --事件类型 
       ,''                             as evt_stat                --事件状态
       ,''                             as evt_stat_desc           --事件状态取值描述
       ,''                             as bgng_prcg_date          --期初定价日
       ,''                             as proc_name               --流程名称
       ,''                             as proc_stat               --流程状态
       ,''                             as tran_no                 --收付款编号
       ,''                             as tran_type               --收付款类型
       ,''                             as tran_stat               --收付款状态
       ,''                             as clr_date                --清算日期
       ,''                             as adj_frnt_bgng_pric      --调整前期初价格
       ,''                             as adj_pst_bgng_pric       --调整后期初价格
       ,md.event_input_time            as inpt_time               --录入时间
       ,''                             as err_type                --异常类型
       ,''                             as stat                    --transfer状态/结算通知书
       ,''                             as wind_cd                 --wind代码
       ,''                             as hld_pos_qty             --持仓数量
       ,''                             as src_upt_time            --源系统更新时间
       ,''                             as src_busi_date           --源系统业务日期
       ,md.key_ca_id                   as key_ca_id               --公司行为ID  
       ,md.ex_date                     as ex_date                 --股票：股权登记日，基金：权益登记日
       ,md.ca_type                     as ca_type                 --CA方式，如现金、股票、基金等
       ,md.ca_subtype                  as ca_sub_type             --CA子类型，如送股、派息等
       ,md.department                  as bel_dept                --部门
       ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')  as data_time               --数据时间
       ,'05'                                                   as grp_id                  --并行标识
       ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                        as busi_date               --业务日期
FROM  (
  SELECT 
    TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,
    TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID,
    CA.KEY_CA_ID,
    CA.EX_DATE,
    CA.CA_TYPE,
    CA.CA_SUBTYPE,
    TOE.EVENT_INPUT_TIME,
    TOE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,
    RB.DEPARTMENT
  FROM (
    SELECT a.co_behav_id as KEY_CA_ID,datekey2date(a.ex_dvd_date) as EX_DATE,b.src_const_cd as CA_TYPE,c.src_const_cd as CA_SUBTYPE,substr(src_sys_prdno,5) as KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID
    FROM pdata_news_n.t02_co_behav_info a
    left join pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const b on a.co_behav_way = b.const_cd and b.src_id='TIT' and b.const_type_cd='var00609'
    left join pdata_news_n.t02_pub_covt_const c on a.co_behav_type = c.const_cd and c.src_id='TIT'  and c.const_type_cd='var00610'
    WHERE a.src_id='TIT' and a.grp_id='01'
    ) CA
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT Opt_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Bgng_Prcg_Date as START_DATE,End_Prcg_Date as END_DATE,Src_Prd_Id as UNDERLYING_INS_ID,Src_Agt_Type_Cd as CONTRACT_TYPE 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) RODS 
    ON CA.KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID = RODS.UNDERLYING_INS_ID
    AND RODS.CONTRACT_TYPE != 'AIRBAGX'
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT opt_comp_agt_id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,comp_stat_cd as CONTR_STATUS,Erly_Trmt_Date as EARLY_TERM_DATE,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,Divd_Adj_Mode_Cd as DIVIDEND_MODE              
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  )ROOD 
    ON RODS.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = ROOD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID 
    AND ROOD.CONTR_STATUS != '218'
  JOIN (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H b
      on a.agt_id = b.agt_id and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
    ON RODS.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  INNER JOIN (
    select book_agt_id as key_book_id,bel_dept as department  
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) RB
    ON TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C1
    ON C1.NATURE_DATE = CA.EX_DATE
  LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT Otc_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OPTION_DEAL_ID,Evt_Type_Cd as EVENT_TYPE,Evt_Date as EVENT_DATE,Evt_Stat_Cd as EVENT_STATUS,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,Appr_End_Time as EVENT_REAL_TIME
            ,Adj_Frnt_Bgng_Pric as INITIAL_PRICE_BEFORE_REset,Adj_Pst_Bgng_Pric as INITIAL_PRICE_AFTER_REset,Inpt_Time as EVENT_INPUT_TIME,Ex_Righ_Ex_Dvd_Date as EX_DATE,Src_Id as KEY_OPTION_EVENT_ID
      from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_COMP_DURA_CHG_EVT 
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OPTION_EVENT'
  )TOE                --场外合约存续期变动事件  最新全量数据   CREATED_DATETIME,EVENT_REAL_TIME 带时间
    ON RODS.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = TOE.KEY_OPTION_DEAL_ID 
    AND to_date(CA.EX_DATE) = to_date(TOE.EX_DATE)
    AND TOE.EVENT_TYPE IN ('CORPORATE_ACTIONS','CASH_DIVIDEND_REBATE','CUMULATOR_CLEARING')
    AND TOE.EVENT_STATUS = '3'
    AND to_date(TOE.EVENT_REAL_TIME) <= C1.SSE_DATE
  WHERE CA.CA_SUBTYPE IN ('STOCK_DIV','DIVIDEND')
    AND to_date(CA.EX_DATE) > to_date(RODS.START_DATE)
    AND to_date(CA.EX_DATE) < to_date(NVL(ROOD.EARLY_TERM_DATE,RODS.END_DATE))
    AND TOE.KEY_OPTION_EVENT_ID IS NULL
    AND NOT (ROOD.DIVIDEND_MODE = 'SPECIAL_ADJUST' AND CA.CA_SUBTYPE = 'DIVIDEND')
    AND NOT (ROOD.DIVIDEND_MODE = 'CASH_DIVIDEND' AND CA.CA_SUBTYPE IN ('DIVIDEND','DIVIDEND_SPECIAL') AND RODS.CONTRACT_TYPE NOT IN ('AIRBAGX','AIRBAGM','AIRBAGL') )
    AND to_date(CA.EX_DATE) = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
) MD 
	) castTable
