SELECT agt_id,
	trd_id,
	event_id,
	comp_stat,
	comp_stat_desc,
	create_time,
	appr_end_time,
	strt_time,
	end_time,
	evt_date,
	evt_type,
	evt_stat,
	evt_stat_desc,
	bgng_prcg_date,
	proc_name,
	proc_stat,
	tran_no,
	tran_type,
	tran_stat,
	clr_date,
	adj_frnt_bgng_pric,
	adj_pst_bgng_pric,
	inpt_time,
	err_type,
	stat,
	wind_cd,
	hld_pos_qty,
	src_upt_time,
	src_busi_date,
	key_ca_id,
	ex_date,
	ca_type,
	ca_sub_type,
	bel_dept,
	data_time,
	grp_id,
	busi_date FROM (
	 



select  distinct 
        df.key_otc_trade_id  as agt_id                  --协议编号
       ,df.internal_trade_id as trd_id                  --交易编号
       ,''                   as event_id                --事件id
       ,cd.src_cd_val        as comp_stat               --合约状态
       ,cd.src_cd_desc       as comp_stat_desc          --合约状态取值描述
       ,df.created_datetime  as create_time             --创建时间
       ,df.event_real_time   as appr_end_time           --事件审批结束时间
       ,''                   as strt_time               --开始时间
       ,''                   as end_time                --结束时间
       ,df.event_date        as evt_date                --事件日期
       ,df.event_type        as evt_type                --事件类型
       ,df.event_status      as evt_stat                --事件状态
       ,df.src_cd_desc       as evt_stat_desc           --事件状态取值描述
       ,''                   as bgng_prcg_date          --期初定价日
       ,''                   as proc_name               --流程名称
       ,''                   as proc_stat               --流程状态
       ,''                   as tran_no                 --收付款编号
       ,''                   as tran_type               --收付款类型
       ,''                   as tran_stat               --收付款状态
       ,''                   as clr_date                --清算日期
       ,''                   as adj_frnt_bgng_pric      --调整前期初价格
       ,''                   as adj_pst_bgng_pric       --调整后期初价格
       ,''                   as inpt_time               --录入时间
       ,''                   as err_type                --异常类型
       ,''                   as stat                    --transfer状态/结算通知书状态
       ,''                   as wind_cd                 --wind代码
       ,''                   as hld_pos_qty             --持仓数量
       ,''                   as src_upt_time            --源系统更新时间
       ,''                   as src_busi_date           --源系统业务日期
       ,''                   as key_ca_id               --公司行为ID  
       ,''                   as ex_date                 --股票：股权登记日，基金：权益登记日
       ,''                   as ca_type                 --CA方式，如现金、股票、基金等
       ,''                   as ca_sub_type             --CA子类型，如送股、派息等 
       ,rb.department        as bel_dept                --部门
       ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')  as data_time               --数据时间
       ,'02'                                                   as grp_id                  --并行标识
       ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                        as busi_date               --业务日期
FROM (
  SELECT 
      MD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID ,
      MD.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID ,
      MD.CONTR_STATUS,
      MD.EVENT_DATE,
      MD.EVENT_TYPE,
      MD.CREATED_DATETIME ,
      MD.EVENT_REAL_TIME ,
      MD.EVENT_STATUS ,
      MD.KEY_BOOK_ID ,
      MD.EXCH_MARKET ,
      MD.INS_FAMILY,
      MD.SRC_CD_DESC
  FROM MASTER_DATA MD
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
    ON  C1.NATURE_DATE = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
    ON MD.EVENT_DATE = C2.NATURE_DATE
  WHERE C1.LAST_1_DATE <= SUBSTR(MD.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10)
    AND SUBSTR(MD.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10) >= C2.NEXT_1_DATE
    AND MD.EXCH_MARKET IN ('SSE','SZSE','HKEX') AND MD.INS_FAMILY != 'FUTURE' AND MD.WIND_CODE NOT IN ('GAMMA.WI','CHARM.WI')
    AND NOT (MD.EXCH_MARKET = 'HKEX' AND MD.INS_FAMILY = 'FUND')    --20250429添加
  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    MD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID ,
    MD.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID ,
    MD.CONTR_STATUS,
    MD.EVENT_DATE,
    MD.EVENT_TYPE,
    MD.CREATED_DATETIME ,
    MD.EVENT_REAL_TIME ,
    MD.EVENT_STATUS ,
    MD.KEY_BOOK_ID ,
    MD.EXCH_MARKET ,
    MD.INS_FAMILY,
    MD.SRC_CD_DESC
  FROM MASTER_DATA MD
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
    ON  C1.NATURE_DATE = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
    ON MD.EVENT_DATE = C2.NATURE_DATE
  WHERE C1.LAST_2_DATE <= SUBSTR(MD.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10)
    AND SUBSTR(MD.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10) >= C2.NEXT_2_DATE
    AND (MD.EXCH_MARKET NOT IN ('SSE','SZSE','HKEX') OR MD.INS_FAMILY = 'FUTURE' OR MD.WIND_CODE IN ('GAMMA.WI','CHARM.WI') OR (MD.EXCH_MARKET = 'HKEX' AND MD.INS_FAMILY = 'FUND'))   --20250429修改
) DF
left join (
  SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL,SRC_CD_DESC
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
  WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO'
    AND TGT_TAB_FLD  = 'Comp_Stat_Cd'
    AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL'
    AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'CONTR_STATUS'
    AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
) CD on DF.CONTR_STATUS = CD.DW_CD_VAL
INNER JOIN (
  select book_agt_id as key_book_id,bel_dept as department  
  from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
  where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) RB
  ON DF.KEY_BOOK_ID = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID
where DF.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID NOT LIKE 'OPT-OTC%'    --20241231新加 
	) castTable
note: 本地快照；任务名称及执行库不能单独证明实际输出，输出同时核对投影。

name: dm_otc_n.cfg_instrument_pool_props_td

	interotc_code,

	interotc_name,
	report_to,

	price_exchange,
	price_publish_organ,
	price_website,
	otc_underlying_type,
	created_datetime,
	created_by,

	updated_by,
	key_pool_id FROM (

 replace(a.src_sys_prdno ,'TIT-','')   as key_instrument_id                    --源系统产品编号   
,a.offr_sys_cd      as interotc_code                    --报价系统代码

,a.undrl_minor_cate  as  interotc_underlying_category                 --报价系统标的小类

,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')  as  created_datetime

name: dm_hk_n.otc_prd_product
querySql:
SELECT id,
	key_prod_id,
	department,
	key_book_id,
	book_name,
	product_type,
	inner_code,
	external_code,
	trade_date,
	start_date,
	end_date,
	payment_date_delay,
	settlement_date,
	invest_maturity,
	total_notional,
	issue_size,
	denomination,
	issue_price,
	mature_price,
	settlement_currency,
	min_order_amount,
	max_order_amount,
	ordered_size,
	accumulated_order_amount,
	product_status,
	created_datetime,
	created_by,
	updated_datetime,
	updated_by,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    pp.rec_id as id,  --记录编号
    pp.prd_id as key_prod_id,  --产品id
    pp.iss_dept as department,  --发行部门
    pp.book_id as key_book_id,  --账簿id
    pp.book_name as book_name,  --账簿名称
    pp.prd_type as product_type,  --产品类型
    pp.prd_inr_cd as inner_code,  --产品内部代码
    pp.prd_ext_cd as external_code,  --产品外部代码
    default.datekey2date(pp.sale_date) as trade_date,  --销售日期
    default.datekey2date(pp.val_date) as start_date,  --产品起息日
    default.datekey2date(pp.maty_date) as end_date,  --产品到期日
    pp.pay_day_delay as payment_date_delay,  --兑付日延期
    default.datekey2date(pp.sett_date) as settlement_date,  --产品结算日
    pp.prd_term as invest_maturity,  --产品期限(天)
    pp.prd_tot_nom_prin as total_notional,  --产品总名义本金
    pp.iss_qty as issue_size,  --发行数量
    pp.prd_par_val as denomination,  --产品面值
    pp.iss_pric as issue_price,  --发行价格
    pp.maty_pric as mature_price,  --到期价格
    pp.sett_crrc as settlement_currency,  --结算币种
    pp.min_scrp_amt as min_order_amount,  --认购起点
    pp.max_scrp_amt as max_order_amount,  --认购上限
    pp.scrp_qty as ordered_size,  --已认购数量
    pp.accum_scrp_amt as accumulated_order_amount,  --累计已认购金额
    pp.prd_stat as product_status,  --产品状态
    pp.src_create_time as created_datetime,  --源创建时间
    '' as created_by,  --创建人
    pp.rec_upd_time as updated_datetime,  --记录修改时间
    '' as updated_by,  --更新人
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date
FROM (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) pp
JOIN (
    select * from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_prd_asset_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) ppa
ON pp.prd_id = ppa.prd_id
join (
    select * from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and Bel_Co = 'GFS_HK'
    ) rb
on pp.book_id = rb.Book_Agt_Id 
	) castTable

name: dm_otc_n.otc_comp_dura_chg_evt
querySql:
SELECT Agt_Id,
	Ext_Comp_No,
	Busi_Type,
	Src_Contr_Type,
	Src_Contr_Type_Desc,
	Src_Sub_Contr_Type,
	Src_Sub_Contr_Type_Desc,
	Cutp_Pty_Id,
	Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name,
	Qual_Revw_Flag,
	Src_Agt_Stat_Cd,
	Undrl_Wd_Cd,
	Undrl_Name,
	Undrl_Long_Name,
	Upper_Undrl_Wd_Cd,
	mhs_flag,
	Tit_Oper_User_Id,
	Tit_Oper_Name,
	Tit_Oper_Emp_Id,
	Tit_Oper_Inr_Org_Id,
	Tit_Oper_Inr_Org_Name,
	Tit_Cust_Mngr_User_Id,
	Tit_Cust_Mngr_Name,
	Tit_Cust_Mngr_Emp_Id,
	Tit_Cust_Mngr_Inr_Org_Id,
	Tit_Cust_Mngr_Inr_Org_Name,
	KEY_OPTION_EVENT_ID,
	EVENT_DATE,
	KEY_OPTION_DEAL_ID,
	Evt_Type_Cd,
	EVENT_TYPE,
	EVENT_INPUT_TIME,
	EVENT_REAL_TIME,
	NOTIONAL_BEFORE,
	NOTIONAL_DELTA,
	NOTIONAL_AFTER,
	ABS_NOTIONAL_BEFORE,
	ABS_NOTIONAL_DELTA,
	ABS_NOTIONAL_AFTER,
	EARLY_TERMINATION_PRICE,
	EARLY_TERM_INTRINSIC_VALUE,
	EARLY_TERM_PRESENT_VALUE,
	EVENT_FEE,
	EVENT_AMOUNT,
	EVENT_AMOUNT_ORG,
	CURRENCY,
	EVENT_STATUS,
	EVENT_DESC,
	TRADER,
	UPDATED_DATETIME,
	CREATED_DATETIME,
	CREATED_BY,
	UPDATED_BY,
	EXCHANGE_RATE,
	PAYMENT_DATE,
	EX_DATE,
	PRE_EX_DATE_CLOSE,
	CASH_RATIO,
	RATIONED_SHARES_QUANTITY,
	RATIONED_SHARES_PRICE,
	BONUS_RATIO,
	CONVERSED_RATIO,
	PRICE_RESET_RATE,
	INITIAL_PRICE_BEFORE_RESET,
	INITIAL_PRICE_AFTER_RESET,
	FEE_ID,
	EFFECTIVE_DATE,
	IS_TASK_FINISH_FLAG,
	CA_UNDERLYING_INS_ID,
	ORI_EARLY_TERM_INTRINSIC_VALUE,
	NON_PAYMENT,
	TIME_VALUE,
	INITIAL_PRICE_FX_BEFORE_RESET,
	INITIAL_PRICE_FX_AFTER_RESET,
	QUANTITY,
	TAX_RATIO,
	PAY_DIRECTION,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
	t.Agt_Id,  --合约编号
	t.Ext_Comp_No,  --对外合约编号
	t.Busi_Type,  --业务类型
	t.Src_Contr_Type,  --源合约类型
	t.Src_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约类型描述
	t.Src_Sub_Contr_Type,  --源合约子类型
	t.Src_Sub_Contr_Type_Desc,  --源合约子类型描述
	t.Cutp_Pty_Id,  --交易对手编号
	t.Cutp_Pty_Shor_Name,  --交易对手简称
	t.Qual_Revw_Flag,  --客户资质复核标志
	t.Src_Agt_Stat_Cd,  --合约状态
	ric.src_cd as Undrl_Wd_Cd,  --标的代码
	ric.ch_abbr as Undrl_Name,  --标的名称短名
	ric.ch_name as Undrl_Long_Name,  --标的名称长名
	ric.upper_src_cd as Upper_Undrl_Wd_Cd,  --标的代码（大写）
	coalesce(s.mhs_flag,'0') as mhs_flag,  --是否港股通
	m.Tit_Oper_User_Id,  --TITANS经办人ID
	m.Tit_Oper_Name,  --TITANS经办人姓名
	m.Tit_Oper_Emp_Id,  --TITANS经办人员工编号
	m.Tit_Oper_Inr_Org_Id,  --TITANS经办人所属部门编号
	m.Tit_Oper_Inr_Org_Name,  --TITANS经办人所属部门名称
	m.Tit_Cust_Mngr_User_Id,  --TITANS客户经理ID
	m.Tit_Cust_Mngr_Name,  --TITANS客户经理姓名
	m.Tit_Cust_Mngr_Emp_Id,  --TITANS客户经理员工编号
	m.Tit_Cust_Mngr_Inr_Org_Id,  --TITANS客户经理所属部门编号
	m.Tit_Cust_Mngr_Inr_Org_Name,  --TITANS客户经理所属部门名称
	a.Src_Id as KEY_OPTION_EVENT_ID,  --事件ID
	a.Evt_Date as EVENT_DATE,  --事件日期
	a.Otc_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OPTION_DEAL_ID,  --场外期权合约ID
	a.Evt_Type_Cd,  --事件类型
	case when a.Evt_Type_Cd in ('DIVIDEND_STOCKS','CASH_DIVIDEND_REBATE') then 'CASH_DIVIDEND'
	     when a.Evt_Type_Cd = 'SEND_STOCKS' then 'STOCK_BONUS'
		 when a.Evt_Type_Cd = 'CORPORATE_ACTIONS' then concat_ws(',',
			if(coalesce(cast(a.Per_Stk_Cash_Divd as double),0) != 0,'CASH_DIVIDEND',null),
			if(coalesce(cast(a.Per_Stk_Bns as double),0) != 0,'STOCK_BONUS',null),
			if(coalesce(cast(a.Righ_Shr_Vol as double),0) != 0 and coalesce(cast(a.Righ_Shr_Pric as double),0) != 0,'RIGHT_SHARE',null),
			if(coalesce(cast(a.Per_Stk_Covt_Add_Equi as double),0) != 0,'CONVERSED_SHARE',null))
		 end as EVENT_TYPE,  --业务标志
	a.Inpt_Time as EVENT_INPUT_TIME,  --事件录入时间
	a.Appr_End_Time as EVENT_REAL_TIME,  --事件审批结束时间
	a.Adj_Frnt_Nom_Prin as NOTIONAL_BEFORE,  --调整前名义本金
	a.Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta as NOTIONAL_DELTA,  --名义本金变动金额
	a.Adj_Pst_Nom_Prin as NOTIONAL_AFTER,  --调整后名义本金
	a.Adj_Frnt_Absl_Nom_Prin as ABS_NOTIONAL_BEFORE,  --调整前绝对名义本金
	a.Absl_Nom_Prin_Chg_Delta as ABS_NOTIONAL_DELTA,  --绝对名义本金变动金额
	a.Adj_Pst_Absl_Nom_Prin as ABS_NOTIONAL_AFTER,  --调整后绝对名义本金
	a.Erly_Trmt_Pric as EARLY_TERMINATION_PRICE,  --提前终止价格
	a.Erly_Trmt_Intrn_Val as EARLY_TERM_INTRINSIC_VALUE,  --内在价值(提前终止)
	a.Erly_Trmt_Pv as EARLY_TERM_PRESENT_VALUE,  --内在价值(PV)
	if(t.busi_type = 'OPTION', a.Evt_Amt, a.Evt_Fee) as EVENT_FEE,  --事件费
	if(t.busi_type = 'OPTION', a.Evt_Fee, a.Evt_Amt) as EVENT_AMOUNT,  --事件金额（本币）
	a.Ocrrd_Evt_Amt as EVENT_AMOUNT_ORG,  --事件金额(原币)
	a.Crrc_Cd as CURRENCY,  --币种
	coalesce(D.SRC_CD_VAL,a.Evt_Stat_Cd) as EVENT_STATUS,  --事件状态
	a.Remark as EVENT_DESC,  --事件备注
	a.Trdr_Id as TRADER,  --交易员
	a.Upd_Time as UPDATED_DATETIME,  --更新时间
	a.Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,  --创建时间
	a.Create_User as CREATED_BY,  --创建人
	a.Upd_User as UPDATED_BY,  --更新人
	a.Rate as EXCHANGE_RATE,  --汇率	
	a.Pay_Date as PAYMENT_DATE,  --兑付日
	a.Ex_Righ_Ex_Dvd_Date as EX_DATE,  --除权除息日
	a.Ex_Yest_Clos_Pric as PRE_EX_DATE_CLOSE,  --除权除息日-昨收盘价
	a.Per_Stk_Cash_Divd as CASH_RATIO,  --每股现金红利
	a.Righ_Shr_Vol as RATIONED_SHARES_QUANTITY,  --配股股数
	a.Righ_Shr_Pric as RATIONED_SHARES_PRICE,  --配股价格
	a.Per_Stk_Bns as BONUS_RATIO,  --每股红股
	a.Per_Stk_Covt_Add_Equi as CONVERSED_RATIO,  --每股转增股本
	a.Pric_Adj_Prop as PRICE_RESET_RATE,  --调整比例
	if(t.busi_type = 'OPTION', a.Adj_Frnt_Bgng_Pric, pos.Bgng_Pric * t.Cny_Ex_Rate) as INITIAL_PRICE_BEFORE_RESET,  --调整前期初价格
	if(t.busi_type = 'OPTION', a.Adj_Pst_Bgng_Pric, pos.Bgng_Pric * t.Cny_Ex_Rate) as INITIAL_PRICE_AFTER_RESET,  --调整后期初价格
	a.Trd_Fee_Src_Id as FEE_ID,  --费用ID
	a.Bgng_Prcg_Date as EFFECTIVE_DATE,  --期初定价日
	CASE WHEN a.Vld_Upd_Comp_Flag = '1' THEN 'Y'
		 WHEN a.Vld_Upd_Comp_Flag = '0' THEN 'N'
		 ELSE a.Vld_Upd_Comp_Flag END as IS_TASK_FINISH_FLAG,  --事件生效更新合约标识
	coalesce(split(a.Undrl_Prd_Id,'-')[1], pos.Src_Prd_Id) as CA_UNDERLYING_INS_ID,  --标的代码
	a.Sys_Intrn_Val as ORI_EARLY_TERM_INTRINSIC_VALUE,  --内在价值(系统)
	a.Unpay_Fee as NON_PAYMENT,  --未支付费用
	a.Preterm_Paid_Val as TIME_VALUE,  --提前终止支付时间价值
	a.Adj_Frnt_Bgng_Fx_Pric as INITIAL_PRICE_FX_BEFORE_RESET,  --调整前期初Fx价格
	a.Adj_Pst_Bgng_Fx_Pric as INITIAL_PRICE_FX_AFTER_RESET,  --调整后期初Fx价格
	a.Vol as QUANTITY,  --数量
	a.Tax_Rate as TAX_RATIO,  --税率
	NVL(E.SRC_CD_VAL,a.Net_Dir_Cd) as PAY_DIRECTION,  --支付方向
	'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date  --业务日期
from (
    select * from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_COMP_DURA_CHG_EVT
    where src_tbl in ('ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OPTION_EVENT','ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRS_EVENT')
    ) a
left join (
    select Swap_Comp_Agt_Id, Dura_Chg_Src_Id, Swap_Comp_Hold_Id
	from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_CHG_DET
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRS_EVENT_STRUC_DETAIL'
    ) sd
on sd.Dura_Chg_Src_Id = a.Src_Id and sd.Swap_Comp_Agt_Id = a.Otc_Comp_Agt_Id
left join (
	select *
	from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_HOLD_INFO
	where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_POS_TRS_LEG_HIS_POS'
	) pos
on pos.Swap_Comp_Hold_Id = sd.Swap_Comp_Hold_Id and a.busi_date = pos.busi_date
inner join (
	select *
	from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_DERI_COMP_SALE_INFO
	where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
	) t
on t.Inr_Seri_No = a.Otc_Comp_Agt_Id
left join (
	select *
	from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_COMP_MNG_RELA_INFO
	where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
	) m
on m.Agt_Id = t.Agt_Id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
    WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T05_OTC_COMP_DURA_CHG_EVT'
        AND TGT_TAB_FLD  = 'Evt_Stat_Cd'
        AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'TRD_OPTION_EVENT'
        AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'EVENT_STATUS'
        AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
    ) D
ON A.Evt_Stat_Cd = D.DW_CD_VAL
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
    WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T05_OTC_COMP_DURA_CHG_EVT'
        AND TGT_TAB_FLD = 'Net_Dir_Cd'
        AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'TRD_TRS_EVENT'
        AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'PAY_DIRECTION'
        AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
    ) E
ON A.Net_Dir_Cd = E.DW_CD_VAL
left join (
    select *
    from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_lbl
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
    ) s
on s.rec_id = if(t.busi_type = 'OPTION',t.Undrl_Ins_Id, pos.Src_Prd_Id)
LEFT JOIN (
    select *
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info
    where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '02' and date_src = 'WIND'
    ) RIC
ON if(t.busi_type = 'OPTION',t.Undrl_Ins_Id, pos.Src_Prd_Id) = RIC.in_code
where ric.src_cd is not null

name: 外汇隐含收益率-曲线数据停滞及异常处理信息 第1批次 01:00
querySql:
SELECT parent_busi_regu_id,
	chk_regu_id,
	trd_dt,
	chk_obj_id,
	chk_obj_name,
	term_dot,
	tdy_offr,
	pday_offr,
	delay_days,
	delay_thrh,
	handd_Intrp,
	chk_tbl_en,
	chk_fld_en,
	src_id,
	data_time,
	grp_id,
	busi_date FROM (
	 -- 市场数据停滞5天、15天、30天检查规则--外汇隐含收益率曲线的即期价格（汇率）
select  
    case when delay_days >= 30 then '82'
        when delay_days >= 15 then '81'
        when delay_days >= 5 then '80' end                 as parent_busi_regu_id   --业务规则ID 
    ,case when delay_days >= 30 then 'BD-040603'
        when delay_days >= 15 then 'BD-040602'
        when delay_days >= 5 then 'BD-040601' end          as chk_regu_id   --核检规则ID 
    ,busi_date                                             as trd_dt        --交易日期 
    ,fctr_id                                               as chk_obj_id    --核检对象编码 
    ,fctr_curv_ch_name                                     as chk_obj_name  --核检对象名称 
    ,''                                                    as term_dot      --期限点 
    ,pric_clos                                             as tdy_offr      --今日报价 
    ,pday_pric_clos                                        as pday_offr     --上日报价 
    ,delay_days                                                             --停滞天数 
    ,case when delay_days >= 30 then '30D'
        when delay_days >= 15 then '15D'
        when delay_days >= 5 then '5D' end                 as delay_thrh    --停滞阈值 
    ,''                                                    as handd_Intrp   --异常处理后填充值 
    ,'pdata_news_n.tyzx_exch_quot_h_fk'                    as chk_tbl_en    --核检表英文名 
    ,'pric_clos'                                           as chk_fld_en    --核检字段英文名 
    ,src_id                                                                 --来源标识 
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time     --数据时间 
    ,'04'                                                  as grp_id        --并行标识 
    ,busi_date                                                              --业务日期 
from
(
    select  
        fctr_id
        ,fctr_curv_ch_name
        ,pric_clos
        ,pday_pric_clos
        ,src_id
        ,case when delay_flag = '0' then 0  else row_number() over(partition by fctr_id,diff order by  busi_date) end as delay_days
        ,busi_date 
    from
    (
        select
            a.*
            ,case when delay_flag = '1' then 
                    row_number() over(partition by fctr_id order by busi_date desc) - 
                    row_number() over(partition by fctr_id,delay_flag order by busi_date desc)
            end as diff
        from
        (
            select  
                a.busi_date
                ,b.fctr_id
                ,b.fctr_curv_ch_name
                ,d.pric_clos
                ,lag(coalesce(d.pric_clos,'')) over(partition by b.fctr_id order by  a.busi_date) pday_pric_clos
                ,d.src_id
                ,case when lag(cast(case when coalesce(trim(d.pric_clos),'') = '' then '0'  else d.pric_clos end as double)) 
                        over(partition by b.fctr_id order by a.busi_date) 
                    = cast(case when coalesce(trim(d.pric_clos),'') = '' then '0'  else d.pric_clos end as double) 
                    then '1'  else '0' end as delay_flag  -- 停滞标志 
            from
            (
                select distinct trd_date as busi_date
                from PDATA_N.T99_TRD_CAL_REF
                where data_src_cd = 'RCC' 
                    and trd_flag='1'
                    and trd_date between '${yyyy-MM-dd,-1y}' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            ) a 
            join
            (
                select
                    fctr_id
                    ,fctr_curv_ch_name
                from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_def
                where src_id = 'LBR'
                    and grp_id = '01'
                    and fctr_type_1 = 'FOREIGN_EXCHANGE'
                    and fctr_type_2 = 'SPOT'
                    and risk_fctr_flag = '1'
                    and enable_flag = '1'
            ) b on 1 = 1
            join
            (
                select
                    fctr_id
                    ,substr(src_sys_prdno,5) as in_code 
                from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fxr_fctr_def
                where src_id = 'LBR' and grp_id = '01'
            ) c on b.fctr_id = c.fctr_id
            left join
            (
                select 
                    default.datekey2date(trd_dt) trd_dt
                    ,src_id
                    ,substr(src_sys_prdno,5) as in_code
                    ,pric_clos 
                from pdata_news_n.tyzx_exch_quot_h_fk
                where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'
                    and trd_dt between '${yyyyMMdd,-1y}' and '${yyyyMMdd}'
            ) d on a.busi_date = d.trd_dt and c.in_code = d.in_code
        ) a
    ) a
) a
where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and delay_days > 5

union all 
-- 基础数据停滞检查--外汇隐含收益率曲线的远掉期点行情
select 
    case when delay_days >= 30 then '90'
        when delay_days >= 15 then '89'
        when delay_days >= 5 then '88' end                 as parent_busi_regu_id   --业务规则ID 
    ,case when delay_days > 30 then 'BD-040606'

        when delay_days > 5 then '5D' end                  as delay_thrh    --停滞阈值
    ,''                                                    as handd_Intrp   --异常处理后填充值 
    ,'pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_mkt_quot'                  as chk_tbl_en    --核检表英文名 
    ,'ytm'                                                 as chk_fld_en    --核检字段英文名 
    ,'TIT'                                                 as src_id        --来源标识 
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time     --数据时间 
    ,'04'                                                  as grp_id        --并行标识
    ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                       as busi_date     --业务日期 
from
(
    select  curv_id_src
        ,curv_name
        ,term
        ,maty_date
        ,ytm
        ,pday_fctr_val 
        ,case when delay_flag = '0' then 0
            else row_number() over(partition by curv_id_src,term,diff order by busi_date)
            end as delay_days
        ,busi_date
    from
    (
        select a.*,
            case when delay_flag = '1' then 
                    row_number() over(partition by curv_id_src,term order by busi_date desc) - 
                    row_number() over(partition by curv_id_src,term,delay_flag order by busi_date desc)
            end as diff 
        from
        (
            select  
                a.busi_date
                ,d.curv_id_src
                ,d.curv_name
                ,e.term
                ,e.maty_date
                ,e.ytm
                ,lag(coalesce(e.ytm,'')) over(partition by d.curv_id_src,e.term order by a.busi_date) as pday_fctr_val
                ,case when lag(cast(case when coalesce(trim(e.ytm),'') = '' then '0' else e.ytm end as double)) 
                            over(partition by d.curv_id_src,e.term order by a.busi_date) 
                        = cast(case when coalesce(trim(e.ytm),'') = '' then '0' else e.ytm end as double)
                    then '1' else '0'
                end as delay_flag       --停滞标志
            from 
            (

                from PDATA_N.T99_TRD_CAL_REF
                where data_src_cd = 'RCC' 
                    and trd_flag='1'
                    and trd_date between '${yyyy-MM-dd,-1y}' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
            ) a
            inner join 
            (
                select rfcd.fctr_id 
                from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_fctr_def rfcd 
                left join pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_def rfd on rfcd.fctr_id = rfd.fctr_id
                where rfcd.src_id = 'LBR' and rfcd.grp_id = '01'
                and rfd.src_id = 'LBR' and rfd.grp_id = '01'
                and rfd.fctr_engine_hand_method = 'IMPLIED_YIELD_CALC'
            ) b on 1=1
            inner join 
            (
                select fctr_id,fx_swap_curv_name --外汇掉期曲线名称  
                from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_impl_yield_undrl_def 
                where src_id = 'LBR' and grp_id = '01'
            ) c on b.fctr_id = c.fctr_id
            inner join

                where src_id='TIT' and grp_id='01'

            inner join 
            (
                select  
                    src_rec_id
                    ,term 
                    ,ytm                   --掉期行情 
                    ,maty_dt as maty_date  --到期日 
                    ,default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt
                from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_mkt_quot
                where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01' 
                and trd_dt between '${yyyyMMdd,-1y}' and '${yyyyMMdd}' 
            ) e on d.curv_id_src =  e.src_rec_id and a.busi_Date = e.trd_dt 
        ) a 
    ) a 
) a 
where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and delay_days > 5

    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time     --数据时间 
    ,'04'                                                  as grp_id        --并行标识 
    ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                       as busi_date     --业务日期  
from  
(
    select 
        c.curv_id_src
        ,c.curv_name
        ,d.term
        ,d.maty_date
        ,cast(d.ytm as double) as ytm
        ,lag(cast(d.ytm as double)) over(partition by c.curv_id_src,d.term order by t.busi_date) as pday_ytm
        ,t.busi_date
    from  
    (
        select distinct trd_date as busi_date
        from PDATA_N.T99_TRD_CAL_REF
        where data_src_cd = 'RCC' 
            and trd_flag='1'
            and trd_date between '${yyyy-MM-dd,-1y}' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) t 
    inner join 
    (
        select rfcd.fctr_id 
        from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_fctr_def rfcd 
        left join pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_def rfd on rfcd.fctr_id = rfd.fctr_id
        where rfcd.src_id = 'LBR' and rfcd.grp_id = '01'
        and rfd.src_id = 'LBR' and rfd.grp_id = '01'
        and rfd.fctr_engine_hand_method = 'IMPLIED_YIELD_CALC'
    ) a on 1=1
    inner join 
    (
        select fctr_id,fx_swap_curv_name --外汇掉期曲线名称  
        from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_impl_yield_undrl_def 
        where src_id = 'LBR' and grp_id = '01'
    ) b on a.fctr_id = b.fctr_id
    inner join 
    ( 
        select curv_id_src,curv_name
        from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_def
        where src_id='TIT' and grp_id='01' 
    ) c on b.fx_swap_curv_name = c.curv_name 
    left join 
    (
        select  
            src_rec_id
            ,term 
            ,ytm                   --掉期行情 
            ,maty_dt as maty_date  --到期日 
            ,default.datekey2date(trd_dt) as trd_dt
        from pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_mkt_quot
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01'  
        and trd_dt between '${yyyyMMdd, -1y}' and '${yyyyMMdd}'  
    ) d on c.curv_id_src =  d.src_rec_id and t.busi_date = d.trd_dt
) t 
where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and cast(ytm as double)=0 
	) castTable

        and fctr_type_2 = 'DIVIDEND'

        rec_id as curv_cd_src
    from 
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_mkt_quot 
    where 
        src_id='TIT' 
        and grp_id='02'
        and trd_dt = '${yyyyMMdd}'
    group by 
        rec_id
    ) c 
on 
    b.divd_curv_id = c.curv_cd_src      --剔除整条曲线缺失的情况
join
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        term_stru
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_term_stru_def
    where
        src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) d
on
    a.fctr_id = d.fctr_id
left join
    (
    select 
        rec_id as curv_cd_src,
        term,
        yield
    from 
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_mkt_quot 
    where 
        src_id='TIT' 
        and grp_id='02'
        and trd_dt = '${yyyyMMdd}'
    ) e
on 
    b.divd_curv_id = e.curv_cd_src
    and d.term_stru = e.term
left join
    (
    select 
        rec_id as curv_cd_src,
        term,
        yield
    from 
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_curv_mkt_quot 
    where 
        src_id='TIT' 
        and grp_id='02'
        and trd_dt = '${yyyyMMdd, -1t}'
    ) f
on 
    b.divd_curv_id = f.curv_cd_src
    and d.term_stru = f.term
where
    coalesce(trim(e.yield),'') = '' 
	) castTable

FROM (
  SELECT CC.CAL_DATE AS NATURE_DATE,CC1.CAL_DATE AS SSE_DATE,CC1.LAST_1_DATE,CC1.LAST_2_DATE,CC1.NEXT_1_DATE,NEXT_2_DATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC.CAL_DATE ORDER BY CC1.CAL_DATE) RN
  FROM (
    select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID = 'TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'NATURE' 
      AND from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') between '2024-01-01' AND '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  ) CC
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CAL_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_1_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_2_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_1_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_2_DATE
    FROM (
      select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
      from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID='TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'SSE' AND TRD_FLAG = '1'

  ) CC1

) cla
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY NATURE_DATE

select  distinct
        df.key_otc_trade_id  as agt_id                  --协议编号
       ,df.internal_trade_id as trd_id                  --交易编号
       ,''                   as event_id                --事件id
       ,cd.src_cd_val        as comp_stat               --合约状态
       ,cd.src_cd_desc       as comp_stat_desc          --合约状态取值描述
       ,df.created_datetime  as create_time             --创建时间
       ,''                   as appr_end_time           --事件审批结束时间
       ,df.start_time_       as strt_time               --开始时间
       ,df.end_time_         as end_time                --结束时间
       ,''                   as evt_date                --事件日期
       ,''                   as evt_type                --事件类型
       ,''                   as evt_stat                --事件状态
       ,''                   as evt_stat_desc           --事件状态取值描述 
       ,df.start_date        as bgng_prcg_date          --期初定价日
       ,df.process_name      as proc_name               --流程名称
       ,df.state_            as proc_stat               --流程状态
       ,''                   as tran_no                 --收付款编号
       ,''                   as tran_type               --收付款类型
       ,''                   as tran_stat               --收付款状态
       ,''                   as clr_date                --清算日期
       ,''                   as adj_frnt_bgng_pric      --调整前期初价格
       ,''                   as adj_pst_bgng_pric       --调整后期初价格
       ,''                   as inpt_time               --录入时间
       ,''                   as err_type                --异常类型
       ,''                   as stat                    --transfer状态/结算通知书状态
       ,''                   as wind_cd                 --wind代码
       ,''                   as hld_pos_qty             --持仓数量
       ,''                   as src_upt_time            --源系统更新时间
       ,''                   as src_busi_date           --源系统业务日期
       ,''                   as key_ca_id               --公司行为ID  
       ,''                   as ex_date                 --股票：股权登记日，基金：权益登记日
       ,''                   as ca_type                 --CA方式，如现金、股票、基金等
       ,''                   as ca_sub_type             --CA子类型，如送股、派息等
       ,rb.department        as bel_dept                --部门
       ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')  as data_time               --数据时间
       ,'01'                                                   as grp_id                  --并行标识
       ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                        as busi_date               --业务日期
FROM (
  --境内
  SELECT  MD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
         ,MD.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID
         ,MD.CREATED_DATETIME
         ,MD.CONTR_STATUS
         ,MD.START_DATE
         ,MD.PROCESS_NAME
         ,MD.START_TIME_
         ,MD.END_TIME_
         ,MD.STATE_
         ,MD.KEY_BOOK_ID
  from MASTER_DATA MD
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
  ON C1.NATURE_DATE = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
  ON SUBSTR(MD.START_DATE,1,10) = C2.NATURE_DATE
  WHERE C1.LAST_1_DATE = SUBSTR(MD.CREATED_DATETIME,1,10)
  AND (MD.END_TIME_ IS NULL OR ((unix_timestamp(MD.END_TIME_,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - unix_timestamp(C2.NEXT_1_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd'))/3600 >= 15 ))
  AND MD.EXCH_MARKET IN ('SSE','SZSE','HKEX') AND MD.INS_FAMILY != 'FUTURE' AND MD.WIND_CODE NOT IN ('GAMMA.WI','CHARM.WI')
  UNION ALL
  
  --境外
  SELECT  MD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
         ,MD.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID
         ,MD.CREATED_DATETIME
         ,MD.CONTR_STATUS
         ,MD.START_DATE
         ,MD.PROCESS_NAME
         ,MD.START_TIME_
         ,MD.END_TIME_
         ,MD.STATE_
         ,MD.KEY_BOOK_ID
  FROM MASTER_DATA MD
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
  ON C1.NATURE_DATE = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
  ON SUBSTR(MD.START_DATE,1,10) = C2.NATURE_DATE
  WHERE C1.LAST_2_DATE = SUBSTR(MD.CREATED_DATETIME,1,10)
  AND (MD.END_TIME_ IS NULL OR ((unix_timestamp(MD.END_TIME_,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - unix_timestamp(C2.NEXT_2_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd'))/3600 >= 15 ))
AND (MD.EXCH_MARKET NOT IN ('SSE','SZSE','HKEX') OR MD.INS_FAMILY = 'FUTURE' OR MD.WIND_CODE IN ('GAMMA.WI','CHARM.WI'))
) DF
left join (
  SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL,src_cd_desc
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
  WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO'
    AND TGT_TAB_FLD  = 'Comp_Stat_Cd'
    AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL'
    AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'CONTR_STATUS'
    AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
) CD on DF.CONTR_STATUS = CD.DW_CD_VAL
INNER JOIN (
  select book_agt_id as key_book_id,bel_dept as department  
  from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
  where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) RB
  ON DF.KEY_BOOK_ID = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID 
	) castTable

WITH CALENDAR AS (
SELECT NATURE_DATE,SSE_DATE,LAST_1_DATE,LAST_2_DATE,NEXT_1_DATE,NEXT_2_DATE,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY SSE_DATE) AS SSE_RN
FROM (
  SELECT CC.CAL_DATE AS NATURE_DATE,CC1.CAL_DATE AS SSE_DATE,CC1.LAST_1_DATE,CC1.LAST_2_DATE,CC1.NEXT_1_DATE,NEXT_2_DATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC.CAL_DATE ORDER BY CC1.CAL_DATE) RN
  FROM (
    select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID = 'TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'NATURE' 
      AND from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') between '2024-01-01' AND '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  ) CC
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CAL_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_1_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_2_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_1_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_2_DATE
    FROM (
      select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
      from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID='TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'SSE' AND TRD_FLAG = '1'
    ) cc 
  ) CC1
  ON CC.CAL_DATE <= CC1.CAL_DATE 
) cla
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY NATURE_DATE
)

  JOIN (
    SELECT Opt_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Bgng_Prcg_Date as START_DATE,End_Prcg_Date as END_DATE,Src_Prd_Id as UNDERLYING_INS_ID

    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  JOIN (
    SELECT Swap_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,Comp_Stat_Cd as CONTR_STATUS,Strt_Pric_Date as START_DATE,End_Pric_Date as END_DATE

  JOIN (
    SELECT Busi_Id as BUSINESS_KEY_,Proc_Def_Bpmn_Id as PROC_DEF_KEY_,Proc_Instc_Id as PROC_INST_ID_,TO_TIMESTAMP(STAT_TIME) AS START_TIME_,TO_TIMESTAMP(END_TIME) AS END_TIME_,Proc_Stat as STATE_,End_Node_Id as END_ACT_ID_
    from	PDATA_N.T05_TIT_PROC_INSTC 
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.W_ACT_HI_PROCINST'
  ) PRO       --START_TIME_，END_TIME_ 带时间
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = PRO.BUSINESS_KEY_
  AND pro.STATE_ IN ('COMPLETED')
  AND PRO.END_ACT_ID_ IN ('EndEvent_0soieqs')
  JOIN CALENDAR C1

  WHERE substr(C1.LAST_1_DATE,1,10) = substr(PRO.END_TIME_,1,10)

  SELECT
  TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  FROM (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  JOIN (
    SELECT Swap_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,Comp_Stat_Cd as CONTR_STATUS,Strt_Pric_Date as START_DATE,End_Pric_Date as END_DATE
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  )RT 
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = RT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID 
  JOIN (
    SELECT Busi_Id as BUSINESS_KEY_,Proc_Def_Bpmn_Id as PROC_DEF_KEY_,Proc_Instc_Id as PROC_INST_ID_,TO_TIMESTAMP(STAT_TIME) AS START_TIME_,TO_TIMESTAMP(END_TIME) AS END_TIME_,Proc_Stat as STATE_,End_Node_Id as END_ACT_ID_
    from	PDATA_N.T05_TIT_PROC_INSTC 
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.W_ACT_HI_PROCINST'
  ) PRO       --START_TIME_，END_TIME_ 带时间
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = PRO.BUSINESS_KEY_
  AND pro.STATE_ IN ('COMPLETED')
  AND PRO.END_ACT_ID_ IN ('EndEvent_0soieqs')
  WHERE 1=1
  AND TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID NOT LIKE 'OTCHKT%'
  AND substr(RT.START_DATE,1,10) >= '2024-01-01' --为了增加效率增加此条件,如需查询24年之前的合约请先注释此条件

) MD
left join (

WITH CALENDAR AS (
SELECT NATURE_DATE,SSE_DATE,LAST_1_DATE,LAST_2_DATE,NEXT_1_DATE,NEXT_2_DATE,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY SSE_DATE) AS SSE_RN
FROM (
  SELECT CC.CAL_DATE AS NATURE_DATE,CC1.CAL_DATE AS SSE_DATE,CC1.LAST_1_DATE,CC1.LAST_2_DATE,CC1.NEXT_1_DATE,NEXT_2_DATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC.CAL_DATE ORDER BY CC1.CAL_DATE) RN
  FROM (
    select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
    from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID = 'TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'NATURE' 
      AND from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') between '2024-01-01' AND '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  ) CC
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CAL_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_1_DATE,
    LAG(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS LAST_2_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_1_DATE,
    LEAD(CAL_DATE,2) OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY CAL_DATE) AS NEXT_2_DATE
    FROM (
      select from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(CAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')  as CAL_DATE,mkt_cd as EXCHANGE_CODE,TRD_FLAG as IS_HOLIDAY
      from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_trd_cal where SRC_ID='TIT' and GRP_ID = '01' and mkt_cd = 'SSE' AND TRD_FLAG = '1'
    ) cc 
  ) CC1
  ON CC.CAL_DATE <= CC1.CAL_DATE 
) cla
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY NATURE_DATE
)

SELECT agt_id,

	comp_stat_desc,
	create_time,
	appr_end_time,

	end_time,

	evt_type,
	evt_stat,

	proc_stat,
	tran_no,

	tran_stat,
	clr_date,

	adj_pst_bgng_pric,

	err_type,
	stat,
	wind_cd,
	hld_pos_qty,
	src_upt_time,
	src_busi_date,
	key_ca_id,
	ex_date,
	ca_type,
	ca_sub_type,
	bel_dept,
	data_time,
	grp_id,
	busi_date FROM (
	 


select  distinct

       ,md.internal_trade_id as trd_id                  --交易编号

       ,''                   as tran_type               --收付款类型

       ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')  as data_time               --数据时间
       ,'06'                                                   as grp_id                  --并行标识
       ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}'                                        as busi_date               --业务日期
from (
--期权部分平仓TRANSFER未生成
  SELECT
  '期权部分平仓TRANSFER未生成' AS ERROR_TYPE,
  TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID ,
  TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID ,
  ROOD.CONTR_STATUS,
  TOE.EVENT_DATE,
  TOE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,
  TOE.EVENT_TYPE,
  TT.CREATED_DATETIME,
  TT.TRANSFER_STATUS AS STATUS,
  TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID
  FROM  (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H b
      on a.agt_id = b.agt_id and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT opt_comp_agt_id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,comp_stat_cd as CONTR_STATUS,Erly_Trmt_Date as EARLY_TERM_DATE,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME              
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  )ROOD 
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = ROOD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID 
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT Opt_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Bgng_Prcg_Date as START_DATE,End_Prcg_Date as END_DATE,Src_Prd_Id as UNDERLYING_INS_ID,Undrl_Cd as UNDERLYING_WIND_CODE
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  )RODS 
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = RODS.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  INNER JOIN (
      SELECT Otc_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OPTION_DEAL_ID,Evt_Type_Cd as EVENT_TYPE,Evt_Date as EVENT_DATE,Evt_Stat_Cd as EVENT_STATUS,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,Appr_End_Time as EVENT_REAL_TIME

      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OPTION_EVENT'
  )TOE                --场外合约存续期变动事件  最新全量数据   CREATED_DATETIME,EVENT_REAL_TIME 带时间
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = TOE.KEY_OPTION_DEAL_ID
  AND TOE.EVENT_TYPE = 'PARTIAL_TERMINATION'
  AND TOE.EVENT_STATUS = '3'
  LEFT JOIN (
      select Comp_No as KEY_CONTRACT_ID,Clr_Date as CLEARING_DATE,Recv_Pymt_Type_Cd as TRANSFER_TYPE,Recv_Pymt_Stat_Cd as TRANSFER_STATUS,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME
      from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_RECV_PYMT_EVT
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRANSFER' and del_flag <> '1'
  ) TT                --场外衍生品收付款事件   只有最新全量数据  CREATED_DATETIME 带时间
  ON TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID = TT.KEY_CONTRACT_ID
  AND SUBSTR(TOE.EVENT_DATE,1,10) = SUBSTR(TT.CLEARING_DATE,1,10)
  AND TT.TRANSFER_STATUS IN ('VERIFIED','SETTLED')
  AND TT.TRANSFER_TYPE = 'PARTIAL_TERM_FEE' 
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
    ON SUBSTR(C1.NATURE_DATE,1,10) = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
  ON SUBSTR(TOE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10) = C2.NATURE_DATE
  WHERE SUBSTR(C1.LAST_1_DATE,1,10) <= SUBSTR(TOE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10)
  AND (TT.CREATED_DATETIME IS NULL OR SUBSTR(TT.CREATED_DATETIME,1,10) >= C2.NEXT_1_DATE)

  AND SUBSTR(TOE.EVENT_DATE,1,10) < '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'

  UNION ALL

  --期权合约平仓TRANSFER未生成
  SELECT
  '期权合约终止TRANSFER未生成' AS ERROR_TYPE,
  TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID ,
  TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID ,
  ROOD.CONTR_STATUS,
  NVL(ROOD.EARLY_TERM_DATE,RODS.END_DATE) AS EVENT_DATE,
  PRO.END_TIME_ AS EVENT_REAL_TIME,
  '期权合约终止',
  TT.CREATED_DATETIME,
  TT.TRANSFER_STATUS,
  TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID
  FROM  (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H b
      on a.agt_id = b.agt_id and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT opt_comp_agt_id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,comp_stat_cd as CONTR_STATUS,Erly_Trmt_Date as EARLY_TERM_DATE,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME              
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  )ROOD 
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = ROOD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID 
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT Opt_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Bgng_Prcg_Date as START_DATE,End_Prcg_Date as END_DATE,Src_Prd_Id as UNDERLYING_INS_ID,Undrl_Cd as UNDERLYING_WIND_CODE
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  )RODS 
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = RODS.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT Busi_Id as BUSINESS_KEY_,Proc_Def_Bpmn_Id as PROC_DEF_KEY_,Proc_Instc_Id as PROC_INST_ID_,to_timestamp(Stat_Time) as START_TIME_,to_timestamp(End_Time) as END_TIME_,Proc_Stat as STATE_,End_Node_Id as END_ACT_ID_
    from	PDATA_N.T05_TIT_PROC_INSTC 
    where SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.W_ACT_HI_PROCINST'
  ) PRO       --START_TIME_，END_TIME_ 带时间
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = PRO.BUSINESS_KEY_ 
  AND PRO.PROC_DEF_KEY_ = 'Contract_effective_terminating_v1'
  AND PRO.STATE_ IN ('COMPLETED')
  AND PRO.END_ACT_ID_ = 'Event_0x994wk'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
  ON GREATEST(SUBSTR(PRO.END_TIME_,1,10),SUBSTR(NVL(ROOD.EARLY_TERM_DATE,RODS.END_DATE),1,10)) = C2.NATURE_DATE
  LEFT JOIN (
      select Comp_No as KEY_CONTRACT_ID,Clr_Date as CLEARING_DATE,Recv_Pymt_Type_Cd as TRANSFER_TYPE,Recv_Pymt_Stat_Cd as TRANSFER_STATUS,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME
      from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_RECV_PYMT_EVT
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRANSFER' and del_flag <> '1'
  ) TT                --场外衍生品收付款事件   只有最新全量数据
  ON TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID = TT.KEY_CONTRACT_ID
  AND SUBSTR(NVL(ROOD.EARLY_TERM_DATE,RODS.END_DATE),1,10) = SUBSTR(TT.CLEARING_DATE,1,10)
  AND TT.TRANSFER_STATUS IN ('VERIFIED','SETTLED')
  AND SUBSTR(TT.CREATED_DATETIME,1,10) < C2.NEXT_1_DATE
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
    ON SUBSTR(C1.NATURE_DATE,1,10) = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  WHERE SUBSTR(C1.LAST_1_DATE,1,10) <= SUBSTR(PRO.END_TIME_,1,10)
  AND TT.CREATED_DATETIME IS NULL
  AND ROOD.CONTR_STATUS != '218'
  AND SUBSTR(NVL(ROOD.EARLY_TERM_DATE,RODS.END_DATE),1,10) < '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  AND PRO.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL
  AND TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID NOT LIKE 'OPT-OTC%'
  AND RODS.UNDERLYING_WIND_CODE NOT IN ('GAMMA.WI','CHARM.WI') --20250425增加条件
  AND SUBSTR(RODS.START_DATE,1,10) >= '2024-01-01' --为了增加效率增加此条件,如需查询24年之前的合约请先注释此条件
  UNION ALL

  --互换部分平仓TRANSFER未生成
  SELECT
  '互换部分平仓TRANSFER未生成' AS ERROR_TYPE,
  TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID ,
  TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID ,
  RT.CONTR_STATUS,
  TTE.EVENT_DATE,
  TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,
  TTE.EVENT_TYPE,
  TT.CREATED_DATETIME,
  TT.TRANSFER_STATUS,
  TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID
  FROM  (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id

      AND Strt_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' AND  '${yyyy-MM-dd}' < End_Date 
  ) NT
    ON TT.TRANSFER_ID = NT.TRANSFER_ID
  LEFT JOIN (
    select a.otc_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.sett_date as clearing_date,a.sett_ntfc_stat_cd as status,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,Sett_Ntfc_Id as ID 
    from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_DERI_COMP_SETT_NTFC_SEND_EVT a
    where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.N_OPE_SETTLE_NOTICE' and a.del_flag <> '1'
  ) SN 
    ON NT.KEY_SN_ID = SN.ID
    AND SN.STATUS IN ('GENERATED','NOTIFIED','REPLIED','VERIFIED','WITHDRAW')
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
    ON SUBSTR(C1.NATURE_DATE,1,10) = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
    ON SUBSTR(TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10) = C2.NATURE_DATE
  WHERE SUBSTR(C1.LAST_1_DATE,1,10) <= SUBSTR(TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10)
    --AND SN.CREATED_DATETIME IS NULL 
    AND RT.CONTR_STATUS != '218'
    AND SUBSTR(TTE.EVENT_DATE,1,10) < '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
    AND TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID NOT LIKE 'OPT-OTC%'
    AND SUBSTR(RT.START_DATE,1,10) >= '2024-01-01' --为了增加效率增加此条件,如需查询24年之前的合约请先注释此条件
  UNION ALL

  --互换合约终止结算通知书未生成
  SELECT
  '互换合约终止结算通知书未生成' AS ERROR_TYPE,
  TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID ,
  TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID ,
  RT.CONTR_STATUS,
  TTE.EVENT_DATE,
  TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,
  TTE.EVENT_TYPE,
  SN.CREATED_DATETIME,
  SN.STATUS,
  TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID,
  C2.NEXT_1_DATE,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID ORDER BY NVL(SN.CREATED_DATETIME,'ZZZZZ'),NVL(TTE.EVENT_DATE,'ZZZZZ')) AS RN
  FROM  (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H b
      on a.agt_id = b.agt_id and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT Swap_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,Comp_Stat_Cd as CONTR_STATUS,Strt_Pric_Date as START_DATE,End_Pric_Date as END_DATE
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_SWAP_COMP_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_TRS' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  )RT    
  ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = RT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  INNER JOIN (
      SELECT Otc_Comp_Agt_Id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Evt_Date as EVENT_DATE,Evt_Stat_Cd as EVENT_STATUS,Evt_Type_Cd as EVENT_TYPE,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,Appr_End_Time AS EVENT_REAL_TIME,Src_Id AS KEY_TRS_EVENT_ID  
      from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_COMP_DURA_CHG_EVT
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRS_EVENT'
  )TTE            --场外合约存续期变动事件 最新全量数据 CREATED_DATETIME,EVENT_REAL_TIME 带时间
    ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = TTE.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
    AND TTE.EVENT_TYPE IN ('EARLY_TERMINATION','TERMINATION')
    AND TTE.EVENT_STATUS = '3'
  LEFT JOIN (
      select Comp_No as KEY_CONTRACT_ID,Clr_Date as CLEARING_DATE,Recv_Pymt_Type_Cd as TRANSFER_TYPE,Recv_Pymt_Stat_Cd as TRANSFER_STATUS,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,Recv_Pymt_No AS TRANSFER_ID,Swap_Dura_Evt_No AS  KEY_TRS_EVENT_ID
      from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_RECV_PYMT_EVT
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_TRANSFER' and del_flag <> '1'
  ) TT                --场外衍生品收付款事件   只有最新全量数据  CREATED_DATETIME 带时间
    ON TTE.KEY_TRS_EVENT_ID = TT.KEY_TRS_EVENT_ID
    AND TT.TRANSFER_STATUS IN ('VERIFIED','SETTLED')
    AND TT.TRANSFER_TYPE = 'TERMINATION_INCOME'
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT SUBSTR(Rela_Evt_Id,8) AS TRANSFER_ID,SUBSTR(EVT_ID,8) AS KEY_SN_ID
    FROM PDATA_N.T05_OTC_DERI_EVT_RELA_H
    WHERE SRC_TBL = 'ODATA_N_TIT.N_OPE_SETTLE_NOTICE_TRANSFER' 
      AND Strt_Date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' AND  '${yyyy-MM-dd}' < End_Date 
  ) NT
    ON TT.TRANSFER_ID = NT.TRANSFER_ID
  LEFT JOIN (
    select a.otc_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.sett_date as clearing_date,a.sett_ntfc_stat_cd as status,Create_Time as CREATED_DATETIME,Sett_Ntfc_Id as ID 
    from PDATA_N.T05_OTC_DERI_COMP_SETT_NTFC_SEND_EVT a
    where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.N_OPE_SETTLE_NOTICE' and a.del_flag <> '1'
  ) SN 
    ON NT.KEY_SN_ID = SN.ID
    AND SN.STATUS IN ('GENERATED','NOTIFIED','REPLIED','VERIFIED','WITHDRAW')
  JOIN CALENDAR C1
    ON SUBSTR(C1.NATURE_DATE,1,10) = '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  LEFT JOIN CALENDAR C2
    ON SUBSTR(TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10) = C2.NATURE_DATE
  WHERE SUBSTR(C1.LAST_1_DATE,1,10) <= SUBSTR(TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME,1,10)
  --AND SN.CREATED_DATETIME IS NULL 
  AND RT.CONTR_STATUS != '218'
  AND SUBSTR(TTE.EVENT_DATE,1,10) < '${yyyy-MM-dd,1d}'
  AND TTE.EVENT_REAL_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID NOT LIKE 'OPT-OTC%'
  AND SUBSTR(RT.START_DATE,1,10) >= '2024-01-01' --为了增加效率增加此条件,如需查询24年之前的合约请先注释此条件
) SNI
WHERE RN = 1
  AND (CREATED_DATETIME IS NULL OR SUBSTR(CREATED_DATETIME,1,10) >= NEXT_1_DATE)
) MD
left join (
  SELECT SRC_CD_VAL,DW_CD_VAL,src_cd_desc
    FROM PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP
  WHERE TGT_TAB_NAME = 'T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO'
    AND TGT_TAB_FLD  = 'Comp_Stat_Cd'
    AND SRC_TAB_NAME = 'REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL'
    AND SRC_FLD_NAME = 'CONTR_STATUS'
    AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'TIT'
) CD on MD.CONTR_STATUS = CD.DW_CD_VAL
INNER JOIN (
  select book_agt_id as key_book_id,bel_dept as department  
  from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
  where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) RB
  ON MD.KEY_BOOK_ID = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID 
	) castTable

name: 波动率行情表_11点批次
querySql:
SELECT fctr_id,
	vola_curv_id,
	val_dt,
	fctr_cd,
	fctr_curv_ch_name,
	dim1,
	dim2,
	dim3,
	vola,
	maty_date,
	src_id,
	rec_upd_time,
	data_time,
	busi_date FROM (
	 select
    a.fctr_id,              --因子ID
    b.vola_curv_id,         --波动率曲线ID
    c.val_dt,               --曲面日期
    a.fctr_cd,              --因子代码
    a.fctr_curv_ch_name,    --因子曲线中文名称
    c.term_stru as dim1,    --维度1取值
    '' as dim2,             --维度2取值
    '' as dim3,             --维度3取值
    c.fctr_val as vola,     --波动率
    c.maty_date,            --到期日
    'LBR' as src_id,        --来源标识
    c.rec_upd_time,         --记录更新时间
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        fctr_cd,
        fctr_curv_ch_name
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_def
    where
        src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and fctr_engine_hand_method in ('VOL_CMF_EWMA_HIS_CALC','VOL_FX_EWMA_HIS_CALC','VOL_IR_CF_HIS_CALC')
    ) a 
join
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        vola_curv_id
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_vola_cate_fctr_def
    where
        busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and vola_srfc_type = 'TERM'
    ) b 
on
    a.fctr_id = b.fctr_id
join
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        default.datekey2date(trd_date) val_dt,
        term_stru,
        fctr_val,
        maty_date,
        rec_upd_time
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_data
    where
        src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '02'
    ) c 
on
    a.fctr_id = c.fctr_id
union all
select
    a.fctr_id,              --因子ID
    b.vola_curv_id,         --波动率曲线ID
    d.val_dt,               --曲面日期
    a.fctr_cd,              --因子代码
    a.fctr_curv_ch_name,    --因子曲线中文名称
    d.term as dim1,         --维度1取值
    '' as dim2,             --维度2取值
    '' as dim3,             --维度3取值
    cast(d.intrpn/100 as decimal(18,6)) as vola,   --波动率
    d.maty_date,            --到期日
    d.src_id,               --来源标识
    d.rec_upd_time,         --记录更新时间
    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as data_time, --数据时间
    '${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date                                        --业务日期
from
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        fctr_cd,
        fctr_curv_ch_name
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_fctr_def
    where
        src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and fctr_engine_hand_method in ('VOL_GENERIC_ATM_CALC', 'VOL_FUTURE_ATM_CALC', 'VOL_MANUAL_INPUT_CALC','VOL_IMPLIED_BENCHMARK_CALC')
    ) a 
join
    (
    select
        fctr_id,
        src_sys_prdno,
        vola_curv_id
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_vola_cate_fctr_def
    where
        busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
        and vola_srfc_type = 'TERM'
        and coalesce(trim(vola_curv_id),'') <> ''
    ) b 
on
    a.fctr_id = b.fctr_id
join
    (
    select
        src_sys_prdno
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_undrl_data_lbr
    where
        busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        and src_id = 'LBR'
        and grp_id = '01'
    ) c 
on
    b.src_sys_prdno = c.src_sys_prdno
join
    (
    select
        curv_surf_id,
        substr(curv_surf_date,1,10) val_dt,
        term,
        intrpn,
        substr(maty_date,1,10) maty_date,
        src_id,
        rec_upd_time
    from
        pdata_news_n.t02_fin_vola_instc
    where
        src_id='TIT' 
        and grp_id='01'
    ) d 
on
    b.vola_curv_id = d.curv_surf_id 
	) castTable
